title: 2026 PGS 6: Who will be the final winner?
author: JBowlerr
contents:
[p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/gkOC94XN.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The first half of the 2026 PGS is already nearing its end. With various teams taking turns claiming the championship, I’d like to introduce three teams considered the absolute strongest title contenders. Let's take a clear look at each team's unique traits, strengths, and weaknesses.[/p][p][/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/FbtZ2p21.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][b]\[The God of War / Natus Vincere][/b][/p][p]"Born to Win." Living up to their name, Natus Vincere (NAVI) is a team that fears no fight. They don't mind disadvantageous terrain or setups; they overcome it all through sheer combat, eventually pulling off victories that give viewers an electrifying thrill. Led by their ace Hakatory, the roster includes boost1k- (who debuted last year and became Europe's rising star), spyrro (a foundational veteran of PUBG esports), and Feyerist (handling team coordination and backup). Together, they are making massive waves in the 2026 PUBG esports scene.[/p][p]There are countless moments that highlight NAVI's overwhelming combat prowess, but the most iconic would be 2026 PGS 2, where they pulled off a dramatic comeback championship from the brink. The back-to-back Chicken Dinners in Match 9 (Taego) and Match 10 (Miramar) are prime examples of them winning through absolute dominance. In Match 9 on Taego, they crushed a full-squad Anyone's Legend (AL) with just three players. In the final Match 10 on Miramar, despite a 13-point deficit behind the frontrunner AL, they once again used just three players to wipe out other teams, taking an 18-kill Chicken Dinner and carving out a historic comeback victory themselves.[/p][p]This team's strength is clear-cut: their gunplay is simply unbelievable. In terms of pure combat ability, it's safe to say almost no one can match their main roster. Hakatory, mentioned earlier, is the team's absolute core. To put it simply, even Twisted Minds' xmpl, who was revered by all players until '25, has to take a backseat to Hakatory considering recent stats. He secured a staggering 9 Man of the Match titles across the '26 PGS events and even took the Kill Leader title in PGS 5, building an untouchable legacy.[/p][p]Their team stats are just as stellar. Usually, teams that hit over 900 DPM (Damage Per Match) are the ones lifting the trophies. Over 45 matches in the '26 PGS Final Stage, NAVI recorded 45,323 total damage, hitting a DPM of 1,007. While damage isn't always the most highlighted metric, NAVI's true value shines in how they consistently stack damage to pry open opportunities.[/p][p]Most engagements start with Hakatory opening fire. From there, NAVI's primary win condition is leveraging numerical advantages to crush the opposition. Hakatory's combat ability is so overwhelming that he can often take down 2 to 3 players in a row by himself. But that's also their biggest double-edged sword: if Hakatory is picked off early, their win rate isn't great. Recently, however, spyrro and boost1k- have been putting up such aggressive performances that they're offsetting that weakness, making the team an even more terrifying unit.[/p][p]The moment you engage this team, you have to fight with the mindset of risking a full wipe. They are undoubtedly the most dreaded team to face. Your only real chance is to focus fire the exact moment they take damage. If you're aiming for the championship, you absolutely cannot miss the split second NAVI wavers. But what if NAVI stays on their feet until the very end? Well, quietly dropping a frag grenade at your own feet might be one way out.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/6jA1Gwje.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The Master of Rotation / Virtus.pro][/b][/p][p]If I had to pick just one team that best understands the fundamental rules of PUBG, I would choose this team without hesitation. Clean, flawless plays, refreshing survival strategies tailored to every situation, rotations that erase the opponents' options one by one, and a display of maximum capacity in everything needed to survive. That is Virtu[u][url="http://virtus.pro/"]s.pro(VP).[/url][/u][/p][p]Of course, VP wasn't perfect from the start. Before winning 26 PGS 3, they tasted the bitterness of consecutive Final Stage eliminations in PGS 1 and 2. However, they consistently stacked data to figure out other teams' paths. They developed ways to stabilize their roster and perfected their "first aid kit" strategy for when their squad was crippled, pushing their survival time to the extreme limit. The average survival time for a tournament-winning team is usually around 24 minutes, but across 35 matches, VP recorded a whopping 25 minutes and 56 seconds per match.[/p][p]The Taego match that epitomizes VP's survival drama shows just how meticulous and calculating this team is. With the final circle ending inside a building, they recognized their positional disadvantage against 4AM, who had already taken the roof. Deciding they couldn't win a head-on fight, they prepared Level 3 and 2 Jammer Packs. Tanking massive Blue Zone damage and outlasting everyone to take the Chicken Dinner was a scene that showcased the very essence of PUBG.[/p][p]On top of that, VP is the most strategic user of Gliders among international teams. The hardest part for edge teams rotating inward is spotting hidden ambushes. VP solves this by using Gliders to scout for ambushes before moving in, maximizing their squad's preservation. They were also the first team to attempt a Glider drop strategy in an international tournament. Although they lost that Rondo match, it was a moment that showed VP's brilliant quick-thinking and creativity.[/p][p]Add to that their decision-making ability to instantly lock down the battlefield and cut off other teams' options. A prime example is the Miramar match in PGS 5 Final Stage D1 M2. They completely shut down the entry routes of T1 and Petrichor Road pushing up from the south, simultaneously ruining 4AM's plans to third-party the fight, resulting in a flawless Chicken Dinner. VP doesn't just sit and wait for the circle; they have the ability to proactively design the situation.[/p][p]I've focused heavily on their survival and strategy, but does that mean they lack firepower? During their 26 PGS 3 championship run, across 15 matches, they averaged 5.9 kills per match, 16,993 total damage, and a DPM of 1,132. By bringing renowned fighting teams to their knees, they proved their combat prowess is entirely intact. While they prefer simple, practical techniques in fights, they also show trendy mechanics depending on the situation, proving their individual skills are highly solid.[/p][p]Armed with diverse strategies and judgments to outlive anyone, VP will remain a complex puzzle in the minds of every participating team. While other teams are busy trying to solve that puzzle, VP will only grow more solid. They might just be the first to lift their second PGS trophy.[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/X0zrIbnE.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][b]
\[The Standard / 17Gaming][/b][/p][p]Everyone expected them to fail under those circumstances. Many said it was impossible because their core roster couldn't play together. A coach in his forties had to inevitably fill the void, and just as many predicted, the team was pushed to the absolute edge in the Survival Stage.[/p][p]But defying concerns, Coach Akuma filled the gap to secure a ticket to the Final Stage, and once their starting players returned for the finals, they went all the way to win 26 PGS 5. This is the story of China's PUBG powerhouse, 17Gaming.[/p][p]Hearing just the intro might make it sound like a dramatic movie, but if you look closely at the matches, 17Gaming didn't really change much. They simply moved to good positions at the right times, maintained the spots they usually favored but with added stability, and flawlessly demonstrated their world-class grenade usage. If there was a difference, it was maybe using a bit more smokes than usual. 17Gaming simply plays the game by the book.[/p][p]17Gaming doesn't use dramatic fights like NAVI or eccentric strategies like VP, but they always make the best possible move in every situation. Unexpected variables are bound to happen in this game, and maintaining cold logic through all of it is not easy. But China's greatest mastermind, Lilghost, makes composed yet profound decisions.[/p][p]The Rondo match in Final Stage D1 M4 serves as a perfect example. A Test Track circle popped, setting up a classic do-or-die scenario. 17 Gaming constantly looked for gaps to push inward while swatting away teams on the edge. They meticulously checked the kill feed, attempting entry based entirely on hard information.[/p][p]When MiTH, who was playing the outer fields, got wiped while forcing a push onto NAVI's in-circle compound, NAVI also failed to keep their squad intact. 17Gaming, who had been eyeing that exact spot, walked right in without shedding a drop of blood. Even DNS, who held a favorable late-game circle, saw their solid defensive line crumble from a single Lilghost frag grenade. 17Gaming followed up with continuous nades to wipe DNS, fended off all remaining teams, and took the Chicken Dinner.[/p][p]Usually, teams that deal over 17 damage per grenade get good results in tournaments. Across 30 Final Stage matches, 17Gaming threw 309 frag grenades, dealing a total of 5,828 damage. Doing the math, that’s an average of 18.86 damage per nade. Such incredible stats are partly due to the players' mechanical skill, but mostly because the shot-calling on exactly where to focus those throws is crystal clear.[/p][p]Furthermore, their play of holding the edge, burning as much time as possible, and watching for the perfect spot before moving in has become noticeably smoother than in the past. Built on that strategy, they managed to grab two Chicken Dinners on Taego in a single day. At the center of that secret was the rediscovery of the Porter, a vehicle rarely utilized on Taego.[/p][p]The Porter's cargo capacity is 400. Even if you only packed smoke grenades (weight 14), you could fit a whopping 28 of them. Not only that, but when you load items into the trunk, physical boxes actually appear in the back, providing cover from bullets. Of course, it's hard to drive and keeping the tires safe is tough, but in this PGS 5, 17Gaming successfully loaded the Porter with various supplies and utilized it until the very end of their Taego matches.[/p][p]The players' individual forms are also top-tier. Xwudd, the best gunner in the mid-range, along with tiantian and Wenbo—newly acquired from CTG this year—blended into the team so naturally it feels like they’ve always been there. With everyone's mechanics peaking, it looks incredibly difficult for anyone to gain the upper hand against 17 Gaming. The standard does not waver easily.[/p][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p]If you've read this far, one question probably comes to mind.[/p][p]So, who’s going to win?[/p][p]There are no absolutes in PUBG. Predictions can always miss the mark, and new variables can always emerge. Nevertheless, at this very moment, I pick Natus Vincere, Virtus.pro, and 17Gaming as the absolute strongest contenders.[/p][p]Data doesn't lie. The results and metrics built up across countless matches ultimately prove who the strong teams are. And if the current momentum holds, it’s highly likely that the PGS 6 trophy will end up in the arms of one of these three teams.[/p][p]Whether my prediction hits the mark... we'll ultimately find the answer on the battlegrounds of PGS 6.[/p][p]- Jisooboy[/p]

title: Community Survey — Share Your Feedback With Us
author: TecK
contents:
[p]Hello players,[/p][p]We are running a new [b]PUBG Community Survey[/b], and we would like to hear directly from you.[/p][p][/p][p]This survey is about your experience with PUBG community channels, such as Steam Forums, Discord, Reddit, and other places where you follow news, share feedback, ask questions, or interact with other players.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to better understand what matters most to players in different regions, what you feel is working well, and where you think we can improve. This includes topics such as communication, community team presence, responses to player concerns, local language support, moderation, community activities, and how well player feedback is being heard.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback will help us improve the way we support and communicate with the PUBG community going forward.[/p][p]As a thank you for participating, we will select [b]50 players[/b] who complete the survey by [b]June 12, 2026[/b] to receive [b]1,000 G-Coin[/b] each.[/p][p][/p][p]Take the survey here:
[url="https://forms.gle/Csz8Ri48TrdzHUXx8"]https://forms.gle/Csz8Ri48TrdzHUXx8[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for sharing your thoughts and helping us improve the PUBG community experience.[/p][p]— PUBG Community Team[/p]

title: PUBG Nations Cup 2026 Tournament Details
author: JBowlerr
contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p]In our previous announcement, we shared the dates and the participating nations for the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026). In this announcement, we'll walk you through the tournament format, ruleset, and other key details of the event. Let's take a closer look at PUBG Esports' biggest all-star showdown, where 24 national teams will gather on one stage.[/p][p][b]PUBG Nations Cup 2026[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Across five days of competition, 24 national teams will battle for national pride and a share of the $500,000 base prize pool, further boosted by crowdfunding.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: June 23rd – 24th / PUBG Seongsu[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: June 26th – 28th / Jangchung Arena, Seoul[/p][/*][/list][p]All matches are scheduled to begin at 19:00 KST / 10:00 UTC / 12:00 CEST / 17:00 ICT / 03:00 PDT each day. Further details on ticket sales and on-site events will be shared on the PUBG ESPORTS website in the coming weeks.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/659bf6c7733ba6a03e2325102d75d30bf241f851.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tournament Format[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will advance directly to the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will begin their journey from the Survival Stage.[/p][p][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Map Order][/b][/p][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/p][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.
The total prize pool will be distributed according to each team's final ranking, and both the prize money and sales revenue share will be distributed equally among each team's roster. Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.[/p][p]Stay updated on all things PUBG Nations Cup 2026 by following the PUBG Esports website and our official social channels.[/p][p]
[/p]

contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p]In our previous announcements, we shared the schedule and participating teams for the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026). At last, we're excited to officially unveil the rosters of all 24 all-star teams set to take the stage in Seoul this June![/p][p]96 all-star players and 24 coaches will compete for the title of world's best — meet the full lineup taking the PNC 2026 stage below.[/p][h2]PNC 2026 Official Rosters[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ed758870174d1ca307288fdddf4cf3c3364a97fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/34b2eac02cf69fa7138f52c34caa95ca92d7ec95.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f1c2f2ff7f3d248cdd52d6efda7bf1f3f1ad41d1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a6d4f4a48c6a01b6022761247d676974d87dadaf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/690ec8aafdd374160522a6ef667edb693045298c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1eb57c9c90569a294a28e1082b740a6a8d09ea1a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Storylines to Watch at PNC 2026[/h2][h3]Return of the Champions[/h3][p]Since the very first PUBG Nations Cup in 2019, only four teams have ever lifted the PNC trophy. This year, 10 of those past champions return to the PNC 2026 stage.[/p][list][*][p][b]The First PNC Champion (2019): ADOUZ1E[/b] returns to the PNC stage for the first time in seven years.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2022 Champion[/b] — [b]United Kingdom[/b]: The full championship lineup is back together. Vard, Fexx, TeaBone, and mykLe reunite under head coach MiracU.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2023 & PNC 2024 Back-to-Back Champion[/b] — [b]South Korea[/b]: Heaven stands alone as the only player in the PNC 2026 field with two PNC titles to his name.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PNC 2025 Defending Champion — Vietnam[/b]: The defending champion's title-winning roster returns intact — Himass, TanVuu, Delwyn, and Sololzy, with head coach DjChip back to lead the title defense.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Three Players Who've Never Missed a PNC[/h3][p]Since the first PUBG Nations Cup in 2019, only three players have appeared at every single edition.[/p][list][*][p][b]Vard [/b]— United Kingdom, Construction Workers[/p][/*][*][p][b]ItzzChrizZ [/b]— Germany, ACEND Club[/p][/*][*][p][b]luke12 [/b]— Australia, Team Liquid[/p][/*][/list][p]PNC 2026 will be their[b] sixth PNC[/b].[/p][p]One more name belongs alongside them. [b]Chinese Taipei's head coach Leo[/b] competed as a player in every PNC from 2019 to 2025. This year, he returns as a head coach — the same uninterrupted record, a new role at the table.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Happy Early Birthday, Mikzenn[/h3][p]On June 27, Denmark's Mikzenn (Patrick Pagh Christensen) will celebrate his 24th [b]birthday [/b]on the PNC 2026 Grand Finals stage — the only player in the 96-player field whose birthday falls within the tournament window.[/p][p]An early [b]happy birthday [/b]from PUBG Esports![/p][p] [/p][h3]Yesterday's Teammates, Today's Rivals[/h3][p]This is the magic that only PNC can deliver. Players who share a practice room and a roster jersey all year round suddenly find themselves on opposite sides of the same lobby — facing off against the very people they call teammates the rest of the year.[/p][p]This year, [b]Team Falcons [/b]sends 5 representatives to PNC 2026, split across [b]3 different teams[/b] — and three of them lead their squads as captains.[/p][list][*][p][b]TGLTN [/b]— Captain of Australia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gustav [/b]— Captain of Denmark[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shrimzy [/b](Captain), Kickstart, head coach GUNNER — United States[/p][/*][/list][p]One org, three teams. The Falcons family will meet in Seoul this June — and from the moment they drop into the same lobby, they'll be marking each other first.[/p][p] [/p][p]Stay tuned for further updates on PNC 2026 via the official PUBG Esports website and our social channels.[/p][p]A five-day showdown of the world's best all-star teams is coming to Seoul this June — we can't wait to see you at PUBG Nations Cup 2026![/p][p]
[/p]

title: Squads up. We are running our first Crew Clash this Saturday with Rumble!
author: TecK
contents: [p]This is the first time we are testing this community format, so the goal is simple: bring crews together, see how squads respond to Rumble, collect useful feedback, and decide whether this should become a regular weekend activity.[/p][p][/p][p]Rumble is a weekend-limited casual competitive mode where pre-made 4-player crews can test their teamwork without the pressure of Ranked tier losses. You still get the tension, the leaderboard chase, and the rewards![/p][p][/p][p][b]⌚ This week’s Rumble window[/b][/p][list][*][p]Saturday, May 23rd[/p][/*][*][p]20:00 - 00:00 (regional local time)[/p][list][*][p]Available in NA & EU[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b] 💭 How to join[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play Rumble during the Saturday window[/p][/*][*][p]Submit your [b]result screensho[/b]t after playing on our [url="https://discord.gg/4Prp35bU"]Discord server[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Give us some feedback about the mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]✍️ Example Post[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ingame Names: TecK, Kruskay, 0reeoo & xFlow[/p][/*][*][p]Rumble Region: EU[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback: Competing against other players was fun, but I would like to see XYZ changed and have it available on Sunday as well.[/p][/*][*][p]+ attached screenshot[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🪙 Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Highest ranked crew: [b]3000 G-Coin[/b] each player[/p][/*][*][p]10x random participating crews: [b]500 G-Coin[/b] each player[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗒️ Important Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can submit your results untilMonday, 25 May 2026 at 09:00 CEST.[/p][/*][*][p]Once your crew is signed up in Rumble, you cannot change crew members, switch crews, or participate in Rumble in a different region during that stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Rumble is played as Squad TPP Normal Matches on Erangel, Taego, Miramar, or Rondo, selected at random.[/p][/*][*][p]Top crews are ranked by accumulated score from placement, survival time, and kills. Rankings update every 5 minutes, and final rankings are determined 2 hours after the Rumble stage ends.[/p][/*][*][p]G-Coin rewards won on Discord will be sent directly to your account within 7 days after the end of this event.[/p][/*][/list]

title: PUBG Global Championship 2026 Heads to İstanbul, Türkiye!
author: JBowlerr
contents:
[p]The most prestige stage of the year, the PUBG Global Championship 2026 (PGC 2026), runs from December 1 (Tue) to December 13 (Sun) in İstanbul, Türkiye.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"]Thirty-two teams from around the world will compete across nine match days for a $1,500,000+ prize pool and the title of PUBG Esports global champion. Fan-driven crowdfunding will add to the prize pool, with additional rewards going to the top-performing teams.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][h1][b]PGC 2026 Overview[/b][/h1][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/Od3eKaLo.png"][/img][/b][/p][list][*][p]Location: İstanbul, Türkiye[/p][/*][*][p]Dates: December 1 (Tue) – December 13 (Sun), 2026[/p][/*][*][p]Teams: 32[/p][/*][*][p]Prize Pool: $1,500,000 (+ crowdfunding)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]A New Qualification Path[/b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/CIwQcuLd.png"][/img][/h2][p align="start"]For PGC 2026, each team's starting stage is determined by their results across PGS and regional leagues throughout the season. Unlike previous seasons where all teams began from a shared Group Stage, top-seeded teams will skip earlier stages and enter the tournament at a later point.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/4SqeIax6.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/FtbEQkUf.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]There are three entry paths to PGC 2026:[/p][list][*][p]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage Day 1 Direct — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Qualifying Stage Entry — 16 teams[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This tiered structure rewards teams that performed well throughout the season with a stronger starting position at PGC, and raises the stakes for every match across the regional leagues and PGS leading up to the global stage.[/p][p align="start"]Note: If a team qualifies for PGC through both PGS points and a regional league, the higher-stage qualification takes precedence. When both qualifications correspond to the same stage, PGS points take priority. Any seed that goes unused due to double qualification is removed and reallocated to the next-in-line team in that region's PGC points standings.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Regional Seed Allocation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Global Seeds (PGS) — 8 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Americas (PAS) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]China (PCL) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]EMEA (PEC) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Korea (PWS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Rest of APAC (PMS) — 2 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Thailand (PTS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnam (PVS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Wildcard — 1 slot[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The Wildcard slot will go to a team representing Türkiye, the host region for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The tournament consists of three phases: [b]Qualifying Stage, Survival Stage[/b], and [b]Grand Finals.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/mMT0z8lu.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Qualifying Stage — December 1 (Tue)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The 16 Qualifying Stage seeds compete on the opening day.[/p][p align="start"]The top 8 advance to Survival Stage Day 1, while the remaining 8 move to Survival Stage Day 2.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage — December 2 (Wed) – December 6 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Survival Stage runs across five days, with 16 teams competing each day.[/p][p align="start"]From Day 1 through Day 4, the team with the highest combined match score on each day secures a direct ticket to the Grand Finals — one per day, four teams in total.[/p][p align="start"]On the final day, the top 16 teams by cumulative points across Days 1 through 4 compete for the last four Grand Finals spots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals — December 11 (Fri) – December 13 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Grand Finals span three days with a total of 15 matches (five per day). The final standings and the year's global champion will be decided here.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Grand Finals Qualified Teams[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The 16 teams competing at the Grand Finals reach the stage through three paths.[/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Six Regional League 1st place teams + PGS 1st place + Host Country Wildcard[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Daily Match Winners — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]One match winner from each of Survival Stage Day 1 through Day 4[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Cumulative Top 4 — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Top 4 by total points across the entire Survival Stage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Prize Pool[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The total PGC 2026 prize pool is $1,500,000+, made up of the Ranking Prize (based on final standings) and the Special Prize (awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals).[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/J6crpHtc.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Ranking Prize — $1,310,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Ranking Prize is distributed to all participating teams based on Grand Finals qualification and final standings. Minimum guaranteed payouts for teams that do not reach the Grand Finals are integrated into the same Ranking Prize structure, creating a single, unified payout system.[/p][p align="start"][b]Special Prize — $190,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]Additional prizes are awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Fan-driven crowdfunding returns for PGC 2026. This season brings one notable change: crowdfunding contributions will be distributed exclusively to the Grand Finals Top 8 teams, allocated by final standing (30% to 4%).[/p][p align="start"]The more fans take part, the larger the final prize pool grows, and the greater the rewards for top-performing clubs. Details on how to participate will follow through official channels.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Closing[/b][/p][p align="start"]With this season's PGS and regional league results directly shaping each team's starting point at PGC 2026, every remaining match carries added weight. Stay tuned for the 32 teams set to compete for the title this December in İstanbul.[/p][p align="start"]Further details on PGC 2026 will follow through PUBG Esports' official channels.[/p]

title: Vote for Your Player. Win G-Coin.
author: JBowlerr
contents: [p]Player of the Day is back for PGS Circuit 2. Here's everything you need to know — including what's new this circuit.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="https://media-cdn.atlassian.com/file/97e3b562-d2f3-4dca-9647-cf2d7c6d0379/image/cdn?allowAnimated=true&client=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&collection=contentId-1046653477&height=125&max-age=2592000&mode=full-fit&source=mediaCard&token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..TRyOFyJa_uONHCs4r0BccIvu9tKv7qSB5ivKvtjTD8w&width=421#media-blob-url=true&id=97e3b562-d2f3-4dca-9647-cf2d7c6d0379&clientId=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&contextId=contentId-1046653477&collection=contentId-1046653477"][/img][/p][h2]What Is Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]Player of the Day is a fan-driven spotlight program that runs during the Final Day broadcast of each tournament. While the pros battle it out on the biggest stage, you get to vote for the player who impressed you most. The player chosen by fan vote is officially recognized as the 'Player of the Day' by PUBG Esports.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Who Can Be Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]There's no set formula. But Player of the Day might just be a player like this:[/p][list][*][p]The one who [b]carried[/b] the team with dominant kills and damage[/p][/*][*][p]The one who pulled off a [b]clutch[/b] play and turned the tide[/p][/*][*][p]The one who showed [b]textbook survival[/b] with sharp positioning and game sense[/p][/*][*][p]The one who [b]changed the game[/b] with creative use of grenades, Panzerfaust, BRDMs, and more[/p][/*][*][p]The one who created [b]that moment[/b] everyone's still talking about after the broadcast ends[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]These are just examples — greatness in PUBG comes in all forms. Vote for whoever left the biggest impression on you. That's all there is to it.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="https://media-cdn.atlassian.com/file/58fa990b-a640-427a-b1ce-650514ee6320/image/cdn?allowAnimated=true&client=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&collection=contentId-1046653477&height=125&max-age=2592000&mode=full-fit&source=mediaCard&token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..TRyOFyJa_uONHCs4r0BccIvu9tKv7qSB5ivKvtjTD8w&width=421#media-blob-url=true&id=58fa990b-a640-427a-b1ce-650514ee6320&clientId=051d0fcc-a9ba-4e64-bbda-3ffc74b0e997&contextId=contentId-1046653477&collection=contentId-1046653477"][/img][/p][h2]How to Participate[/h2][olist][*][p]Watch the PUBG Global Series Final Stage and Grand Finals broadcast. Player of the Day voting takes place on the Final Day of each PGS event.[/p][/*][*][p]Cast your vote. Once voting opens, a voting post will go live on the PUBG Esports website. One vote per person — pick one player from the nominees.[/p][/*][*][p]Follow the live results. Real-time vote standings are revealed during the broadcast, so you can see who's leading.[/p][/*][*][p]Check the results. After the Final, the Player of the Day will be announced through the official BATTLEGROUNDS Esports social channels.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Each Player of the Day will also be featured in dedicated post-event content, including interviews, behind-the-scenes coverage, and highlight packages.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]PGS Circuit 2 — Voting Schedule & Rewards[/h2][p align="start"]Player of the Day returns for PGS Circuit 2. Please note the updated voting window and rewards for this circuit.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="180,,,"][tr][th colwidth="180"][p]Event[/p][/th][th][p]Voting Window[/p][/th][th][p]Reward[/p][/th][th][p]Where to Vote[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 4 Final Stage Day 2[/p][/td][td][p]May 24 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p]1,000 G-Coin (random draw among voters)[/p][/td][td rowspan="3"][p][url="https://pubgesports.com"]pubgesports.com[/url] \[NEWS] – \[WIDGET][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 5 Final Stage Day 2[/p][/td][td][p]May 31 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="180"][p]PGS 6 Grand Finals Day 3[/p][/td][td][p]June 7 (Sun) 09:00 – 12:30 UTC[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]❗️ [b]The voting window has been updated this circuit.[/b] Voting now closes at 12:30 UTC — earlier than before. Make sure to cast your vote before the deadline![/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Why Player of the Day?[/h2][p align="start"]We want to shine a light not just on the champions, but on the players who make PUBG Esports an unforgettable experience through their own stories. And we want you to be part of that story. Whether it's a name you've cheered for all season or a player you discovered today — your vote puts the spotlight on them.[/p][p align="start"]Player of the Day is yours to decide. Today, who caught your eye?[/p]

title: PAS1 Finals 2 Day 3
author: JBowlerr
contents: [p]The last weekend of PAS1 is just around the corner, and there’s plenty to catch up on. From how things have unfolded so far to what’s on the line, plus Twitch drops, format details, and the full schedule, here’s your complete rundown.[/p][h3][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260506/qUILtINr.png"][/img][/h3][p align="start"]PAS1 introduced an exciting new format this season, featuring two separate rounds of Playoffs and Finals. We’ve already seen Playoffs 1 and Finals 1 wrap up, with Team Falcons claiming the top spot, closely followed by Godlike and Team Liquid. After that, everything was reset, and the competition kicked off again with Playoffs 2 last weekend. From there, 16 teams secured their place in this weekend’s Finals 2. Here’s who made the cut:[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260506/fL46qDHs.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260506/kgsiHf4i.png"][/img][/h3][p align="start"]It’s not just the players walking away with rewards this weekend. Viewers can also earn in-game items simply by tuning into the PAS1 Finals on Twitch. These drops will also be available during the PUBG EMEA Championship broadcasts.[/p][p align="start"][b]May 8[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Friendly Fire (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Networked Gloves[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]May 9[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Victory Dance 142[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Foulmouthed Mask[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]May 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 30 minutes of the stream: Lipovka Slacks[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Dash Doberman Tee[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Serpent’s Garden Jacket[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260506/xRtZBhrM.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Drops will be active on [u][url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_battlegrounds"]PUBG: Battlegrounds (EN)[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_br"]PUBG: Battlegrounds (PTBR)[/url][/u][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]What’s the format?[/h3][p align="start"]The format for the Finals remains a familiar one. Sixteen teams will battle it out across three days, playing a total of 15 matches. By the end of Sunday, the team with the highest overall points will be crowned the Finals 2 Champion. [/p][h3]What’s at stake?[/h3][p align="start"]These Finals are a major proving ground for teams looking to make it onto the global stage. Most importantly, this is where the majority of PGC Points are up for grabs, the key factor in qualifying for the PUBG Global Championship, the pinnacle event in PUBG Esports. While some points were earned during the Playoffs, the Finals carry much greater weight, making them the decisive stage in the qualification race.[/p][p align="start"]There’s even more on the line, too. The two teams with the highest total PGC Points from PEC: Spring will earn direct qualification to the Esports World Cup in Riyadh later this year, along with entry into all PUBG Global Series events in the second half of the season, including PGS Circuits 3 and 4.[/p][p align="start"]And to top it all off, each Finals weekend features a $30,000 prize pool, giving every team even more incentive to perform when it matters most.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Be sure to tune in on our [u][url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_battlegrounds"]Twitch[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@PUBGEsports"]YouTube[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://kick.com/pubgesports"]Kick[/url][/u] channels to catch all of the action![/p]

title: PEC: Spring Finals 2 - Day 3
author: JBowlerr
contents: [p]It’s almost time for the final weekend of PEC: Spring! Here’s everything you need to know about the story so far, what’s at stake, Twitch drops, format, schedule and more.[/p][h3][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260506/SoxXlnlY.jpg"][/img][/h3][p align="start"]PEC: Spring features a new double-trouble format, with two sets of Playoffs and Finals! title: PUBG Global Series Circuit 2 is about to drop!
author: Eoin
contents:
[p]A little over a month after Circuit 1's unpredictable three weeks, the 24 teams are back in Seoul. The PUBG Global Series returns with its second circuit — PGS 4-6 — kicking off May 20.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 2 isn't a reset. The PGS Points earned in Circuit 1 carry directly into the standings, and the final results here decide who qualifies for the Esports World Cup (EWC). Add a new patch to the mix, and the question becomes: how do the strategies teams locked in during Circuit 1 hold up in a different environment?[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Circuit 2 Overview[/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6211a4eea73f9b192067303cc970e33c5944d8ff.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Location: Seongsu, Seoul, South Korea[/p][/*][*][p]Participating Teams: 24 Teams[/p][/*][*][p]Total Prize Pool: $500,000 (PGS 4-5: $100,000 each / PGS 6: $300,000)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]All Circuit 2 matches begin at 19:00 KST (10:00 UTC / 11:00 CET / 17:00 ICT / 03:00 PDT) daily. 
[i]*PGS 4 Day 1 Group Stage begins at 14:00 KST (05:00 UTC / 06:00 CET / 12:00 ICT / 22:00 PDT†). † Previous day (May 19)[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Group Stage Seeding — Based on PGS 3 Results[/h3][p align="start"]Circuit 2 Group Stage seeding was drawn via snake draft from PGS 3 final standings. Circuit 1 results shape the starting line of Circuit 2 directly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/31b424e473be85946f59751252a640ea40f5d272.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Looking Back at Circuit 1 — The Starting Point of Circuit 2[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4d6a26eb82b7b2626def67d8845c9bbb33a869bf.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]These are the top 12 teams in PGS Points from Circuit 1 — the teams closest to the EWC qualification line heading into Circuit 2. Their performance over the next three weeks will decide who makes the cut: the top 8 teams in cumulative first-half PGS Points earn EWC spots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]What's Changed from Circuit 1 — Game Updates[/h2][p align="start"]The biggest variable in Circuit 2 is the game patch. PGS 4 and PGS 5 run on the April Update (Patch 41.1), which brings several updates that could directly affect team strategy. How Circuit 1's refined approaches hold up in this new environment is the circuit's biggest storyline.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Terrain Destruction Reshapes the Battlefield[/h3][p align="start"]The headline change is a major expansion of terrain destruction.[/p][p align="start"]Erangel now joins Rondo, Taego, Sanhok, and Miramar — meaning terrain itself becomes a tactical layer across all major competitive maps. Pickaxe strikes also dig deeper than before, giving teams new options for cover and route design.[/p][p align="start"]Terrain is no longer a fixed environment, but something players can shape. How new combat patterns emerge through grenades, mortars, Panzerfausts, C4, pickaxes, and vehicle explosions will be a key watchpoint throughout Circuit 2.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Gunplay — New Options and Rebalanced Weapons[/h3][p align="start"]The most notable gunplay change in this patch is the new Hybrid Scope.[/p][p align="start"]The Hybrid Scope switches between 1x and 4x magnification instantly, covering both close- and mid-range fights with a single attachment. It fills the void left by the Canted Sight's removal and should reshape how pros approach attachment choices and engagement distance.[/p][p align="start"]The patch also includes additional new attachments and weapon balancing. Grip-tier changes and recoil adjustments to key weapons are in, so expect teams to revisit their gun setups and combat approach.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Gameplay — New Variables for Supply and Survival[/h3][p align="start"]This patch introduces a new support item (the Emergency Support Flare), expanded Trigger Backpack tiers, and new BlueChip Tower functionality.[/p][p align="start"]The BlueChip Tower changes stand out. Destroying enemy BlueChips to block revives used to be the whole play — now, teams can spend 2 enemy BlueChips at a BlueChip Tower to call in an air supply drop. Enemy BlueChips become a resource instead of just something to remove, and Circuit 2 should showcase far more strategic usage around them.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 2's final series, PGS 6, runs on a version that incorporates the May Update. Details will follow in the May Patch Notes.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Map Order — Adjustments from Circuit 1[/h2][p align="start"]The map pool stays the same as Circuit 1 — Erangel, Miramar, Taego, and Rondo — but the order per stage has changed.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,"][tr][th][p]Stage[/p][/th][th][p]Match 1[/p][/th][th][p]Match 2[/p][/th][th][p]Match 3[/p][/th][th][p]Match 4[/p][/th][th][p]Match 5[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Group Stage (PGS 4)[/p][/td][td][p]Erangel[/p][/td][td][p]Miramar[/p][/td][td][p]Taego[/p][/td][td][p]—[/p][/td][td][p]—[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Winners / Survival / Final D1 / Grand Finals D1·D3[/p][/td][td][p]Erangel[/p][/td][td][p]Miramar[/p][/td][td][p]Taego[/p][/td][td][p]Rondo[/p][/td][td][p]Erangel[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Final D2 / Grand Finals D2[/p][/td][td][p]Taego[/p][/td][td][p]Erangel[/p][/td][td][p]Rondo[/p][/td][td][p]Miramar[/p][/td][td][p]Taego[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][i]*Group Stage runs the same Erangel → Miramar → Taego cycle across all three matchup rounds (A&B, B&C, A&C) for Matches 1 through 9.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Key changes from Circuit 1:[/p][list][*][p]Taego comes in earlier. With Taego in the rotation from the opening matches, team map preferences and prep priorities will shift.[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage and Grand Finals Day 2 have been fully restructured. Different late-game decisive maps mean match flow is harder to read than it was in Circuit 1.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Why Circuit 2 Matters — The Final Battle for EWC Qualification[/h2][p align="start"]Circuit 2's results go beyond the PGS race — they directly determine Esports World Cup (EWC) 2026 qualification.[/p][list][*][p]EWC Qualification — The top 9 teams in cumulative PGS Points from PGS 1-6 earn EWC spots. (2025 EWC champions Twisted Minds hold a separate seed.)[/p][/*][*][p]Circuit 2 is the final stage of the first half — Circuits 3 and 4 run in the second half (August onward), which means EWC qualification locks in the moment Circuit 2 ends.[/p][/*][*][p]The annual PGS Points race continues — Circuit 2 results are also a key foundation for direct qualification to PGC 2026 (top 8 teams).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]For teams holding a Points lead from Circuit 1, Circuit 2 is about defending that position. For the teams chasing, it's a chance to flip the standings. Three weeks from now, the first-half PGS standings are final.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]PGS 6 — Where Points Count Double[/h2][p align="start"]PGS 6 is just another series in Circuit 2, but the scale of PGS Points awarded is different.[/p][list][*][p]Points go to the top 16 teams per series. Teams finishing 17th–24th earn none.[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 4 and PGS 5 award the same points (e.g., 1st = 30 pts each).[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 6 awards double (e.g., 1st = 60 pts). The Series Final week is one of the most important weeks in the PGC race.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the centerpiece of the first-half PGC/EWC race, PGS 6 carries the most weight for Circuit 2's final standings and the annual PGS Points race.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Watch[/h2][p align="start"]All PGS 4-6 matches are broadcast live from 19:00 KST daily on official PUBG Esports channels.[/p][p align="start"]*PGS 4 Day 1 Group Stage begins at 14:00 KST.[/p][list][*][p]PUBG Esports Twitch[/p][/*][*][p]PUBG Esports YouTube[/p][/*][*][p]Regional broadcast partners and co-streamers[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]The 24 teams behind Circuit 1's unpredictable drama are back — new Group Stage draw, new in-game update, same stakes. The final battle for EWC qualification starts Wednesday, May 20. See you there![/p]

title: PUBG Americas Series Finals 1 - Day 3
author: Eoin
contents:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3ff442e156d52480a18699edb94388c0505cc174.png"][/img][/p][p]Following a dramatic Playoffs 1 weekend, we’re gearing up for the first set of PAS1 Finals! Here’s what you need to know about the schedule, format, who’s competing and more. [/p][p align="center"]Finals 1 Participants[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p align="center"]Copenhagen Wolves[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]FURIA[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Athletes of Christ[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]ROC Esports[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Team Falcons[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]TOYO[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Bestia[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Team Liquid[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]No Way[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]+55 E-sports[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Newgen Allstars[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Affinity[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]EUFAREIX10[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Pest Control[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]DUEL[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Rent Free[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[/p][h3]Twitch Drops[/h3][p]The pro players won’t be the only ones who’ll be earning a prize this weekend - you can also score some in-game items just by watching the PAS1 Finals on Twitch! (You can also snag these during the PUBG EMEA Championship strings, which take place about an hour or two before PAS each day)[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]April 24[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Yeet! (Spray)[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Casper The Caster (Emblem)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]April 25[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Victory Dance 93[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Festive Flurry Jeans[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]April 26[/b][/p][list][*][p]Watch 30 minutes of the stream: Victory Dance 74[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 60 minutes of the stream: Festive Flurry Shoes[/p][/*][*][p]Watch 120 minutes of the stream: Festive Flurry Sweater[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Drops will be active on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_battlegrounds"][u]PUBG: Battlegrounds (EN)[/u][/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_br"][u]PUBG: Battlegrounds (PTBR)[/u][/url][/p][p]
[/p][h3]What’s the format?[/h3][p]The PAS1 Finals format is tried and tested - 16 teams will face off over three days, for a total of 15 matches. Whoever has the most points at the end of play on Sunday will be crowned the Finals 1 Champion! [/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]What’s at stake?[/h3][p]The PAS1 Finals are vitally important to any team who wants to compete on the global stage. To start with, the top 2 teams qualify directly to all PUBG Global Series events in the second half of the year (meaning PGS Circuit 2 and 3). [/p][p]Furthermore, PAS1 Finals will be the main events at which Americas teams earn PGC Points, which are used to qualify for the crown jewel of the PUBG Esports year - the PUBG Global Championship. Teams have already had an opportunity to pick up some PGC Points during the Playoffs, but the amount up for grabs is much bigger in the Finals.[/p][p]And last but certainly not least - there is $29,500 of prize money to be earned in each Finals weekend![/p][p]
[/p][h3]Wait… there’s two sets of Finals?[/h3][p]This edition of PAS1 is unique because there are [b]two[/b] sets of Playoffs and Finals. So, once this weekend’s Finals are over, we’ll be going back to the Playoffs stage next weekend with [b]Playoffs 2[/b] - where all 29 teams will start from scratch and try to qualify for Finals 2.[/p][p]

[/p][p]Be sure to tune in on our [url="https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_battlegrounds"][u]Twitch[/u][/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PUBGEsports"][u]YouTube[/u][/url] and [url="https://kick.com/pubgesports"][u]Kick[/u][/url] channels to catch all of the action![/p][p]

title: PUBG Nations Cup 2026 Returns to Seoul, Korea!
author: Eoin
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/60395954cdf1e1477324307bf77537b9be800c17.png[/img]
Hello, PUBG Esports Fans!

The PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026) is returning to Seoul, South Korea, this summer!


24 teams will once again battle across five days of intense competition. With new challenger teams joining the fray, this year's PNC will feature the most diverse lineup in the tournament's history. Get ready for the ultimate all-star showdown in PUBG Esports — PUBG Nations Cup 2026!

[h3]When and Where?[/h3]

PNC 2026 will take place from June 23 to June 28, with the Grand Finals held at Jangchung Arena in Seoul — returning to the venue for the first time in seven years since 2019!

[list]
[*] Survival Stage: June 23 – 24
[*] Grand Finals: June 26 – 28
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/330911f507f51193afc2018aa931fcc5ccd7780d.png[/img]

[h3]PNC 2026 Participating Teams[/h3]

24 teams will compete in this year's tournament.

[list]
[*] Defending Champion: Vietnam
[*] Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, Germany, India, Indonesia, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, South Korea, Thailand, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States of America
[/list]

[i][h3]New Challengers Join the Stage![/h3][/i]

Kazakhstan and Ukraine will make their PUBG Nations Cup debut at PNC 2026! Finland also makes a long-awaited return, last competing at PNC 2022. With new rosters and fresh storylines entering the mix, we can't wait to see how they'll stack up against the established powerhouses!

More details on PNC 2026 — including team rosters, ticket sales, and broadcast information — will be announced through the official PUBG Esports website in the coming weeks. We look forward to seeing you at PUBG Nations Cup 2026!

title: PGS Circuit 1: Meta & Statistics Deepdive
author: Eoin
contents:
[p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p align="start"]From PGS 1 to PGS 3, the first circuit of the 2026 PUBG Global Series has come to a close. With a different champion crowned in every series, the competition was anything but predictable — but what choices were the pros making behind the scenes?[/p][p align="start"]In the end, survival and victory come down to the details. Which guns they ran, which items they used, how they played. Find out in the Esports Data Report: PGS Circuit 1, live now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260420/JLklsRF9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Gun Play: The AUG Era Continues[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The pros made their preference clear. The AUG dominated the AR slot with a 62.5% equip rate — up from 60.2% at PGC 2025, and pulling even further ahead of the pack. With a 44%p gap over the second-place M416 (18.2%), the AUG's place in the pro meta shows no signs of shifting.[/p][p align="start"]In the DMR/SR category, there were signs of change. The MK12 held onto first place at 45.4%, but that's a drop of over 8%p from PGC 2025 (53.6%). The Mini14 stepped into the gap, climbing from 31.5% to 37.5%. SR usage within the DMR/SR category also rose from 4.1% to 5.8% — with DNS_DIEL leading the SR kill charts at 8 kills, followed by AL_Himass and AL_Destroyy tied at 6 kills each. Whether this trend continues into Circuit 2 or gives way to something new remains to be seen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260420/286KIc10.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tactical Equipment: Throw It, Block It, Hide in It[/b][/h3][p align="start"]17Gaming averaged 8.55 grenades per match — by far the highest in the field. Throwing nearly 9 grenades a game isn't just aggression, it's a philosophy. Their Molotov Cocktail usage (1.43 per match) also ranked first. When 17Gaming shows up, expect something to come flying your way.[/p][p align="start"]DN SOOPers took a different approach. Top rankings in both Flashbang (2.96 per match) and Smoke Grenade (11.8 per match) usage tell a clear story: control the vision, control the game. Their playstyle is written right there in the numbers.[/p][p align="start"]Blue Zone Grenade, Emergency Cover Flare — teams across the board found ways to make every piece of tactical equipment count.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260420/T0cGBB31.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Mortar & Panzerfaust: No Longer Optional[/b][/h3][p align="start"]New equipment that felt experimental at PGC 2025 has become a staple in Circuit 1.[/p][p align="start"]Mortar usage more than doubled from 249 to 587 total fires, with hit rate climbing from 16.5% to 18.9%. The pros have moved well past the "trying it out" phase — this is tactical integration. The top Mortar kill count belongs to 17Gaming's tiantianhaovo with 7 kills.[/p][p align="start"]The Panzerfaust told an even more dramatic story. Hit rate jumped from 50.7% to 59.5%, a nearly 9% increase. DN SOOPers' DIEL led all players with 4 Panzerfaust kills — proof that this weapon is now a genuine game-changer in the right hands.[/p][p align="start"]
[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260420/q8VqPUBk.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]PGS Moments: Who Got Got?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]11 players were taken out by BRDMs over the course of Circuit 1. 17Gaming's xwudd accounted for two of those — alone. We can only imagine what his teammates were thinking.[/p][p align="start"]Three players were knocked out by Emergency Cover: 17_tiantianhaovo, VIT_QWZYYY, and DNS_Heaven. Survival isn't just about the enemy — sometimes it's what's around you. Always stay alert![/p][p align="start"]CR_Pio, TE_Clories, TE_TanVuu, PeRo_Cui711, and FUR_zkraken all tied at the top of the Recall leaderboard with 4 each. They kept coming back. Their teammates must have been pretty busy making that happen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260420/K2biRllO.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Circuit 1 Final Records[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Three series, three champions. Petrichor Road took PGS 1 (95pts), Natus Vincere won PGS 2 (93pts), and Virtus.pro closed out the circuit with a dominant PGS 3 victory (136pts).[/p][p align="start"]One name kept appearing in the individual records: NAVI_Hakatory. Most kills (92) and most damage (19,590) — both. If the data had to pick the most dangerous player of Circuit 1, it wouldn't hesitate.[/p][p align="start"]Most Chicken Dinners went to Natus Vincere with 7. And the longest kill of the circuit belonged to VIT_Lev4nte at 831m — the shot that took down NAVI_boost1k- during Match 5 of the PGS 2 Survival Stage. [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]What will the meta look like in Circuit 2?
Stay tuned for the next Esports Data Report: PGS Circuit 2![/p]

[/p][p align="start"][b]Playoffs 1[/b] will kick off this weekend with a brand new format! Over the course of three days, 29 of the best teams across Europe, Middle East & Africa will face off for a chance to qualify to[b] Grand Finals 1![/b][/p][p align="start"]Our new Playoffs format is pretty unique - at the end of each day, the leaderboard is reset and the top teams will qualify directly to the Grand Finals! [/p][p align="start"][b]NAVI & [u][url="http://virtus.pro/"]Virtus.pro[/url][/u][/b][/p][p align="start"]Hot off the heels of winning PGS 2 and PGS 3 respectively, these teams have proven themselves as titans of EMEA on the global stage. But will they be prepared for the chaos of regionals? Better tune in and find out 😎[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"][b]Twisted Minds[/b][/p][p align="start"]As the reigning PEC Champions from 2025, Twisted Minds are no stranger to performing on the regional stage. But this year’s PEC is like none other before; will they adapt to the new format, TPP and more teams than ever before and hold on to their Championship title?

[b]Acend, Bushido Wildcats & S8UL[/b][/p][p align="start"]All three of these teams will be making their 2026 debut at PEC! As invited teams, their status as some of the best in the region is unquestioned; but how will they fare against the teams who had to slog through the qualifying PEC Cups? Only time will tell! It’s also the first time S8UL will be competing in PUBG: Battlegrounds - after picking up the world-class roster of Molodoct, Bestoloch, ADOUZ1E and F1lfirst expectations will no doubt be high.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"][b]Construction Workers[/b][/p][p align="start"]The addition of Pixel1k to the ex-FaZe powerhouse roster has resulted in a dominant performance across most of the PEC Qualifying Cups. We’re excited to see if the team can keep the momentum into the Playoffs and Finals![/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"]Catch all of the action LIVE from 18:00 CEST this weekend![/p]

title: PGS 3: Virtus.pro Caps Off the First Circuit
author: Eoin
contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/50af079e80998745ada6e7669f4389d7149df649.png"][/img][/p][p]From PGS 1 to PGS 3, the three-week journey of the first PGS circuit, where 24 teams battled fiercely, has come to an end.[/p][p align="start"]In the PGS 3 Grand Final, which brought the circuit to a dramatic close, Virtus.pro  claimed the championship with a dominant performance of 89 kills and 136 total points.[/p][p align="start"]This circuit delivered an unpredictable storyline, with the balance of power shifting in every series. PGS 1 champion Petrichor Road, PGS 2 champion Natus Vincere, and now PGS 3 champion Virtus.pro . The fact that three different teams claimed the title across all three series highlights just how fierce the competition was throughout this circuit.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]PGS 3 Recap[/b][/h2][h3][b]Survival Stage[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The bottom 16 teams in the cumulative PGS Points standings played five matches for a place in the Grand Final.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/mBzGNfjC.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]eArena secured its Grand Final berth by finishing first in the Survival Stage with 48 points (26 placement + 22 kills). TEAM LIQUID placed second with 46 points after earning back-to-back Chicken Dinners in Match 2 and Match 3, while Virtus.pro  followed in third with 43 points.[/p][p align="start"]The bottom eight teams — Gen.G Esports, The Expendables, FURIA, Finhay Cerberus, Change The Game, FULL SENSE, Team Falcons, and S2G Esports — were eliminated from PGS Circuit 1.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Grand Final[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The top eight teams in PGS Points and the top eight teams from the Survival Stage, for a total of 16 teams, competed across 15 matches over three days to determine the PGS 3 champion.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/6FkXmrQS.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Virtus.pro  became the PGS 3 champion with 136 points (47 placement + 89 kills), finishing a massive 35 points ahead of second-place eArena (101 points). It was a result few could have predicted, as Virtus.pro  had been eliminated in both PGS 1 and PGS 2 and had not earned a single PGS Point before PGS 3. Their 89 kills ranked first overall in the Grand Final, and with 47 placement points added on top, they proved their strength in both firepower and survivability.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]eArena continued its momentum from the Survival Stage, where it finished first, by taking second place in the Grand Final with 101 points, marking one of the most dramatic rises of Circuit 1. T1 finished third with 93 points, powered by an impressive 68 kills, while Crazy Raccoon climbed seven places to finish fifth with 91 points. PGS 2 champion Natus Vincere ended the event in sixth place with 90 points, but still showed its resilience by securing first place in the overall Circuit 1 PGS Points standings.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/PQVFn2kK.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Virtus.pro ’s Nixzyee was named the PGS 3 Grand Final MVP. Nixzyee led his team to victory with 33 kills, 4,716 damage, and 26 knockdowns in the Grand Final. The MVP also receives an individual prize of $10,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Final PGS Points Standings — PGS Circuit 1 Combined[/b][/h2][h2][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/j1KEQrUm.jpg"][/img][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/QtXuItsU.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The PGS Points from all three series have now been finalized. These points will count toward the annual PGS Points standings and will have a direct impact on qualification for the Esports World Cup (EWC) and direct qualification for the PUBG Global Championship (PGC).[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Team Highlights — Teams That Shined in Circuit 1[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/8EHXbWGn.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Virtus.pro[/b]  — PGS 3 champion. Finished 19th in PGS 1 (eliminated), was eliminated in PGS 2, and had 0 PGS Points entering PGS 3. After advancing through the Survival Stage and reaching the Grand Final, the team delivered a dominant championship run with 89 kills and 136 points, finishing 35 points ahead of second place. Nixzyee’s MVP performance (33 kills, 4,716 damage, 26 knockdowns) perfectly symbolized the team’s PGS 3 run. Virtus.pro  also ranked first in total prize earnings for Circuit 1 with $102,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Natus Vincere[/b] — Finished first in cumulative PGS Points with 69 points. From sixth place in PGS 1 (13 points), to a dramatic comeback title in PGS 2 (30 points), to sixth place in the PGS 3 Grand Final (26 points), the team consistently earned points across all three series and claimed the top spot in the overall Circuit 1 points race. It was a case where consistency at the top mattered more than a single explosive result.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/s0Qd1NRx.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]eArena[/b] — The team that showed the most dramatic growth curve in Circuit 1. After finishing 16th in PGS 1 (1 point) and remaining in the lower ranks in PGS 2 (4 points), eArena surged to first place in the PGS 3 Survival Stage and then second place in the Grand Final (101 points), achieving its best result of the tournament. The team finished fifth overall in Circuit 1 with 53 points and earned a total of $52,000, emerging as a new powerhouse from the APAC region.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/vdgqdTDV.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]Crazy Raccoon[/b] — Like eArena, Crazy Raccoon was one of the breakout teams of PGS 3. After being eliminated in PGS 1 (0 points) and finishing 15th in PGS 2 (1 point), the team had little presence in the earlier stages of the circuit. But in the PGS 3 Grand Final, it climbed seven places to finish fifth with 91 points and 30 PGS Points. That single-event performance brought the team to 11th place overall with 31 points.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/dAfyX0XF.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]T1[/b] — A team that best illustrated the benefits of the circuit structure. T1 finished fifth in PGS 1 with 15 points, but was eliminated in PGS 2 and earned no points there. Even so, its PGS 1 points were enough to send the team directly to the PGS 3 Grand Final, where it secured third place with 93 points and 40 PGS Points, finishing Circuit 1 in fourth overall with 55 points.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/PZ7pmkrq.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]Petrichor Road[/b] — PGS 1 champion (30 points) and second in the overall Circuit 1 PGS Points standings with 68 points. Although the team’s placement declined over the course of the series (PGS 1: 1st → PGS 2: 3rd → PGS 3: 8th), its steady point accumulation across all three events stood out. The points built up in PGS 1 and PGS 2 ultimately carried Petrichor Road to second place overall in Circuit 1.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Player of the Day — PGS 3[/b][/h2][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/qwMV2Khv.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]By fan vote, the Player of the Day for PGS 3 is MMing from Petrichor Road![/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/82jD9nRO.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/8ka5YBaf.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h1][b]Circuit 1 Total Prize Pool[/b][/h1][p align="start"]The $500,000 total prize pool for Circuit 1 (PGS 1–3) has now been fully distributed![/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/0ew50G8i.jpg"][/img][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260409/WMz7PN6L.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][/h1][h1][b]Looking Back on Circuit 1[/b][/h1][p align="start"]Three weeks of Circuit 1 showed what the new circuit format can produce.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Three series, three different champions — Petrichor Road (PGS 1), Natus Vincere (PGS 2), Virtus.pro  (PGS 3). The top of the standings changed every single week.[/p][p align="start"]PGS 3 comebacks — Virtus.pro  went from 0 PGS Points through PGS 1–2 to PGS 3 Champion, while eArena and Crazy Raccoon surged from the bottom half into the upper ranks.[/p][p align="start"]The power of cumulative points — PGS Points leader Natus Vincere (69 pts) earned their position not from a single dominant series, but through consistent results across all three. T1's PGS 1 points alone carried them into the PGS 3 Grand Finals — proof that the circuit structure rewards sustained performance.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Thank you to every fan who followed along for the past three weeks. The second circuit of the PUBG Global Series returns in May. The 2026 season is just getting started — with three more circuits, Regional Series, the Esports World Cup, and the PUBG Global Championship still to come, the PUBG Esports journey continues![/p]

title: New Mode: Xeno Point
author: haejun.yang
contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0c0444b55cf737fa5c8229cf955a3208f9a38651.png"][/img]Mysterious threat has emerged in the once peaceful Miramar. An unidentified alien vessel, the “Construct,” has torn through the sky, unleashing unknown entities that now overrun the battleground. Join the all-new cooperative PvE mode, Xeno Point, now available in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, and fight to reclaim Miramar. You are the only ones who can stop this invasion. Prepare for battle with your team and make your way to the Mothership.[/p][p] [/p][h2]General Flow[/h2][p]Welcome to Xeno Point. Your mission is simple: Fight back against the enemy invading Miramar!
Reach the Mothership and defeat the Architect before time runs out. 
Go to Play > Arcade > Xeno Point to enter and start matchmaking.

[/p][h3]HUB[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/316597162fd8efe6218295392863a9cdb3b8eac5.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Each session begins in the HUB. Enter through the open doors and eliminate enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]After clearing the sector beyond the door, your team will return to the HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]On Normal difficulty, successfully returning to the HUB unlocks additional sectors that were previously unavailable. Decide as a team which sector to tackle next.[/p][/*][*][p]On Hard and Impossible difficulties, all doors, except for the Tier 4 boss sector, are open from the start.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Missions[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8dac82b99024f1793eea5b803289ad3e2253549e.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Complete a series of objectives while fighting waves of Xenos.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete missions to unlock sector doors. Missions become progressively harder across sectors.[/p][/*][*][p]When a player dies, all progress resets except for Supers, Blue Chip Skills, and unspent Fragments and Skill Points.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Work Together[/h3][list][*][p]The team can view each member's vital stats, equipment tier, Supers, and more. [/p][/*][*][p]Use this information to plan your strategy effectively. Share key items, equip different Supers within the team, and revive downed teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]Teammates can be revived at any time, but the team fails if all members are downed.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Craft and Upgrade Supers[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/680249413fff9edc002d5d0edc693ae96641aadc.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Supers are powerful abilities that recharge over time. Some Supers are stronger when used together. Coordinate with your team to discover powerful combinations. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5b58f38a0f59680bc7232949afde06c0960d63d1.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Players can craft and upgrade Supers using Fragments at the Crafting Station in HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]After completing a full set, Supers can be further upgraded. [/p][list][*][p]An available Super is selected at random when crafting or upgrading.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Purchase Blue Chip Skills[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d57177a353caf001c082d7d18743f78caa22d79d.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Blue Chip Skills provide stat boosts and combat bonuses. [/p][/*][*][p]Players can purchase and refund Blue Chip Skills using Skill points at the Crafting Station in HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlike Supers, these skills can be refunded, allowing players to freely adjust their Skill Tree.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Difficulty[/h3][list][*][p]Difficulty is divided into three levels: Normal, Hard, and Impossible.[/p][/*][*][p]After defeating the boss on the previous difficulty, purchase the Difficulty Amplifier Skill to access higher difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher difficulties increase the chance of obtaining higher-tier equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]All team members must purchase the Difficulty Amplifier to advance to the next difficulty.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Resources[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b54295081b66d15de68e9c30588c0557595c9b9a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Kill enemies and complete missions to earn Skill Points, Fragments, and unique gear with extra abilities. [/p][list][*][p]The signature weapon of Xeno Point, the “Xeno Cannon,” deals significantly increased damage to enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]The Xeno Cannon is a powerful weapon that uses exclusive ammo. More ammo can be obtained from the Sector Commander and Fabricators.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Higher-tier equipment, including weapons, comes with unique perks. [/p][/*][*][p]Playing on higher-tier maps and difficulties rewards better loot.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Boss[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/39eb0c81dbbe3abfed94b8f4a6396ff493a8dcba.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The final objective of each sector. Defeat the powerful Sector Commander that appears at the end of the sector.[/p][/*][*][p]Each boss and enemy has a unique weakness. Work together with your team to use the right weapons and Supers, and strike when their weakness is exposed.[/p][/*][*][p]Your ultimate goal is to reach the boss sector, the Mothership, where you must defeat the Architect leading the invasion.  [/p][/*][/list][h2]Mode Settings[/h2][list][*][p]Map: Miramar[/p][/*][*][p]Perspective: TPP[/p][/*][*][p]4-Man Squads[/p][list][*][p]Teams consist of up to 4 players.[/p][/*][*][p]You can form a team in advance before starting matchmaking.[/p][list][*][p]Solo play is available, but matchmaking is not supported if your team is not full.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty is fixed to squad-level regardless of team size.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Teamkill is disabled.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Notes[/h2][list][*][p](PC) You can check your Total Score rankings (Fragments + Skill Points) and play records on the Bridge website under the “Ranking” tab.[/p][list][*][p]PUBG Bridge Link: [url="https://bridge.pubg.com/"]https://bridge.pubg.com/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Rankings and records will remain available on the website even after the Xeno Point mode ends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Does not provide XP or gameplay rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Will not be reflected in your Match History.[/p][/*][*][p] Will not be reflected on the Career page.[/p][/*][*][p] Does not support replays. 
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Service Period (UTC)[/h2][list][*][p]PC : April 8, after live server maintenance - May 6, 07:00[/p][/*][*][p]Console : April 16,  after live server maintenance - May 14, 07:00 [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Event Pass: Xeno Point[/h2][p]Fight back the Xeno invasion! Defend the Battlegrounds, loot gear, and defeat enemies with the Event Pass: Xeno Point.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2af402c945f735444892af8d61d614dc4661fa04.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Items List[/h3][list][*][p]Event Pass: Xeno Point ($3.99)[/p][/*][*][p]1 Level (100 G-Coin) [/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3]Sales Period (UTC)[/h3][list][*][p]PC: April 8, after live server maintenance - May 6, 07:00[/p][/*][*][p]Console: April 16, after live server maintenance - May 14, 07:00 [/p][/*][/list][p]
Now, stop the invasion and survive until the very end.
See you in Xeno Point.
