[h2]Live Server Updates
[/h2]- After closely analyzing the player metrics after the XP balance adjustment of the Survivor Pass in Update #23.1, we felt that the leveling experience didn't go as smoothly as intended. Therefore, an additional adjustment was made to the Survivor Pass system to further enhance the leveling experience: the XP gained through weekly missions has been increased.
- Fixed the issue that prevented the appearance of Sunset weather in Erangel.
- Fixed the issue in War Mode: Conquest mode where players fell beneath the terrain when the map is set to Ruins in Sanhok.
- Fixed the clipping issue in the chest area when a male character equips the Greenback Suit.
- Fixed the clipping issue at the wrist when equipping Bunny Academy Hazard Gloves with the Greenback Suit.
- Fixed the issue where some detail elements of Julie's Infiltrator Shorts disappear when certain outerwear are equipped with the shorts.
- In the English language setting, we've fixed the inconsistency of uppercase and lowercase letters in Match History - Casual Mode.


[h2]Map Service
[/h2][i]※ Please note that PC players can anticipate map changes every Wednesday at 2 AM UTC, while Console players can expect the same every Thursday at 7 AM UTC.
※ In Random Map regions, each map will have an equal probability of being selected, with a probability of 20%.[/i]

[u][b](PC) Test Server
[/b][/u][b]Normal Match: Miramar / Vikendi
[/b]AS region: Squad - TPP
NA region: Squad - FPP


[u][b]Live Server - Normal Match
[/b][/u][b]Week 1: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Karakin
[/b]PC: June 14 ~ June 21
Console: June 22 ~ June 29

[b]Week 2: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Paramo
[/b]PC: June 21 ~ June 28
Console: June 29 ~ July 6

[b]Week 3: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Karakin
[/b]PC: June 28 ~ July 5
Console: July 6 ~ July 13

[b]Week 4: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Paramo
[/b]PC: July 5 ~ July 12
Console: July 13 ~ July 20


[u][b]Live Server - Ranked
[/b][/u][b]- Deston has been replaced with Vikendi in the map pool.[/b]
- Ranked: Erangel (30%) / Miramar (30%) / Taego (30%) / Vikendi (10%)
- The map service for Ranked is updated on a season-by-season basis.


[i][b]※ Please note that the features and updates described below are subject to change or removal due to issues such as bugs, in-game problems, and community feedback. The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.
[/b][/i]

[h2]Tactical Gear
[/h2]We're turning Tactical Gear into essential items by bestowing them a new purpose, enhancing their significance beyond consumable options. Experience the game in a multitude of ways with this update, whether playing individually or as part of a team. From beginners to veterans, the renewed Tactical Gear can foster a sense of achievement among all players by enabling them to contribute to the success of their squad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c3eb8a91d4252ea8029d2e7cfc2fc8b7c87b03b6.jpg[/img]
[i][b]﻿※ This update applies to only Normal Matches, Intense Battle Royale mode, and Custom Matches (Normal Match, Intense Battle Royale).
[/b][/i]
- Players will be equipped with a [b]Tactical Gear Carrier[/b] in their Inventory at the start of each match.
ㅤ- To ensure the Carrier does not hinder initial game progress after landing, we've set the Tactical Gear Carrier weight to 0.

- Open the Carrier to select your desired Tactical Gear from all available options - EMT Gear, Tactical Pack, Spotter Scope, Drone, Blue Chip Detector, or the Repair Kit.
ㅤ- The Carrier cannot be opened when you're in a vehicle or on top of static transport features such as trains and ships.

- The selected Tactical Gear will be fitted into a dedicated sixth slot reserved for Tactical Gear.

- Once equipped, the Tactical Gear cannot be removed.

- Tactical Gear nor the Carrier will not be dropped when a player dies. Upon a player's death the Tactical Gear/Tactical Gear Carrier are removed.

- Players recalled to the match will not be provided a new Tactical Gear Carrier.

- All world-spawned Tactical Gear has been removed.

- Radio Message
ㅤ- Can be used to relay information about the selected Tactical Gear of team members.
ㅤ- Upon equipping a Tactical Gear, a Radio Message is triggered for notification.
[i]ㅤㅤ- "Equipping (Tactical Gear)".
[/i]
- Training Mode
ㅤ- Players can remove Tactical Gear from their sixth Inventory slot in Training Mode only to allow for more diverse practice.
ㅤ- Both Tactical Gear and the Tactical Gear Carrier are provided via the Training Helper.


[b]We also strive to maintain the fundamental system of Tactical Gear while rebalancing their overall stats this update as Tactical Gear have changed to a basic, required item for all:
[/b]

[b][h3]EMT Gear[/h3]
[/b]To primarily serve the purpose of team healing rather than self-healing, the healing feature will only apply to team members. Additionally, to balance the overly beneficial healing effects when using heal items, the usage time of heal items has been adjusted to the following:
- Med Kit usage time: 3 seconds → 7 seconds.
- First Aid Kit usage time: 3 seconds → 5 seconds.
- In addition, the revival speed of teammates has been changed from 3 seconds → 8 seconds to prevent overly quick recoveries in tense scenarios.
- Using Energy Drinks or Painkillers will now provide a 50% additional effect.
ㅤ- This boost will only be for personal use and does not apply to teammates.

[b][h3]Tactical Pack[/h3]
[/b]- Attachment slots decreased from 4 slots → 2 slots.
- We wish to give the Tactical Pack a similar feel to a Level 4 Backpack. Therefore, the reduction of slots is aimed at moderating the possession of individual items such as firearms (excluding stackable items).

[b][h3]Spotter Scope[/h3]
[/b]Improved for more straightforward and less time-consuming use.
- Its magnification capabilities are now adjustable from 4x to 8x, allowing for more detailed observations.
[b]- The creation of the white passive marker is removed. The red active marker will be automatically created and maintained for 7 seconds after a scan.
[/b]- The standard Screen Pings can also be placed while using the Spotter Scope.

[b][h3]Drone[/h3]
[/b]- Maximum range has been reduced from 300m → 200m.

[b][h3]Blue Chip Detector[/h3]
[/b]The Blue Chip Detector has been perceived as an overperforming gear. Therefore, it has been decided to receive several adjustments to harmonize it with other Tactical Gear.
- Screen update frequency: 5 seconds → 8 seconds.
- Enemy scan radius: 100m → 50m.
[b]- Players who are equipped with a Jammer Pack are undetectable with the Blue Chip Detector.
[/b]
﻿-
[i]< Dev's Comment >

Following the initial introduction of Tactical Gear, we have observed their considerable utility in gameplay. However, we also understand the magnitude of the decision players are faced with in sacrificing a primary weapon slot for Tactical Gear, particularly in battle scenarios where mid-to-long range combat is crucial. As such, with the renewal of the Tactical Gear system, we eagerly anticipate witnessing our players' varied gameplay strategies!

For example, for solo play, we look forward to see players utilizing a strategy centered around their chosen Tactical Gear, which you'd select to complement your primary weapon. You may opt for a slow-burn approach with the EMT Gear, spending more time looting and gradually entering the Safe Zone. The Drone and Blue Chip Detector can help with a strategy that involves quick penetration of the center area, swiftly identifying incoming enemies. And the Tactical Pack could suit those favoring weapons with high ammo consumption. As for the Spotter Scope, it may be ideal for players selecting weapons aimed at precise long-distance engagement.

As for team play, we anticipate strategic looting that aligns with team dynamics while avoiding overlapping roles. Each teammate would have a distinct role, contributing effectively to the team's primary goal. Utilize the Drone and Spotter Scope for ordering and coordination. Or the Spotter Scope could enhance accuracy for those sharpshooters. The EMT Gear and Tactical Pack may also be helpful to novice players, so they could actively contribute to team survival, or even the Blue Chip Detector for optimal information delivery.

With this change, we are also committed to implementing constraints that are proportional to in-game performance - we do not aim to unfairly boost the abilities of already-skilled players. With this in mind, we've made it so that once a Tactical Gear is selected, it becomes irreplaceable. Players are required to use their chosen equipment consistently throughout the match. We have also proceeded with an overall balance update.[/i]
﻿-

[h2]Items[/h2]
[h3]Tactical Gear - Repair Kit
[/h3]The current Helmet/Armor Repair Kits and Mechanic's Toolbox seemed to have limited applications in specific circumstances - therefore, we're [b]merging them into a single versatile Repair Kit[/b] that can repair Helmets, Vests, and vehicles. With this multipurpose tool, you can now consider the possibility of pursuing the role of your team's go-to mechanic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/09af229140d853302717aeaf90d936a000de6701.jpg[/img]
[i][b]﻿※ This update applies to only Normal Matches, Intense Battle Royale mode, and Custom Matches (Normal Match, Intense Battle Royale).
[/b][/i]
- The Repair Kit is no longer a consumable, and is now a part of Tactical Gear that can be equipped to your Tactical Gear slot.
ㅤ- Once equipped, it cannot be replaced or removed until the match concludes.

- The Repair Kit can be utilized up to 10 times.

- You can use the Repair Kit via the Limited Interact key.

- [b]A single use on a Helmet or Vest[/b] will restore its durability to 100 in 6 seconds.
ㅤ- You can repair not just your own Helmet/Vest, but those equipped by your teammates or those found lying on the floor.

- [b]A single use on a vehicle[/b] restores 500 durability in 8 seconds.
ㅤ- You are only able to repair[b] a vehicle that can be interacted with[/b].

- The repair process will be canceled under the following circumstances:
ㅤ- If the character carrying out the repair, or the subject undergoing the repair, moves using the movement keys.
ㅤ- Once the preceding repair of the same Helmet/Vest/vehicle is complete.
ㅤ- If another player picks up the Helmet/Vest from the ground during the repair.

[b]- New feature: Removing and installing tires
[/b]ㅤ- When the Repair Kit is equipped, you can use the Limited Interact Key to remove tires from any vehicle.
ㅤㅤ- Tires that have burst with 0 durability cannot be removed.
ㅤㅤ- Interacting with a vehicle will display the remaining durability of the tire.
ㅤ- Removing a tire requires a certain amount of time.
ㅤ- Successful removal causes the tire to drop to the ground.
ㅤㅤ- Tires weigh 20 each.
ㅤㅤ- Tires will go to your Inventory's fourth melee weapon slot.
ㅤㅤㅤ- If the fourth slot is occupied, the tire will move to the Inventory.
ㅤㅤㅤ- Swapping to the weapon in the fourth slot will result in your character holding the tire.
ㅤㅤ- You [b]cannot[/b] remove or install tires to the BRDM, Boat, Aquarail, Mountain Bike, Motor Glider, Airboat, or Snowmobile.
ㅤ- Any player can install removed tires on a vehicle, even without a Repair Kit.
ㅤㅤ- Upon approaching a vehicle without a tire, tire installation requires a certain amount of time.
ㅤㅤ- The removal/installation process will be canceled under the following circumstances:
ㅤㅤㅤ- If the vehicle is driven during the installation process.
ㅤㅤㅤ- If the position of the vehicle changes due to a collision or other during the installation process.
ㅤㅤㅤ- If another tire on the vehicle during tire removal receives damage.

- The existing Helmet/Armor Repair Kits and Mechanic's Toolbox have been removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1ba5dfb1a3ff23dd8f5d28695f3a985a4f4cfbe2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Emergency Pickup, BZ Grenade, Jammer Pack, Mortar, and Panzerfaust
[/h3]- Will now world spawn in all 8x8 maps.
- This applies to Normal, Ranked, and Custom Matches (including Esports mode).
- The spawn rate of the Emergency Pickup in both Normal Match and Ranked on Erangel and Miramar maps has been reduced by 30%.


[h2]World - Vikendi
[/h2]After the Vikendi Reborn update last year, we've diligently monitored player trends and incorporated your valuable feedback into the latest update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5c55d203c65a543eb343b2cc3a14326c6ae915f7.jpg[/img]
[h3]Terrain
[/h3]We have tactically upgraded those locations - excluding major cities - that, according to live data, have proven to be the most unfeasible for engagement or where cover was particularly scarce by adding new objects and ridgelines, offering more opportunities for strategic cover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d74e3f30e2a9615dbc5aa52e85eb3bbb3c20d177.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e9c707ca89ad07833daf85f98bcbcbc16c223340.jpg[/img]
[h3]Phase[/h3]
The initiative Blue Zone ruleset similar as Ranked's for Normal Matches introduced back in Update #23.1 has been applied to Vikendi, effectively reducing the overall playtime.

[h3]Item spawn
[/h3]Vikendi's Normal Matches typically feature an array of special item spawn spots, leading to an excess of high-value items. To prevent disproportionate looting of these items, we've recalibrated the balance. The spawn rates of high-value weapons and items have been scaled down to also mitigate the disparity in the play experience with Ranked matches.

- Lab Camp
ㅤ- The probability of finding lucky Supply Drops (holding Care Package weapons) have been boosted.
ㅤㅤ- However, a marginal downgrade has been made in the quality of items.
ㅤㅤ- A significant reduction has been made in the appearance rate of Care Package weapons and Level 3 equipment.
ㅤ- Critical Response Kits will now exclusively appear in Lab Camps, with an increased spawn rate.

- Caves
ㅤ- The quantity and quality of items discoverable in caves' Supply Drops have been downgraded.
ㅤㅤ- A significant reduction has been made in the appearance rate of Care Package weapons and Level 3 equipment.
ㅤㅤ- 8x Scopes, Critical Response Kits, and C4 have been removed from caves' Supply Drops.

- Secret Room
ㅤ- Acquisition of the Self-AED is now restricted to Secret Rooms, except for the rare chance of looting it as a world spawn item.

- The Thermal 4x Scope will now only be available as a world spawn item, in Care Packages, and caves' Supply Drops. It has been removed from Lab Camp and Secret Rooms.

- The following changes have also been made to align with the ruleset of other maps.
ㅤ- ARs, SMGs, Handguns, Crossbows, Grenades, Smoke Grenades, Stun Grenades, and First Aid Kits will spawn slightly more.
ㅤ- SRs, LMGs, Backpack (Level 1), Molotovs, BZ Grenades, C4, Emergency Pickups, Bandages, Med Kits, and Adrenaline Syringes will spawn slightly less.

[h3]Vehicle spawn
[/h3]In terms of transportation, we noted that vehicle usage in Vikendi was lower compared to other maps, so we've amplified vehicle spawn spots and appropriately adjusted existing spawn locations.

[h3]Blizzard Zone
[/h3]- The duration of the Blizzard Zone has been increased by approximately 70%.
- The number of snowstorms appearing in a Blizzard Zone has increased.
- The distance between snowstorms has decreased.
- The phases when Blizzard Zones occur during a match have been adjusted.

[h3]Cable Car
[/h3]- Player feedback concerning the rather sluggish speed of Vikendi's Cable Cars was noted, leading to a significant speed enhancement. This adjustment now allows for better encounters during transit, with an overall speed increase of 80%.

[h3]Comeback BR[/h3]
- Map
ㅤ- We have improved player's vulnerability by relocating existing objects to the back.
ㅤ- Item spawn spots have been added near player spawn locations for an optimized start.
ㅤ- Made containers more accessible by repositioning some containers and adding wooden pallets.
- Combat Time
ㅤ- Reduced combat time from 160 seconds to 100 seconds.
ㅤ- The Play Area restriction time has been adjusted to accommodate the reduced combat time.
- The multidrops will descend earlier.
- To prevent the decreasing survival rate as the number of participants increases during the later phases of Comeback BR, each size of the final Play Area for each phase has been adjusted.
- The UI notifications for Comeback BR have improved.

[h3]Crowbar Interaction
[/h3]- Increased spawn rate for cabinets.
- A storage unit specifically designed for Crowbars has been added to garages that are accessible with a Crowbar. This storage unit has a high probability of containing a Crowbar.
- Simultaneously, we've slightly diminished the appearance rate for Secret Room Security Keys.
ㅤ- However, we've increased the spawn rates for items such as healing items and throwables.

[h3]Sound[/h3]
Reduced the volume of wind turbines by 40%, along with the audible range.

[h3]Minimap[/h3]
Minimap has been updated to mirror the above changes.


[h2]﻿﻿Ranked - Season 24[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7ffd1e9d45def362d1dfcc12f38a3d7361e3052e.jpg[/img]
- The Jammer Pack, Mortar, Panzerfaust, BZ Grenade, and Emergency Pickup have been added to every map.
- [b]Vikendi has been added to the map pool with a 10% matchmaking probability.[/b]
ㅤ- Number of players: 64
ㅤ- Weather: Sunny
ㅤ- The Blizzard Zone, Lab Camp, Crowbar interaction feature and cabinets, Cable Cars, bears, and Supply Drops are available.
ㅤㅤ- Weapons only available in Care Packages have been removed from Lab Camp and Supply Drops.
ㅤ- Comeback BR, Security Keys, Thermal 4x Scope are not available.
ㅤ- High-tier items have generally decreased.
ㅤ- BRDM vehicles can not be called with a Flare Gun from outside the circle.
- The leaderboard will reset after the Live Server maintenance.
- Check out your final Tier from the previous season through your Career page.
﻿[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/137586273f6209de916227d9e6f8a75049c0715f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Season 23 Rewards
[/h3]Below are the rewards you'll be receiving based on your final Tier from the previous Ranked season.
ㅤㅤ[b]Bronze [/b]- Bronze PUBG ID Emblem
ㅤㅤ[b]Silver [/b]- Silver PUBG ID Emblem
ㅤㅤ[b]Gold [/b]- Gold PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin
ㅤㅤ[b]Platinum [/b]- Animated Platinum PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum Medal
ㅤㅤ[b]Diamond [/b]- Animated Diamond PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum, Diamond Medal
ㅤㅤ[b]Master [/b]- Animated Master PUBG ID Emblem, Animated Master Nameplate, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum, Diamond, Master Medal
[b]ㅤㅤTop 500[/b] - Bonus rewards for Top 500 players: Animated Top 500 PUBG ID Emblem, Animated Top 500 Nameplate

- The Parachute skin and Medals are permanent rewards.
- The rest of the obtainable rewards are available for use during a single Ranked season.
- Rewards can be found in your Inventory once Season 24 starts.
- Once Season 24 is over and the server undergoes maintenance, every reward but the Parachute and Medal will be withdrawn from your Edit Profile page.

﻿
[h2]Custom Match
[/h2]- On/off option for the Tactical Gear Carrier has been added.
- Helmet Repair Kit, Armor Repair Kit, and Mechanic's Toolbox have been removed from the Spawn tab.
- World-spawn Tactical Gear have been removed from the Spawn tab.
- On/off option for the Recall system has been added.
ㅤ- When the Recall system is off, both the Blue Chip Tower and Blue Chips will not spawn and the Blue Chip Transmitter can not be used.
- The Blue Chip Transmitter has been added to the Spawn tab.
- The phase settings in [b]World - Vikendi[/b] above have been applied to Custom Match - Vikendi.
- Esports Mode
ㅤ- Vikendi has been added.
ㅤ- The number of players in a team has been changed to 10.
ㅤ- A setting option for the Blue Zone has been added.
﻿
﻿
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
We've observed that requiring new players to complete AI Training Match was impacting the engagement of new players in Normal Matches. Therefore, after successfully finishing Basic Training, players will now have the ability to play Normal Matches right away even without having to complete AI Training Matches.


[h2]﻿﻿Survivor Pass: Splash Royale[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/401b00a0fb13fe3025bc4d7b94e894772f20717f.jpg[/img]
A new Survivor Pass: Splash Royale is prepared for the approaching hottest season of the year. Read more details on the upcoming June Store Update announcement!

﻿
[h2]Workshop[/h2]
[h3]Chest
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7d6f17bdd401ddfb725d5778d5a40366ce5747ed.png[/img]
New item sets have been added to the Hunter's Chest and Archivist's Chest.
- Survivor Pass: Vikendi Reborn

﻿
[h2]Performance[/h2]
Implemented enhancements to our memory management system, resulting in a reduction of hitches experienced during gameplay.


[h2]﻿﻿Bug Fixes
[/h2]﻿[h3]Gameplay
[/h3]- General in-game bugs have been fixed.
- Fixed the issue where an extra timer was generated upon completion of a team member's heal using the EMT Gear.

[h3]World[/h3]
- Fixed collision, texture, performance, and some other general Vikendi map issues.
- Fixed the issue where the Self-AED was not appearing in Taego's breakable pots.
- Fixed the issue where certain heal items were not spawning on the bridges of Erangel.

[h3]UX/UI
[/h3]- Fixed the issue where the Clan Tag was being displayed in specific in-game areas when the Clan level was at 1.
- Fixed the issue where the kill/assist details were not displayed upon accessing the Inventory in-game.
- (Console) Fixed the issue where the "Played with" information was not displayed upon returning to the Social page after viewing a random player's profile from the Recent Players list.

title: Dev Letter: Illegal Software - Terrain Passing Function
author: [****] UZI
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/778087a5856f08f920b5ab7b553edb701fc702cf.png[/img]

Hello players.

Among the functions of illegal software that undermine a fair gaming environment, there are functions that also induce visual discomfort. In today's Dev Letter, we intend to discuss the countermeasures we have taken and our future plans regarding the illegal software function known as the "terrain passing function," which allows characters or vehicles to pass through physical boundaries and objects.

[h2][b]Illegal Software - Terrain Passing Function[/b][/h2]

The terrain passing function of illegal software grants cheaters an unfair advantage in the game by enabling them to pass through physical boundaries like doors, walls, and rocks that are impassable under normal circumstances. This function significantly disrupts gameplay and also leads to visual discomfort. When cheaters exploit this function to infiltrate objects and attack unsuspecting players outside, the targeted players feel helpless and vulnerable, akin to being attacked by an invisible man. Witnessing cheaters effortlessly pass through objects understandably evokes strong displeasure among other players.

Due to its conspicuous nature, the terrain passing function has been reported by numerous players. Recognizing its detrimental impact on game fairness, the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team has undertaken various endeavors to combat it. To be precise, two distinct measures were implemented from a game design perspective. Firstly, defensive measures were put in place to rectify instances where characters or vehicles were positioned abnormally, returning them to normal positions. Secondly, verification logic was incorporated to address cases of players shooting from inside the terrain towards targets outside. In addition to this, we would like to share the latest improvements we have made concerning the implementation of the terrain passing function, as well as our accomplishments and future plans.

The implementation of the terrain passing function can be primarily categorized into two methods: code tampering and data tampering.

Code tampering method refers to modifying the game's code so that one can pass through terrain that is typically impassable. Although PUBG's own anti-cheat solution, Zakynthos, already includes a feature that detects whether the code has been tampered with, there were limitations imposed on this feature to ensure optimal gameplay performance for players.

Data tampering method involves manipulating the game's data related to collision to allow players to pass through normally impassable terrain. While there is a data verification logic for vehicles and characters, not every instance of tampering could be verified, as this data can be altered even under normal circumstances.

Nonetheless, despite the realistic restrictions and limitations, our dedication to combating illegal software remains unwavering. We promptly initiated a search for solutions and opportunities for improvement.

[h2][b]Past Achievements and Future Plans[/b][/h2]

To begin with, we addressed the code tampering method by enhancing Zakynthos' code modulation detection feature. We developed an improved mechanism that efficiently detects tampering without impacting players' gaming performance, and implemented it in March 2023. As a result, the number of accounts identified as engaging in code tampering increased by approximately threefold compared to the previous period, leading to an 81% decrease in the number of illegal software providing the terrain passing function. Furthermore, since March of this year, we have observed a significant reduction (approximately 83%) in community reports from players concerning cheaters exploiting the terrain passing function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54b9f6099da5ea61aa4bc733e46b9f0e33faf8e1.jpg[/img]

As depicted in the graph above, notable achievements have been accomplished. Nevertheless, there are still hurdles to overcome in order to completely eradicate the terrain passing function. In addition to consistently addressing the code tampering method previously discussed, enhancing the verification logic for the data tampering method is also necessary. Currently, the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team is diligently working on refining the logic and expects to implement fortified measures against the data tampering method in the near future.

Furthermore, alongside counteracting the terrain passing function discussed today, the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team remains dedicated to advancing machine learning technology and anti-cheat measures, while simultaneously conducting real-time monitoring of ongoing matches.

We acknowledge that individual reports may not hold significant weight from a player's perspective, but the reports we receive greatly contribute to validating our anti-cheat efforts. By working together to thwart those who deteriorate the gaming environment, we firmly believe we can foster a fairer PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS experience. We kindly urge you to continue actively reporting cheaters. Stay tuned for our next topic!


Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: Clan Emblem Workshop
author: [****] UZI
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/aaa4a7110fd0f0c18cd5ae5ce09ed47101108e4c.png[/img]
Hello players!

We've recently added an exciting update to the game - the Clan system. This presents a fantastic opportunity for players from around the globe to create communities and find new friends to play PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS with.

So, what will your clan look like if you decide to create one? Creating a clan is not as easy as it sounds. It involves making decisions about a cool name and tag, among other things. Of course, if you're creative enough it might not even be an issue for you.

Anyway! Before diving into the world of clans, it might be a good idea to take a moment to express your clan's identity and try creating an emblem. 

[h2][b]Show off your Clan![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=r2vZcy08AGE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]*Please note that the clan names, tags, emblems, and other content created through the following website are not linked to your game account in any way.[/b]

Using the tools provided on our new [b][url=http://pubgclanemblem.com/]website[/url][/b], you can create an appearance of your unique Clan. The possibilities for Clan names, Tags, and Emblem design are truly diverse, so go ahead and try creating a visual representation of your perfect Clan!

If you are currently managing or planning to start an actual Clan, you can also share the Clan Emblem you created through the website and share it to your social channels.  We look forward to seeing the diverse and impressive clan emblems you create through the website!

[h2][b]Step-by-Step Guide [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5f45f83ebdceead1fff956a28f9b8762c541074c.png[/img]
So how about we start creating a Clan Emblem? 
[list]
[*] Step 1. Access [b][url=http://pubgclanemblem.com]http://pubgclanemblem.com[/url][/b]
[*] Step 2. Enter your Clan Tag.
[*] Step 3. Decorate your Clan Emblem (Choose a design, Sticker, Clan Name, etc.).
[*] Step 4. Save your Clan Emblem as an image.
[*] Step 5. Share your Clan Emblem to recruit new clan members!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4fac9726ebfb9fb901c20897d3014f7032e26c22.png[/img]

[h2][b]Website Service Schedule[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] PDT: May 17, 2023, 12:00 AM - April 30, 2024, 7:59 AM
[*] CEST: May 17, 2023, 9:00 AM - April 30, 2024, 4:59 PM
[*] KST: May 17, 2023, 4:00 PM - April 30, 2024, 11:59 PM
[/list]

[h2][b]Important Notes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The website supports English, Korean, and Chinese languages only.
[*] The website only supports PC, Mobile devices, and Tablets. 
[*] The website is intended for clan promotion purposes only. Any clan names, tags, emblems, or other in-game settings created on the website will not have any impact on the actual in-game settings.
[*] The clan emblems created on the website cannot be used within the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS game itself.
[/list]

With the recent update, we have also introduced a new in-game Clan System, allowing players to create Clans within the game and recruit Clan members. The Clan System brings various elements to enhance the gaming experience, including Clan level progression and in-game chat functionality. For more detailed information about the Clan system, please refer to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/578080/view/3694684194547908323]23.2 patch notes[/url]. 

Thank you.
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.[/b]

[h2][b]New System: Recall[/b][/h2]

[i]Blue Chip registered successfully. Boarding the plane in a few seconds.[/i]

Introducing the new [b]recall system[/b], designed to alleviate the sense of frustration felt upon death during team play. Acquire the Blue Chip from the deathbox of a defeated ally and help your teammate rejoin the match!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7613e061b6fe9a05e6abd467c9e8a6cd991dad72.jpg[/img]
[b]Blue Chip[/b]

[list]
	[*]A Blue Chip is a special chip containing a player's biometric signature.
	[*]You can obtain a Blue Chip from any player's deathbox.
	[*]Collected Blue Chips can be found in your inventory.

		[list]
			[*]Each Blue Chip has a weight of 5.
		[/list]
	
	[*](PC)A dedicated inventory slot for your character's Blue Chip has been added below the Helmet slot.

		[list]
			[*](Console) Your character's Blue Chip inventory slot has been added below the Shoes slot.
			[*]It is not possible to unequip your own Blue Chip.
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Blue Chip Tower[/b]

[list]
	[*]Register Blue Chips at Blue Chip Towers scattered throughout the map to Recall your teammates.
	[*]These towers randomly spawn every match, with their locations marked on the map.
	[*]An Interact button appears when approaching a Blue Chip Tower when you are holding at least one Blue Chip in your inventory.

		[list]
			[*]Multiple teammates' Blue Chips can be registered concurrently.
			[*]Enemy Blue Chips can not be registered.
			[*]If the player you are trying to recall leaves the match, a corresponding text will be displayed.
			[*]You are unable to activate the Blue Chip Tower while holding a Drone Tablet.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Activating a Blue Chip Tower takes about 10 seconds.

		[list]
			[*]A loud noise is produced during the activation process.
			[*]Activation is canceled if you move, get knocked out or eliminated, or press the Cancel key.
		[/list]
	
	[*]After successful registration, the same Blue Chip Tower becomes unusuable for a specific duration.
	[*]Successfully registered Blue Chips will recall the appropriate teammates in the next phase.
	[*]Blue Chip Towers display 4 light states:

		[list]
			[*]Red: In use.
			[*]Yellow: Temporarily unavailable.
			[*]Blue: Ready for use.
			[*]Gray: Unusable (during phases when the Recall system is deactivated).
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Blue Chip Transmitter[/b]

[list]
	[*]Recall teammates anytime, anywhere using the world-spawn item, Blue Chip Transmitter.
	[*]Weight: 5
	[*]Once you have acquired the Blue Chip Transmitter, locate it in your inventory and click on it to activate.
	[*]WhenBlue Chips are in your possession, a confirmation list appears.

		[list]
			[*]Multiple teammates' Blue Chips can be registered concurrently.
			[*]Enemy Blue Chips can not be registered.
			[*]If the player you are trying to recall leaves the match, an icon and corresponding text will be displayed.
		[/list]
	
	[*]A 10-second activation period is required to register the Blue Chip(s).

		[list]
			[*]A noise is produced during the activation process.
			[*]Activation is canceled if you move, get knocked out or eliminated, or press the Cancel key.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Successfully registered Blue Chips will recall the appropriate teammates in the next phase.
	[*]The Blue Chip Transmitter is a consumable item and is removed from the inventory after use.
	[*]The Blue Chip Transmitter can not be used while DBNO, in a vehicle, or swimming.

		[list]
			[*]Using the Blue Chip Transmitter while prone or crouching will automatically cause you to stand up.
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Recall Process[/b]

[list]
	[*]Players will be recalled to the match after their Blue Chips are successfully registered via Blue Chip Towers or Blue Chip Transmitters.
	[*]Once Recalled, players can re-enter the battlegrounds by parachuting from a Recall plane, which flies once at the start of each phase.
	[*]Recalled players will [b]not [/b]possess any weapons or equipment.

		[list]
			[*]Health, boosts, DBNO stack, and items will be reset.
			[*]A new Blue Chip is equipped.
		[/list]
	
	[*]If the last remaining teammate is eliminated [b]before [/b]the player set to rejoin the match boards the plane, the Recall will be canceled, resulting in a match defeat.
[/list]

[b]More Info[/b]

[list]
	[*]Recall is impossible if the entire team is eliminated.
	[*]

		

The Blue Chip Tower and Transmitter can be utilized an unlimited number of times.

		[list]
			[*]

				

However, due to the restriction of boarding the Recall plane only once from Phases 2-7, each player can be Recalled up to a maximum of six times.
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]The Recall system will be [b]disabled[/b]from Phase 7 onwards.

		[list]
			[*]The Recall plane will not fly.
			[*]Only players with Blue Chips successfully registered up to Phase 6 will rejoin the match at the beginning of Phase 7.
		[/list]
	
	[*]The Recall system applies to Normal Matches, Custom Matches, and Casual Mode.

		[list]
			[*]It is not available in Custom Match - Esports Mode.
		[/list]
	
	[*]This feature is available on Erangel, Miramar, and Deston.
	[*]On Deston, the Blue Chip Detector can now detect not only players but also Blue Chips.

		[list]
			[*]The Detector identifies Blue Chips in deathboxes, lying on the ground, or stored in vehicle trunks.
			[*]Detected Blue Chips will be displayed with icons identical to those used for detected players.
		[/list]
	
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ff1f9b4f43e8a91bf28fbe56ae0fb53559bc43dd.jpg[/img]





[I]< Dev's Comment >[/i]

[i]With our latest update, we're introducing a unique feature that not only adds an extra layer of enjoyment to the standard battle royale mode, but also encourages a variety of strategic plays for an enriched experience on the battlegrounds.[/i]

[i]The new Recall system presents several key differences from the existing Comeback BR mechanic: it demands cooperation and effort from surviving team members rather than just the fallen player, is available until the mid-late game phases, and enables plays that contest enemy players attempting to use the Recall system.[/i]

[i]While the system offers numerous advantages, it also comes with several challenges: Recovering Blue Chips from fallen teammates, finding designated Blue Chip Towers scattered across the map, using Blue Chip Transmitters without being detected by nearby foes, and being more exposed to enemy attention during your descent from the Recall airplane. [/i][i]We believe the benefits of Recall are significant in a battle royale setting, so we've designed the system to reward players who can overcome these challenges. Our intention is to allow even less experienced players to occasionally utilize this system, depending on their luck. The new Recall system is particularly helpful for novices who may struggle with combat in Comeback BR, as it emphasizes the importance of surviving team members' roles in facilitating successful recalls.[/i]

[i]But why limit it to Erangel, Miramar, and Deston? Smaller maps have shorter play times, making it faster to start a new game upon death. And we've decided to add the Recall system exclusively to maps without the existing Comeback BR.[/i]

[i]There is no cap to the number of Recalls; as long as you can retrieve Blue Chips and successfully register them, your teammates can be recalled to the match multiple times. However, given various factors such as the quantity and location of Blue Chip Towers and Transmitters and their specific usage conditions, we anticipate that players will not be able to excessively recall their allies with ease.[/i]

[i]By the way, it's good to know that the owner's username is always displayed alongside the Blue Chip. I still hold onto a screenshot of the Blue Chip I acquired from my boss.[/i]


[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]

[b]Vehicle[/b]

[i]Hey where'd my car go?[/i]

Remembering the location of your vehicle after exiting it may bring quite the advantage, but it's also quite common for players to become disoriented and unable to locate their vehicles, causing significant stress.

To address this, we're introducing a feature that [b]automatically generates a vehicle icon[/b], [b]visible only to you, at the location where you exit your vehicle[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7ec483532dbdc038e60ebd9416d1751386ec9a14.jpg[/img]	
	

[list]
	[*]The vehicle icon is marked on the World Map.

		[list]
			[*]The icon is not visible to other team members.
			[*]It will not show up as a screen ping marker.
			[*]This does not affect the existing marker features.
		[/list]
	
	[*]This feature applies to every seat in the vehicle.
	[*]The icon will be removed once you board another vehicle.
	[*]The icon can be removed with the existing marker deletion key/button.

		[list]
			[*]However, this action will also delete any existing markers you've created.
		[/list]
	
	[*]This feature applies to every vehicle but the Mountain Bike.
	[*]This feature is available in every mode.
[/list]

Additionally, to enhance safety measures and prevent tragic accidents caused by players inadvertently disembarking from a moving vehicle, we have introduced a [b]timed exit feature[/b]. This feature is activated when someone attempts to exit a moving vehicle at a specific speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/83ba275123c165a21da57cbd206dd67f71514a6d.jpg[/img]	
	

[list]
	[*]When the vehicle's moving speed exceeds 60 km/h, a 3-second countdown timer will be initiated upon attempting to leave the vehicle.

		[list]
			[*]For speeds at or below 60 km/h, players can leave the vehicle immediately.
		[/list]
	
	[*]If the Leave Vehicle key/button is pressed again within the 3-second window, the leaving process can be canceled.
	[*]This feature can be toggled on or off through settings.

		

To avoid repeated cancellation of leaving a vehicle, any Leave Vehicle presses within 1 second of the initial input will be disregarded, with only the first input executed.
	
[/list]

We're also adjusting [b]fixed vehicle spawns[/b] in Taego to enhance utility for players:

[list]
	[*]The Pony Coupe is now available as a fixed spawn vehicle.
	[*]The Porter will now spawn randomly, instead of appearing in fixed locations.
	[*]At garage locations, the Pony Coupe will no longer spawn, and instead, the UAZ and Dacia will appear in fixed locations.
	[*]Although the fixed spawns result in minor adjustments to spawn rates for specific random-spawn vehicles, the overall vehicle spawn rate remains unchanged.
	[*]

		

These modifications apply to all Taego game modes - Normal Match, Ranked, and Custom Match.
	
[/list]

[b]DBNO[/b]

We are implementing adjustments to the balance of automatic HP loss during the Down But Not Out (DBNO) state to provide players with additional strategic choices.

By [b]decreasing the rate of automatic HP loss[/b] [b]while remaining stationary[/b], players can make more informed decisions on whether to stay put or reposition based on their circumstances. We believe this not only promotes a more realistic experience but also strengthens the game's narrative structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/621c19d23dce1fca0b0ec099b0d8a9005548cd6c.jpg[/img]
[list]
	[*]While remaining stationary during DBNO, the identical HP reduce rate will apply regardless of how many times you are knocked out.

		[list]
			[*]A unique animation will play when the automatic HP reduce rate is applied.
		[/list]
	
	[*]When you are [b]not moving[/b], your character is considered to be still, remaining stationary.

		[list]
			[*]Adjusting the camera's position without moving your character is also deemed as standing still.
		[/list]
	
	[*]You are [b]in motion[/b] when your character is actively moving, in water, rotating, or boarding a vehicle.
[/list]

Additionally, in the current gaming landscape, when a squad member gets knocked out, it takes quite some time to recall them, leaving the squad vulnerable to the enemy's approach.

Thus, we aim to introduce a new strategy: [b]adding a feature where players can carry their knocked out teammates and load them into a vehicle[/b] for a quick getaway. We hope this will encourage more diverse scenarios as you may use vehicles to swiftly evade rather than being forced to engage in combat or abandoning teammates.

[i]Or better yet... why not knock out an enemy and load them onto your vehicle to taunt the opposing team?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/125d48e502435054193bbd6515b081fbfea70f94.jpg[/img]	

[list]
	[*]Carry your knocked out teammate and use the [b]Limited Interact key[/b] to load them onto a vehicle.
	[*]

		

Knocked out players can be placed in any seat of a vehicle, including the driver's seat.
	
	[*]Once onboard, the knocked out teammate is limited to the following actions:

		[list]
			[*]Leave the vehicle using the leave vehicle key.
			[*]Drop items from inventory.

				[list]
					[*]This includes moving them to the vehicle's trunk.
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]BRDM

		[list]
			[*]If unoccupied,

				[list]
					[*]You can load any knocked out player on it.
				[/list]
			
			[*]If occupied by a teammate,

				[list]
					[*]You can only load your knocked out teammate.
				[/list]
			
			[*]If occupied by an enemy player,

				[list]
					[*]Only the knocked out enemy's teammates can load their teammates on it.
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Weapon Balance
[/b]

Following the weapon balance adjustments in Update 22.2, the ACE32 has exhibited an overall decent performance, but its win rate during combat has been marginally lower than expected. As a result, we have incorporated the following enhancements:

[list]
	[*]The intensity of the screen shake experienced while firing the ACE32 has been reduced. 

		[list]
			[*]This leads to an improvement in the weapon's stability.
			[*]There have been no changes made to the recoil itself.
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Item[/b]

The particle count of smoke grenades has been optimized to enhance rendering performance. While the visual representation of the smoke might seem slightly different from its previous state, we have ensured that gameplay remains unaffected.

[b]New System: Clan[/b]

Experience the exciting integration of Clans in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS! With Clans, feel a fresh and engaging layer to the gameplay experience with a new progression system: Clan levels. Collaborating with your Clan members offers a range of benefits and rewards, and furthermore, you'll have the ability to access your own or other players' Clan Tags, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/610902bdb0dbc10d02340226b1739593c26476cf.jpg[/img]
[list]
	[*]The Lobby now features a [b]Clan button[/b] for creating or joining a Clan.
	[*]Creating a Clan

		[list]
			[*]Cost: 15,000 BP
			[*]Capacity: 100 members
			[*]The Create Clan feature is only available to players with the Plus Status.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Clan Roles

		[list]
			[*]Clan Master

				[list]
					[*]The player who initially creates the Clan or is appointed as the Master becomes the Clan Master.

						[list]
							[*]

								

Upon appointing a new Clan Master, the former Master is demoted to a General Member.
							
						[/list]
					
					[*]Each Clan can have one Clan Master.
					[*]Permissions: Changing Clan name and Tag, creating and editing notices, setting and changing the primary language, inviting Clan members, accepting or declining membership requests, modifying Clan's application method, kicking out Clan members, disbanding the Clan, appointing a new Master, appointing Managers, dismissing Managers.
				[/list]
			
			[*]Manager

				[list]
					[*]There is no limit to the number of Managers.
					[*]Permissions: Creating and editing notices, setting and changing the primary language, inviting Clan members, accepting or declining membership requests, modifying Clan's application method, kicking out Clan members, leaving Clan.
				[/list]
			
			[*]General Member

				[list]
					[*]Permissions: Leaving Clan.
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]Joining a Clan

		[list]
			[*]Players who have completed the Tutorials are eligible to join a Clan.
			[*]Players can either request to join a Clan or be invited by a current Clan member.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Clan Levels

		[list]
			[*]Clans can level up to level 20.
			[*]Clan XP is earnable through gameplay.

				[list]
					[*]Players can earn Clan XP by playing solo or with their Clan members.
					[*]Players receive a double XP bonus when playing with their Clan members!

						[list]
							[*]

								

Clan members must complete a match under normal circumstances, including spectating other Clan members after their own death.
							
						[/list]
					
					[*]Eligible modes: Normal Match, Ranked, Casual Match
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]Clan Name

		[list]
			[*]Each Clan can be named with their own unique name, and can not be used by multiple Clans.

				[list]
[*]PC: A Clan name can be used only once within all PC platforms (Steam, KAKAO, Epic Games Store).
[*]Console: A Clan name can be used only once within all Console platforms (Xbox, PlayStation®).
					[*]Requirement: 2-15 characters, uppercase and lowercase letters of the English alphabet, numbers, hyphen (-), underscore (_)

						[list]
							[*]First character must be an English alphabet letter or number.
							[*]Spaces cannot be used.
							[*]You must have a minimum of 2 combined alphabets and numbers, excluding hyphens and underscores.
							[*]The combined total of all digits (0-9) should not exceed 6 characters.
						[/list]
					
				[/list]
			
			[*]If you want to change your Clan's name or Tag:

				[list]
					[*]Purchase a Clan Name Change or Clan Tag Change at Store - Utility for 990 G-COIN each.
					[*]Clan Name Change/Clan Tag Change can be used on the Clan - Manage page.
					[*]Clan Name Change/Clan Tag Changes can [b]only[/b]be used by the Clan Master.

						[list]
							[*]Managers and General Members [b]cannot[/b] use these items.
						[/list]
					
					[*]Upon changing your Clan name, a 7-day grace period is granted for the previous name. Disbanding your Clan will also have a 7-day grace period.


						[list]
							[*]During this grace period, the name is unavailable for use by other Clans.
						[/list]
					
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]Clan Tags and Tag Plates

		[list]
			[*]A Clan Tag can consist of up to 4 characters and can be used by multiple Clans.

				[list]
					[*]Requirement: 2-4 characters, uppercase letters of the English alphabet, numbers, hyphen (-), underscore (_)

						[list]
							[*]First character must be an English alphabet letter or number.
							[*]Spaces cannot be used.
							[*]You must have a minimum of 2 combined alphabets and numbers, excluding hyphens and underscores.
						[/list]
					
				[/list]
			
			[*]Once a Clan reaches Level 2, its Clan Tag will appear on players' nicknames/PUBG IDs both in-game and out-game, along with a corresponding Tag Plate.

				[list]
					[*]If the on-screen display is visually congested, the Clan Tag may appear in [brackets] instead of a Tag Plate.
				[/list]
			
			[*]The Tag Plate can be upgraded as your Clan levels up.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Benefits

		[list]
			[*]Players earn a 30% BP boost for playing with their Clan members.

				[list]
					[*]Eligible modes: Normal Match, Ranked, Casual Match
				[/list]
			
		[/list]
	
	[*]Chat

		[list]
			[*]A new Clan channel will be added to the chat feature, allowing Clan members to communicate with each other.
			[*]Clan messages can be viewed even during matches, but responses cannot be sent.
			[*]A "Hide Clan Messages During Matches" option has been added under System Menu - Settings - Gameplay - Interface - UI.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Clan Search

		[list]
			[*]Clans with precise matches to their name or Clan Tag initials can be searched.
			[*]The Clan Search page allows you to look for Clans to join and Clans to promote and recruit members through an external community site.
		[/list]
	
	[*]And more

		[list]
			[*]A Clan tab has been added to the Social page.
			[*]Actions available with friends are now available with Clan members.

				[list]
					[*]Join Team, Whispers, login notifications
				[/list]
			
			[*]If the Clan Master doesn't log in for more than 42 days, a Manager will be automatically appointed as the new Master.

				[list]
					[*]A warning message will be displayed after 28 days of inactivity.
					[*]The Master will be delegated to a Manager with the earliest join date who has logged in within the past 28 days.

						[list]
							[*]In the absence of a Manager who fulfills the specified criteria above, a General Member who has logged in within the last 28 days with the earliest join date will be appointed as the Master.
							[*]If no General Members have logged in within the last 28 days, the first Clan member to log in will assume the Master role.
						[/list]
					
				[/list]
			
			[*]Report

				[list]
					[*]"Inappropriate Clan Name or Tag" has been added to the existing Report Player feature.
					[*]You can report a Clan through the Clan search page.
					[*]There are two items for reporting one's own Clan:

						[list]
							[*]Inappropriate Clan Name or Tag
							[*]Inappropriate Clan Content
						[/list]
					
				[/list]
			
			[*]Note: Some screens may not display the Clan Tag in front of certain nicknames.
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3cc4e980aaa8886c6dffe3a115218419377ba9da.jpg[/img]



[i]< Dev's Comment >[/i]

[i]Prior to this update, active players in external Clans had no particular means of displaying their achievements within the game. To address this, the newly implemented Clan system aims to offer a common objective for Clan members to work towards upgrading their Clans. We hope the new Clan feature fosters a sense of belonging, ultimately heightening player satisfaction and instilling pride in their in-game progress.[/i]

[i]At launch, the Clan system is designed with the essential specifications in mind. However, we are committed to continually refining and expanding its features based on your valuable feedback.[/i]


[b]UX/UI[/b]

The UX/UI for general item-related interactions has been enhanced.

[list]
	[*]You can now preview items within a redesigned layout at the Store, Survivor Pass, Workshop, etc.
	[*]During a full item preview, relevant information is displayed, allowing for quick identification of the item type.
	[*]Vehicle skin previews now include the ground, although X-axis rotation and zoom in/out functions are unavailable.
	[*]Within item sets previews,

		[list]
			[*]You can now easily preview elements such as Sprays and Nameplates without the need to navigate to a separate screen.
			[*]Hovering or focusing on an item reveals an icon that signifies the expected action upon clicking.
			[*]You can now expand the text to view lengthy descriptions.
			[*]If only one item is equipped, it cannot be unequipped.
		[/list]
	
	[*]Upon entering any preview where you can turn on/off equipped skins, the equipped skin ON/OFF feature will be set to ON by default.
[/list]

[b]Workshop
[/b]

[b]Chest[/b]
	

[list]
	[*]New item sets have been added to the Hunter's Chest and Archivist's Chest.

		[list]
			[*]Cat Burglar
			[*]Victory Dance 102
		[/list]
	
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]

[list]
	[*]Reduced hitches and memory usage after in-game death, during both revival from Comeback BR and spectating.
	[*]Decreased memory usage when transitioning to the Death Cam.
	[*]Enhanced performance by optimizing the use of Thermal 4x Scopes.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Gameplay

[list]
	[*]General in-game bugs have been fixed.
	[*]Fixed an issue causing the player character to exit on the passenger side instead of the driver's side when the Pony Coupe collides with an object and veers towards the driver's seat.
	[*]Fixed an issue that displays the animation for running from another player's perspective when attempting to run into a wall.
	[*]Fixed an issue causing your perspective angle to adjust to the previously spectated player when switching to FPP after spectating an ally driving on an incline.
	[*]Fixed an issue that made the character automatically move locations when transitioning to Drone view during a jump towards a Drone positioned beneath the character.
	[*]Fixed an issue that stopped the firing sound of the Mk47 Mutant in burst mode.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue where the volume reducer setting after you are removed from Training Mode due to inactivity would also affect your settings for Normal Matches.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue causing nearly every player to fall off near the start of the airplane ride.
[/list]

World

[list]
	[*]Fixed collision, texture, performance, and some other general map issues.
[/list]

UX/UI

[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue causing an incorrect system message to appear when sending a friend request to a blocked friend.
	[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the item type from being displayed in the outfit and armor tooltip.
	[*]Fixed an issue where accepting a Custom Match invitation during item preview on the Store page does not transition to the waiting room nor close the Store page.
	[*]Fixed the incorrect Mastery tier of bots displayed in Match Report.
	[*]Fixed an issue with the malfunctioning outfit previews on the Throwback Crate preview screen.
	[*]Fixed an issue where the attachment replacement interaction UI displays the icon of an unequipped weapon slot, instead of the attachment on the currently equipped weapon.
	[*]Fixed the inaccurate attachment descriptions for the Tactical Stock and Half Grip.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue causing the menu list to shake unstably when navigating up and down with the scrollbar pressed when creating a Custom Match.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue where the password for private Custom Matches is not encrypted with asterisks and is displayed as entered.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue where the /hidewhisper and /showwhisper commands are not functional in Lobby chat.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue where you are unable to close the in-game Match Log screen using the ESC button.
[/list]

Items & Skins

[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue where wearing a Sleeveless Biker Jacket would obstruct the view in ADS.
	[*]Fixed an issue where the armpit area would stretch when a male character equips the Phoenix Jacket.
	[*]Fixed an issue causing the wrist to appear transparent when the Tormented Knight Gloves and Heartwarming Sweater are equipped simultaneously.
	[*](PC) Fixed an issue where the name is displayed incorrectly when equipping or unequipping the Tortoise Emerald Weapon Charm.
[/list]

Hello players!

We are excited to announce that Prime Gaming rewards are back starting this month! With Prime Gaming you can get your hands on various rewards that will make your PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS experience even more enjoyable!

Prime Gaming rewards will change every month, so make sure to check our [url=http://gaming.amazon.com/pubg]Prime Gaming page[/url] for new rewards and exciting updates.

[b]Prime Gaming Website will become available starting from the dates below. [/b]

[h2][b]Rewards can be claimed starting from [/b][/h2]

[*] CEST: April 28 2023, 1 AM

[h2][b]How to Claim Rewards[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Access our [url=http://gaming.amazon.com/pubg]Prime Gaming page[/url].
[*] Click the "Claim Now" button below the claimable reward.
[*] Sign in to or sign up for an Amazon Prime account.
[list]
[*] You need an Amazon account to sign up for Prime. If you don't have an Amazon account, you can create one by clicking "Create Your Amazon Account."
[*] After signing up for Amazon Prime, you will be required to add a payment method. You can start your 7-day free trial first and pay the monthly payment after the trial. [/list][*] After you successfully set up your Amazon Prime account, you will be redirected to the reward claiming window.
[*] Press "Go to KRAFTON" to link your KRAFTON ID to your Amazon Prime account.

[/list]

[list]

[list]
[*] Amazon Prime will initially extract $1.00 USD from your bank account to confirm your payment method. The $1.00 USD will be returned a few days later.[/list]

[list]

[list]

[/list][/list]

Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: Dev Talk: A New 6eginning Additional Q&A
author: [****] UZI
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0fecc3791449439f970437f95d55daeb4beca103.png[/img]

Hello players!

During our 6th Anniversary Dev Talk, we had the privilege of receiving a wealth of questions from passionate PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS fans worldwide.

Today, we are excited to share with you the remaining questions and answers that were not addressed during the live Q&A session.

---

[h2]IN-GAME: TAEHYUN KIM[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d12fbd3e5dc3d147d0a243a35ec7062ff8606253.jpg[/img]

Q: Are there plans to rework maps other than Erangel/Miramar this year?

A: While we don't have any reworks planned for other maps this year, we do have plans to rework Erangel and Miramar.



Q: Where do you mainly receive inspiration for new maps?

A: Finding inspiration for new maps is not always limited to a particular location. Our initial priority is to ensure that the new map's concept and atmosphere are unique and distinct from our existing maps. After that, we focus on selecting a specific theme. As we strive for realism in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS' world, we meticulously research areas that align with the chosen theme and narrow down the location where we can best capture the desired concept.



Q: I'm excited for the new map, Codename: NEON! Will the Care Package system in NEON be different from other maps?

A: While it has not been officially confirmed, we are presently engaged in discussions regarding the potential implementation of a unique method for acquiring Care Packages, which would set it apart from other maps.



Q: Will you add helicopters to NEON?

A: As for incorporating this form of transportation (vehicle), it is not currently within our development plans. But we may possibly reconsider this idea in the future.



Q: Will the new revival system give multiple opportunities to revive (like in Vikendi)?

A: The new revival system functions in a substantially distinct manner compared to Vikendi's Comeback BR. While specific conditions must be met to revive a teammate, it is theoretically possible to achieve multiple revivals. However, given the nature of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS gameplay, even attaining two revivals may be a daunting task. Moreover, the erratic nature of the Blue Zone adds to the difficulty of accomplishing multiple revivals.



Q: I understand that the revival systems in Taego and Vikendi are different, and that there is no revival system in Erangel and Miramar. Will the new revival system be implemented on every map?

A: We currently have no intentions of implementing the new revival system on Taego or Vikendi, as they already feature their own Comeback BRs. Instead, the new system will be exclusively introduced to larger maps like Erangel, Miramar, and Deston. We may contemplate extending the new revival system to other maps in the future, depending on player feedback.



Q: Will any weapons be removed during the weapon diversification updates?

A: Our objective is to maximize the use of existing weapons in the game, and therefore, we do not intend to remove any weapons.



Q: Are there any plans for additional animation updates after the animation refresh?

A: At present, there are no plans to release any further updates for animations.



Q: Will there be any other refreshes after the animation refresh, such as for in-game sounds?

A: Our focus, following the animation refresh update, is to refrain from modifying familiar elements unless there are known issues. In the absence of any problems, there are no plans for further refreshes.



Q: Are there any plans for updates aimed at newbies?

A: Our plans are centered around appealing to a broad range of players rather than targeting specific groups. We intend to enhance tutorials, improve understanding of the minimap, Blue Zone mechanics, navigation, and other aspects.



Q: I personally believe safe transportation between islands and land should be better secured. Could you share your thoughts on this?

A: In PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, players' choices can have both positive and negative consequences, and they should be prepared to face the outcomes of their decisions. We acknowledge that traveling between islands and land can be inconvenient and unstable, and we are monitoring the situation. However, we currently do not see any significant problems that require improvement or modification.



Q: Will more Care Package-exclusive weapons be added?

A: Our priority is to add commonly-used weapons, but we are also considering the gradual addition of Care Package-exclusive weapons.



Q: Is there a plan to add a feature where you can upgrade your weapon during a match?

A: We do not have any plans to introduce such a feature at this time, but possibly in the future!



Q: Regarding weapon balancing, are there plans to adjust attachment stats or add new attachments?

A: As we have recently released an update to improve attachment stats, we currently have no additional plans. We are also cautious about adding new attachments, as too many attachments can make gameplay more challenging.



Q: Is there a plan to incorporate vehicle spawns in Training Mode for practicing vehicle play with Smoke Grenades?

A: Although it would be beneficial to offer various simulation opportunities, we have observed that some players intentionally disrupt others trying to practice. We are currently exploring options to enable uninterrupted practice sessions, but no concrete plans have been established at this time.



Q: Will the three-match daily limit for Casual Mode be removed or increased?

A: We currently have no plans to modify the daily match limit for Casual Mode for now.



Q: Sensitivity settings in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS seem to be a challenging aspect for players. While the gameplay environment and knowledge of various weapons and how they're used may be important for beginners, the skill difference may also be largely determined by sensitivity settings. Are there plans to introduce a tutorial or mode to assist with adjusting these settings?

A: Our team is discussing this topic, though we are still determining the appropriate tutorial format to familiarize beginners with weapons in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS without overwhelming them with complex sensitivity settings. While no specific plans are in place, we are definitely interested in developing such a system.



Q: I believe a feature where you can destroy buildings already exists within the game (C4). Will you be adding a new feature that is even more powerful?

A: We cannot provide a definitive answer at this time, but we are attempting to implement gameplay where players can destroy buildings using a variety of weapons.



Q: The building destruction feature mentioned in the R&D part was interesting. Are there any other interactive objects being considered for addition?

A: We are definitely considering the addition of more interactive features as we believe it's important to have both meaningful and entertaining elements in the game.



Q: You mentioned striving to synchronize Esports and Ranked gameplay. I personally believe the most important thing is to assign team numbers before a player's nickname to make player count easier. In professional gameplay, players' unified nicknames make it easy to confirm remaining players/2:2 splits through killfeeds. However, in Ranked, players have different nicknames - making it difficult to quickly assess the number of players, which leads to a number of obstacles for orders and gameplay. Are there any plans for a killfeed update for Ranked?

A: We do not have any current plans for such an update, but the suggestion is under internal review. Our team has diverse opinions on this topic, and we acknowledge both pros and cons. However, we are actively considering the idea.



Q: In Esports, only FPP is used while Ranked has both FPP and TPP. If the ruleset is unified, will TPP be removed from Ranked or will TPP be added to Esports?

A: We don't aim to make Esports and Ranked entirely identical. Although the rules will be consistent, Esports will maintain its FPP setting, and we will continue to offer the current perspective options for Ranked.



Q: Are there plans to recruit various types of players for playtesting and feedback sessions? It can be helpful long-term to receive feedback and obtain diverse perspectives.

A: We are considering this option, but implementing and reviewing feedback would require substantial resources to deliver content promptly. As PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is a global service, it is challenging to conduct tests and receive feedback from every region, though we are open to finding viable methods for these sessions.



Q: Will PUBG prioritize improving existing systems or introducing new creative systems in the future?

A: Both aspects are crucial. While we mainly focused on new content development until last year, we plan to allocate more resources to enhancing existing systems alongside creating new ones this year, with a 50:50 ratio in mind.

---

[h2]OUT-GAME: SANGKYUN KIM[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/33d9b96e28564924517afaf2fcfbcdb5745713ed.jpg[/img]

Q: Are there any plans to release a Mountain Bike skin?

A: That's an interesting suggestion. We'll definitely take it into consideration.



Q: Due to dissatisfaction with Ranked rewards, more players are opting for Normal Matches. Are there plans to offer more diverse rewards for Ranked?

A: We intend to improve Ranked rewards, although we won't be adding currency-based rewards like Schematics/Contraband Coupons. Instead, our focus is on expanding rewards that players can permanently own.



Q: Will Clan Tags be added to in-game killfeeds?

A: We plan to incorporate Clan Tags in various game aspects and expand their visibility. The display of Clan Tags or Clan Plates will depend on the context, such as their location within the UI.



Q: Are there any plans to enable character movement in the Lobby?

A: We currently do not have plans for such a feature, but we may reconsider it in the future.



Q: Will there be a feature allowing squad members to swap positions or equip owned skins in the Lobby?

A: Although we have no plans to add position-swapping functionality, we do aim to develop a feature enabling outfit changes during the pre-game phase.



Q: Will PUBG prioritize improving existing systems or introducing new creative systems in the future?

A: For now, our focus is on refining and enhancing our current systems.

---

[h2]ANTI-CHEAT: SANGWAN KIM[/h2]
Q: Are there plans to strengthen measures against users who intentionally team kill, such as permanently ban or restrictions from Duo/Squad matches? Additionally, could players check teammates' team killing history before starting a match to avoid such players?

A: We are currently implementing penalties for intentional team killing and considering additional measures to reinforce these sanctions. We plan to collaborate with relevant teams to execute these actions. Checking team killing history before starting a match is possible, but not on the starting island. This issue warrants further discussion with the appropriate teams.

---

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the players who have generously shown their support and sent us numerous questions as we celebrated our 6th anniversary milestone.

The PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS team is committed to continuing our efforts to connect with players and meet their expectations even more so in the coming months and years.


PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: Map Service Plan - April 2023
author: [****] UZI
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a27ed0428ed566e739e9c338d5b14738ff9093f8.png[/img]

Hello players!

The [url=https://pubg.com/en/news/4942]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS 2023 Roadmap[/url] released last month ushered in a change in map service plans. We have mentioned that the goal of the 2023 map service plan is to allow players to access their favorite maps without waiting too long.

In today's announcement, we would like to elaborate on the PUBG team's intentions for the map service plan that will be implemented from Update 23.1. We will first provide an overview of the map service update schedule and plan summary before delving into the full details.

[h2][b]Map Service Update Schedule[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] PC: April 12
[*] Console: April 20
[/list]
[h2][b]Map Service Plan[/b][/h2]
(The details of the plan may be subject to change.)

From Update 23.1 onwards, maps will rotate on a weekly basis! The changes that will be applied to Normal Match and Ranked are as follows.

[h3][b]Normal Matches (One week cycle)[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Erangel / Sanhok
[*] Rotation Set 1: Taego / Deston / Paramo
[*] Rotation Set 2: Miramar / Vikendi / Karakin[list]
[*] Rotation Sets 1 and 2 will alternate each week.[/list]
[/list][h3][b]Ranked Mode (One season cycle)[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Deston
[/list]
※ The plan above applies to both PC and Console.
※ Maps are rotated every Wednesday at 11 AM KST for PC / every Thursday at 4 PM KST for Console.
※ The map service plan and schedule for each update can be found in our monthly patch notes.

[h2][b]What PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team Aims to Achieve[/b][/h2]

Having a variety of maps is definitely one of the factors that add to a game's appeal. As players have diverse preferences given the availability of multiple maps, we aim to cater to as many players as possible by altering the rotation cycle.

Why not just offer all maps and make everyone happy? Learning a map is in some ways the toughest part of a game and going through a whole bunch of maps to master every one of them is a steep learning curve. Too many maps available as options will also slow down matchmaking.

Hence, we took into account multiple factors, including ensuring a seamless matchmaking environment, incorporating a diverse range of maps, fostering an environment where players can improve their mastery of the maps, and providing a stable service. We felt that 5 maps for Normal Match and 4 for Ranked would be the optimal choice that offers both variety and mastery.

This will provide some leeway for existing players, ease the onboarding process for new players, and offer pro teams the best environment to have deeper, more exciting playbooks. Shall we now go into more details about this year's map service plan?

[h3][b]Normal Match[/b][/h3]

In Normal Match, Erangel and Sanhok will remain fixed, and rotation sets 1 and 2 will be rotated on a weekly basis.

We have come up with a one week map rotation cycle (4-5 rotations per update) so that a variety of maps will be more frequently available along with Erangel and Sanhok. The previous map rotation system had the advantage of offering certain maps for a whole month, but one month was a bit too long to wait when your favorite map was not included in the rotation. Although changing the cycle from a month to a week is a fairly drastic shift, we have decided to make this change for a more flexible map service.

Good news is each map rotation will be applied without maintenance after Update 23.1, allowing players to enjoy a new rotation more quickly than before. Also, when new content is added to a specific map, that map will be included in the update week's rotation.

Some of you may have questions about the composition of the rotation sets at this point, right? To answer those queries, we would like to share the graphs that show map select/leave rates for Erangel / Miramar / Sanhok / Haven below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/329e7b2d9ee863918405e58475315a66d8c4bfb5.jpg[/img]

Haven is not included in the Normal Match rotation map pool due to its low usage rate. But for all the Haven enjoyers out there, it will still be accessible in custom matches.

Additionally, Sanhok is fixed based on global map preference shown in the graph above. 

By improving the Normal Match map rotation system itself, we want to provide a more flexible service in terms of map rotation cycle and map pool change, and at the same time create a map rotation service suitable for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS.

[h3][b]Ranked[/b][/h3]

In the case of Ranked, 4 maps will be rotated approximately every 2 months in a season cycle. Following the 23.1 update, Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Deston will be in service as previously described. Erangel, Miramar, and Taego will be fixed for 2023, giving players the opportunity to experience the maps they play in Ranked in Esports as well. This alignment will help bridge the gap between Ranked and Esports, along with synchronizing the rulesets as Taego, Deston, and Vikendi are gradually introduced into official Esports tournaments this year.

The map service plan for Ranked will proceed with 8x8km maps, and Deston has been added to the rotation map pool. The probability of the rotation map is subject to change depending on the service performance. Also, there is a chance Vikendi may be added to the Ranked map pool as a rotation map in the future, so those who love the desolate snowfield can look forward to it!


That's a wrap for our map service plan for 2023. Although today's announcement may not have addressed all of your inquiries, we will strive to develop improved plans to help players enjoy varied experiences in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS and keep you informed about our agendas. 

As always, your feedback is a great reference while we are making decisions and we encourage you to always keep those thoughts and suggestions coming! 

Thank you!

[b]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team[/b]

title: 6TH BIRTHDAY! MESSAGE TO PU6G Event - Winner Announcement
author: [****] UZI
contents:
Hello players!

The messages from players that were written with sincerity through our previous 6th Birthday! Message to PU6G Event have deeply moved our PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS team. We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for the enthusiastic participation in our event ([url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2023/03/09/6th-birthday-message-to-pu6g-event/]link[/url]).

As previously informed, we will be announcing the 100 randomly selected winners today!

[h2]Notice[/h2]
[list]
[*] A separate email regarding your winning will be sent to your email address provided during your participation in the survey. Please be sure to check your inbox!
[*] Sender: Pubgsocialevent@pubg.com 
[*] In order to confirm the winner and reward delivery, personal information will be collected through the winning notification email.[list]
[*] If there is no response within 14 days of the initial email being sent, a follow-up email will be sent.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Privacy Notice and Important Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Privacy Notice]  We are going to collect, store and use information about you to operate this promotion. For more details about processing your information please visit “Privacy Policy ([url=https://pubg.com/en/clause]link[/url]).”   
[*] Please refer to the email sent to the winners of this event and reply with your accurate personal information, such as address and contact information, for the delivery of the reward.[list]
[*] If you do not enter the correct information, there may be difficulties to delivering the reward.[/list]
[*] The costs incurred for awarding the reward, such as taxes, will be borne by the company, KRAFTON, Inc.
[*] The company may collect and use additional personal information, such as name, address, contact information, and a copy of identity verification, for the purpose of awarding the reward and providing related customer support services. In such cases, the company will guide you through a separate personal information collection and use consent procedure.
[*] You have the right to decline the reward or decline the collection and use of personal information as described above. However, in this case, please let us know your intention to decline the reward through the reply of the notified email.
[*] If we are unable to contact the winners within a month of the first email sent, or if the reward is unawarded due to reasons such as reward decline, the unawarded reward may be used for other events.
[*] For smooth delivery of the prize, the personal information (name, contact information, address) of the winner may be processed by the courier delivery company.
[/list]

Thank you.
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team
