[u]< Dev’s Comment >[/u]


[u]Deston is returning to Random Map regions this update! For every rotation, we try our best to base each of our decisions on map popularity rates, dodge rates, surveys, etc., but we’ve been receiving feedback that the extraction of certain maps from the random map pool was upsetting several players who enjoyed playing maps that were excluded from a rotation. Therefore, we’ve decided to implement your feedback by placing Deston back to the random map pool and taking Taego out for a bit.[/u]


[u]Also, we can’t say much now, but we are planning a change to the map rotation system based on all your feedback sometime this year. With this update, every player from every region will be able to meet various maps at a faster pace. Until then, enjoy the return of Deston and Karakin this update![/u]



[b]※ PLEASE NOTE THE FEATURES AND UPDATES INTRODUCED BELOW MAY BE MODIFIED OR EVEN POSSIBLY REMOVED DUE TO REASONS SUCH AS BUGS, IN-GAME ISSUES, AND/OR COMMUNITY FEEDBACK. ALSO, IMAGES USED BELOW ARE PROVIDED AS VISUAL GUIDELINES – FEATURES MAY TURN OUT LOOKING DIFFERENT IN THE ACTUAL GAME AS BUILDS ARE CONTINUOUSLY DEVELOPED AND FIXED BEFORE THEY GO LIVE.[/b]

[h2][b]WORLD[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]VIKENDI[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]NEW CREATURE: BEAR[/b][/h3]

The lumbering pack of malice has awoken from hibernation and is ready to blow up bloody winds on the Battlegrounds. Introducing a new creature available only in Vikendi: the [b]BEAR[/b].


These Bears may look soft to the touch, but they’ll never be your friendly neighborhood pets so make sure to flee or fight back if you wish to keep all your body parts intact!

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/New-Creature-Bear-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Bears can be killed.[/*]
    [*]Bears will begin to attack if you are within a certain range.[/*]
    [*]Bear warning signs have been added throughout the map.[/*]
    [*]Bear kill/damage stats will not reflect on your Profile Overview, Stats, Match History, Mastery, and End of Match screen.[/*]
    [*]Available modes[list]
            [*]Bears reside in Vikendi only.[/*]
            [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]THE RETURN OF MOONLIGHT[/b][/h3]

As the sun sets on the frost-laced lands, a beautiful aurora blooms within the serene darkness.


The weather everyone’s been waiting for – [b]MOONLIGHT [/b]mode – has returned this update.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/New-weather-Moonlight_F-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Moonlight weather will appear randomly in matches.[/*]
    [*]Available modes[list]
            [*]Only available in Vikendi.[/*]
            [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]NEW SCOPE: THERMAL 4X SCOPE[/b][/h3]

Would you perhaps remember LABS: Thermal Scope Mode, where you had to fight in darkness using only infrared rays? Well we’ve collected your opinions based on our previous experimental mode and decided to add the popular feature to the snowy grounds: detect snooping players with the new [b]THERMAL 4X SCOPE[/b]! (Shouldn’t it be your best friend in Moonlight weather?)

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/New-scope-Thermal-Scope-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]The Thermal Scope utilizes heat signatures to help you detect obscured enemies more easily.[list]
            [*]This includes enemies hiding in smoke, darkness, brush, etc.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]The Thermal Scope is a world spawn item.[/*]
    [*]Available modes[list]
            [*]Only available in Vikendi.[/*]
            [*]Training Mode, Normal Matches, Custom Matches[list]
                    [*](PC) Available on every map through Sandbox Mode.[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]

[/list]

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Blizzard-Zone-Update-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]

    [*]To make the recently added natural disasters a bit more realistic, smoke and flame from throwables such as Smoke Grenades, Molotov, etc. will no longer work properly within the Blizzard Zone.[list]
            [*]Players who are caught on fire will also not receive damage within the Blizzard Zone.[list]
                    [*]However, you will still receive initial damage when your body is hit with the Molotov.[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
        [/list]

[/list]
[h3][b]KARAKIN[/b][/h3]

title: THE FASTEST CHICKEN DINNER CHALLENGE
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:
Hello players! 


How have you been enjoying the new Intense Battle Royale mode? Are you keeping up with the fast pace of the new mode? 


There’s a saying.. ‘Good Chicken Dinners come to those who act fast’.


How fast can you win the Chicken Dinner? To test your speed, we have set up a challenge that will reveal the fastest survivor among us: The Fastest Chicken Dinner Challenge.


Go engage in the Intense Battle Royale mode and capture and upload the moment you win the Chicken Dinner online. Those who are selected will earn a Chicken Dinner Spray and a Bronze G-COIN Box!

title: LABS: INTENSE BATTLE ROYALE MODE
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:
Hello players!


The new [b]INTENSE BATTLE ROYALE[/b] mode is here to dip you into an extremely fast-paced and heated battlefield – whip out your weapons, engage in nonstop team fights in a smaller arena and achieve that Chicken Dinner!


To celebrate our first service day of LABS: Intense Battle Royale, we’ve also prepared a light event that’ll grant you some Workshop gifts so check out all the details below!

[h3][b]INTRODUCING INTENSE BATTLE ROYALE[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Gameplay-Screenshot-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Intense Battle Royale is a fast-paced, mini battle royale LABS mode sustaining all the essential factors of our traditional battle royale system.


We’ve simplified several factors to reduce play time by a bunch – looting, long-distance traveling, number of enemies, and more. With these factors minimized, players will be able to focus more on the usual battle royale’s late-game intensity right off the bat and aim for the top among the other squads.


[b]WE’VE UTILIZED THE CURRENT BATTLE ROYALE SYSTEM TO CREATE A CONTINUOUS ADRENALINE RUSH IN INTENSE BATTLE ROYALE. SINCE THERE’S ALWAYS ROOM FOR MORE IMPROVEMENTS IN THIS NEW MODE, WE’LL BE ACTIVELY MONITORING AND IMPLEMENTING YOUR FEEDBACK SO THAT WE CAN CONTINUE TO PROVIDE AN ENJOYABLE GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE. ENJOY INTENSE BATTLE ROYALE AND LET US KNOW WHAT YOU THINK![/b]

[h3][b]BASIC SETTINGS[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Map-UI-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]MAXIMUM NUMBER OF STARTING PLAYERS[/b]: 16[/*]
    [*][b]MAP[/b]: Designated areas of either Erangel, Miramar, Taego, or Deston.[/*]
    [*][b]SAFE ZONE[/b]: Starts out with a similar size of the Normal Match’s Phase 3 circle.[list]
            [*]Be warned, the number of players may cause the Safe Zone to be restricted faster![/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*][b]PLANE[/b]: Players will automatically drop from the plane once the plane reaches the edge of the Safe Zone.[/*]
    [*]Specific Zones such as the Red Zone, Blizzard Zone, etc. will [b]NOT [/b]be activated.[/*]
    [*]The balance adjustments for weapons/vehicles/maps in Normal Matches will apply to this mode.[/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]ITEMS AND VEHICLES[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Inventory-UI-1024x576.jpg[/img]

title: PUBG RECAP – YOUR 2022
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:
Greetings players!


Throughout 2022 PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS players have experienced all kinds of exciting situations which led to skillful plays that are definitely worth remembering.
[previewyoutube=Th3aP10s4u8;full][/previewyoutube]
We’d like to cherish and save these memories we all made together, so we’ve created a space where you can check your [url=https://event.pubg.com/your2022]2022 memorable milestones [/url]and achievements on the battlegrounds.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Pubg-Legend-1024x576.png[/img]

These and many other amusing stats along with a special [b]REWARD[/b] we have prepared for the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS players of 2022 can be checked on the [url=https://event.pubg.com/your2022]2022 PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Recap space. [/url]

[h2][b]2022 RECAP – HASHTAG EVENT[/b][/h2]

Jump on the hype train, share your cool stats with the rest of the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS crowd, and get a chance to get your hands on the coolest PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS merch!


To participate, simply upload a screenshot of your stats from the[url=https://event.pubg.com/your2022]Recap website above[/url] to social media using the required hashtags.


Check out the detailed instructions down below:[u] [/u]

[h3][b]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/b][/h3]
[olist]
    [*]Download the screenshot file of your stats from the [url=https://event.pubg.com/your2022]Recap website. [/url][/*]
    [*]Upload the screenshot file to your social media account on one of the following platforms.[/*]
[/olist]
[list]
    [*]Twitter[/*]
    [*]Instagram[/*]
    [*]Facebook[/*]
    [*]Regional platforms[/*]
[/list]

       3. Please include the following information along with your entry:

[list]
    [*]Your PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS in-game nickname[/*]
    [*]Your platform (ex. Steam, Xbox, etc.)[/*]
    [*][b]REQUIRED HASHTAGS[/b]: [u]#PUBG #my2022 + Region code (Ex: #PUBG #my2022KR)[/u][/*]

contents:
[h2][b]21.2 HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=C42joW3P4Q0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]LIVE MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE[/b][/h2]

※ The times shown below are subject to change.

[list]
    [*]PC[list]
            [*]PST: January 17, 4:30 PM – January 18, 12:30 AM[/*]
            [*]CET: January 18, 1:30 AM – 9:30 AM[/*]
            [*]KST: January 18, 9:30 AM – 5:30 PM[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Console[list]
            [*]PST: January 25, 8 PM – January 26, 4 AM[/*]
            [*]CET: January 26, 5 AM – 1 PM[/*]
            [*]KST: January 26, 1 PM – 9 PM[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
Live Server Fixes
[list][*]Fixed the issue which caused you to receive damage and die after parachuting on to building roof edges on every map.[/*]
[*]Fixed the issue where the Secret Room Key was unable to open Secret Rooms in Taego and Paramo. Secret Room Keys are now available again on every mode.[/*]
[*]Fixed the untranslated Contraband Crate names for Colored Smoke Grenades in French.[/*]
[*](PC) Fixed the typo in Simplified Chinese for Taego's map selection description.[/*]
[*](Console) Fixed the issue where you could not hear the engine sounds from vehicles.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]MAP SERVICE[/b][/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]TEST SERVER[/b]
        [list]
            [*]Featured Map: Vikendi[/*]
            [*]Normal Match: Taego / Sanhok[list]
                    [*]AS region: Squad[/*]
                    [*]NA region: Squad – FPP[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*][b]LIVE SERVER[/b]
        [list]
            [*][b]MAP SELECTION REGION[/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Featured Map: Vikendi[/*]
                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Sanhok / [b]DESTON[/b][/*]
                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
            [*][b]RANDOM MAP REGION[/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel (15%) / Miramar (15%) / Taego (15%) / Sanhok (15%) / [b]VIKENDI (40%)[/b][/*]
                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
            [*][b]CONSOLE (XBOX, PLAYSTATION®)[/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel (15%) / Miramar (15%) / Taego (15%) / Sanhok (15%) / [b]VIKENDI (40%)[/b][/*]
                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]


[u]< Dev’s Comment >[/u]


[u]Vikendi has been available as a Featured Map since its first introduction back in Update #21.1. The Featured Map queue was sustained to allow players to enjoy our winter wonderland whenever they wished, but at the same time we received continuous reports from certain regions on issues with Normal Match matchmakings.[/u]


[u]We looked into matchmaking data and map usage rates based on these reports and proceeded to internal discussions – in conclusion, we decided it’d be best to prioritize active queues for a better gameplay experience for every player. Therefore, the Featured Map will be taken down from regions with random map selection starting this #21.2 live update.[/u]


[u]Instead, Vikendi will be added to the Normal Match pool with an increased matching rate of 40% so players will still be able to meet and play Vikendi more often. There are even more new updates for Vikendi this #21.2, so we encourage you to try them out and leave us your feedback as always![/u]



[b]※ PLEASE NOTE THE FEATURES AND UPDATES INTRODUCED BELOW MAY BE MODIFIED OR EVEN POSSIBLY REMOVED DUE TO REASONS SUCH AS BUGS, IN-GAME ISSUES, AND/OR COMMUNITY FEEDBACK. ALSO, IMAGES USED BELOW ARE PROVIDED AS VISUAL GUIDELINES – FEATURES MAY TURN OUT LOOKING DIFFERENT IN THE ACTUAL GAME AS BUILDS ARE CONTINUOUSLY DEVELOPED AND FIXED BEFORE THEY GO LIVE.[/b]

[h2][b]WORLD[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]VIKENDI[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]BLIZZARD ZONE[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Blizzard-Zone-1024x576.jpg[/img]

At some point within the howling devastation of snow, a severe snowstorm accompanied by whistling winds begin to ravage the silent ground. Dare to step into the whipping storm and you shall face pure numbness to your senses – welcome to the [b]BLIZZARD ZONE[/b].

[list]
    [*]Once you enter the Blizzard Zone…[list]
            [*]You will move slower.[/*]
            [*]You will receive consistent damage per second.[/*]
            [*]Your sight and soundplay will be hindered.[/*]
            [*]Vehicle control will be harder.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]A Blizzard Zone warning message along with its activated area UI on the world map will show up on your screen during the match.[/*]
    [*]Kill messages for the Blizzard Zone have been added.[/*]
    [*]Available in Normal Matches and Custom Matches.[list]
            [*]Available in Vikendi only.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Blizzard-Zone-Map-UI-1024x576.jpg[/img]


[u]< Dev’s Comment >[/u]


[u]The fierce Blizzard Zone is now available this update. This Vikendi-exclusive Zone has been designed based on the other maps’ Red/Black Zone’s features, activation phase and location, duration, size, damage, affected gameplay aspects, effect range and more. Watch out as the Blizzard Zone will definitely tatter your health, movement speed, soundplay and vision (including Scopes!) etc. so make sure to duck out of the hazardous Zone as soon as possible![/u]


[h3] [/h3]
[h3][b]SECRET ROOM[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Vikendi-Secret-Room-Key-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Scour deeply into the snow and perhaps you’ll stumble upon a [b]SECRET ROOM[/b] full of high-tier items.

[list]
    [*]Secret Rooms holding valuable items are scattered throughout the map.[/*]
    [*]Obtain the world spawn item [b]SECURITY KEY[/b] to open a Secret Room.[/*]
    [*]Available in Normal Matches and Custom Matches.[list]
            [*]Available in Vikendi only.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]


[u]< Dev’s Comment >[/u]


[u]Land your hands on items you won’t be able to casually find on the map! Here’s a tip: as the risks are relatively high when you wish to get back out of the Secret Room, we’ve installed something handy inside so try to find and use it for a safer getaway![/u]


[h3] [/h3]
[h3][b]REPAIR KITS[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Repair-Kit-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Have you damaged your hard-earned armor or vehicle? No worries, the three new Repair Kits have arrived to save the match.

[list]
    [*]3 Repair Kits have been added.[list]
            [*][b]HELMET REPAIR KIT [/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Repairs a helmet to full health.[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
            [*][b]ARMOR REPAIR KIT[/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Repairs armor to full health.[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
            [*][b]MECHANIC’S TOOLBOX[/b]
                [list]
                    [*]Repairs 500 health for vehicles.[list]
                            [*]Can not repair vehicle tires.[/*]
                        [/list]
                    [/*]
                    [*]Can repair every type of vehicle.[list]
                            [*]However, fully-drowned vehicles can not be repaired.[/*]
                        [/list]
                    [/*]
                    [*]Can only be used while inside the vehicle.[list]
                            [*]Can not be used while driving.[/*]
                            [*]Can not be used when holding your breath.[/*]
                        [/list]
                    [/*]
                    [*]More than one player can simultaneously repair a single vehicle.[list]
                            [*]However, repairs will be instantly canceled once the vehicle is fully repaired.[/*]
                        [/list]
                    [/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Repair Kits can not be used on destroyed helmets/vehicles.[/*]
    [*]Repair kits are consumable items.[/*]
    [*]Repair kits will world spawn with a relatively low spawn rate.[/*]
    [*]Available in Normal Matches and Custom Matches.[list]
            [*]Available in Vikendi only.[/*]
            [*]Repair Kits have been added to Custom Match – Sandbox mode.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]MULTIDROPS[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Vikendi-Multi-Drops-1024x576.jpg[/img]

The multidrops that were only witnessed in Taego will now be falling from Vikendi’s skies as well.

[list]
    [*]Multiple care packages holding high-tier weapons, armor, consumables, and more will be randomly dropped during a match.[/*]
    [*]Available in Normal Matches and Custom Matches.[list]
            [*]Available in Vikendi only.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h3] [/h3]
[h3][b]ADDITIONAL UPDATES[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Vikendi-Road-Signs-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Vikendi-exclusive road signs that can navigate you through the snow have been added throughout the map.[/*]
    [*]The unused Cable Car station has been removed from the northeast part of Coal Mine.[/*]
    [*]Item types have been updated and spawn spots have been increased in buildings with garages (that can only be opened using Crowbars).[/*]
    [*]A few vehicles have been found to spawn overlapping with foliage or fences, so we have slightly moved their spawn spots to a more open area.[/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]SANHOK[/b][/h3]
(1/20) WE ARE CURRENTLY LOOKING INTO AN ISSUE WHERE A LOSS OF GRASS WAS DISCOVERED AT A CERTAIN AREA IN SANHOK AFTER ITS UPDATES BELOW. THE FIX WILL BE APPLIED TO THE #22.1 UPDATE.

We’ve reflected a bunch of player and internal feedback regarding gameplay in Sanhok.

[list]
    [*][b]ASCENDERS[/b]have been added to Cave and rock mountains.[list]
            [*]Ascender Attachments will provided as starting items.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Inside-of-cave-added-Ascender-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]An additional bridge connecting the northwest island and east island (Bootcamp) has been added.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Additional-bridge-location-1-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]An additional bridge connecting the northwest island and southwest island (Ruins) has been added.[list]
            [*]Made the area’s water deeper to allow you to swim across.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Additional-bridge-location-2-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Sanhok themed billboards have been added throughout the map.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Sanhok-Billboards-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Sand terrain has been added to certain areas for a more convenient trek.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/General-structure-of-the-lake-islands-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Added even more general cover such as boulders and trees.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Additional-Trees-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Terrain and foliage texture have been generally improved.[/*]
    [*]As we say goodbye to the end-of-year holidays, LINE FRIENDS decorations also take their leave from Paradise Resort.[/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]TAEGO[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Additional boat spawn spots have been added to Ranked.[/*]
    [*]Boat spawn locations have been slightly shifted closer to land for easier access.[list]
            [*]This applies to both Normal and Ranked matches.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]SCREEN PING MARKER[/b][/h3]

A few improvements to the Screen Ping Marker.

[list]
    [*]Screen Ping Markers will be automatically deleted after 120 seconds (previously 30).[/*]
    [*]A player’s Screen Ping Marker will be instantly removed if they leave the match or lose connection.[/*]
[/list]
[h3][b]REPORT PLAYER[/b][/h3]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/In-game-report-window-1024x576.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]Previously, you were only able to report players who killed you or players you’re spectating. Now, you can report players who [b]ASSISTED [/b]in killing you.[list]
            [*]Click the Report button located on the bottom of your death screen → Select the assisted player.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]TRAINING MODE[/b][/h2]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/1vs1-Arena-Winning-Streak-UI-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Pretty good at beating up your friends at the 1v1 Arena? You can now show off your winning streak (WIN) starting this update!

[list]
    [*]Winning streaks at the 1v1 Arena will now be recorded after the live server update.[/*]
    [*]The winning streak UI will be shown on the following screens:[list]
            [*]Lower left of your screen during a 1v1 Arena match[/*]
            [*]Below your nickname on every Round Finished screen[/*]
            [*]Below your nickname on the Match Finished screen[/*]
            [*]Top of spectator’s screens[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Your winning streak will be reset to 0 once you lose a 1v1 Arena match.[/*]
    [*]A tied result will not affect your winning streak.[/*]
    [*]1v1 Arena matches that end due to the Training Mode session’s time out will result in a tie and not affect your winning streak.[/*]
    [*]Winning streaks are separately recorded for normal Training sessions and Custom Matches.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]UX/UI[/b][/h2]

Map-related UI has been added to Normal Matches and Ranked.

[list]
    [*]The name of the map you’re playing will show on the screen once you enter the starting island.[/*]
    [*]Map name, mode, and perspective information have been added to the top left screen of the world map.[list]
            [*]This information will be removed once you board the plane.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Available in Normal Matches and Ranked.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]LOBBY[/b][/h2]
[list]
    [*]Updated every map’s minimap image to the newest versions on the map selection page.[/*]
    [*]Certain information has been updated in Career – Overview (Ranked) – About Ranked.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]CRAFTER PASS: SPRING FEST 2023[/b][/h2]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Crafter-Pass-keyart-1024x576.jpg[/img]

A new Crafter Pass is prepared to host the first festival of the year. Read more details on the upcoming January Store Update announcement!

[h2][b]WORKSHOP[/b][/h2]

Added two new progressive weapon skins – the Azure Dragon – Beryl M762 and Black Tortoise – SKS – craftable [u]only[/u] through Special Crafting at the Workshop! Check out the full details on the upcoming January Store Update.

[list]
    [*][b]THE SPECIAL CRAFTING – SPRING FEST 2023 TAB WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR CRAFTING AND USING PURCHASED SPRING FEST 2023 MATERIALS UNTIL:[/b]
        [list]
            [*]PC[list]
                    [*]PST: March 6, 4 PM[/*]
                    [*]CET: March 7, 1 AM[/*]
                    [*]KST: March 7, 9 AM[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
            [*]Console[list]
                    [*]PDT: March 13, 9 PM[/*]
                    [*]CET: March 14, 5 AM[/*]
                    [*]KST: March 14, 1 PM[/*]
                [/list]
            [/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]PERFORMANCE[/b][/h2]
[list]
    [*]Improved physics engine performance to enhance game loading speeds.[/*]
    [*]Optimized memory using animation to enhance memory usage.[/*]
    [*](Console) Increased file reading speed on Xbox to improve in-game loading speeds such as parachute use, starting spectate, etc.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
[list]
    [*]General in-game bugs have been fixed.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the issue where you’re unable to use the Free Look feature while using an emote when you board the plane or when the plane is descending.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the issue where you get knocked out from falling when a crash occurs while you’re Following a player.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the issue where you are able to use Carry while using specific Emotes.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue where you are able to use primary weapons other than SMGs in the back seat of two-wheeled vehicles.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue where you are unable to revive the teammate you were carrying after you get knocked out and revived.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue where you and your teammates can jump abnormally high after pressing the Jump button continuously near a wall.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]WORLD[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed collision, texture, performance, and more general issues in Vikendi and Sanhok.[list]
            [*]Re-added an item spawn spot that was missing from a certain building in Vikendi, Winery.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where you teleport to a specific location after vaulting and withdrawing the Folded Shield inside a Cable Car.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where the sound of footsteps in a certain bathroom in Vikendi sounded like footsteps on dirt.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where throwables and ammo passed through one side of the flag in Vikendi, Cosmodrome.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the air vents’ animation error in Vikendi, Train Station.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the incorrectly used texture of a certain staircase in Vikendi.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where you receive damage when landing on a signboard in Vikendi, Train Station.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where throwables can not pass through windows in Vikendi.[/*]
            [*]Fixed the issue where you receive damage and die after parachuting on to a building roof in Sanhok.[/*]
        [/list]
    [/*]
    [*]Fixed the issue where the last Safe Zones are being set in the outer, unavailable areas of the map in Paramo.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]UX/UI[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed the issue where the Daily Mission count increases when you complete the Daily Mission Contender mission.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the issue where a certain design was not shown on the map selection page.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the spacing issue in the Daily Supply Mission page.[/*]
    [*]Fixed the Japanese error in Training Mode – ESC – ‘Exit Training Mode’.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue of hearing the Store item sound effect when you hover your mouse over a specific location on the screen when another window is covering the game in Windowed mode.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue where a sound effect is heard when you hover or click the bottom UI of Survival Level/Last Weapon Kill/Last Medal Earned in the Career – Overview page.[/*]
    [*](PC) Fixed the issue where your character still has the Backpack equipped even when you remove the equipment previews for Preset slots 1~3 in Customize.[/*]
    [*](Console) Fixed the issue of the swapped Pickup Item/Replace Attachment keybindings.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]ITEMS & SKINS[/h3]

※ Clipping issue: Graphics that are shown outside the visible part of an image/object.

[list]

title: DEV TALK: VIKENDI REBORN - ADDITIONAL Q&A
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:
Hello players!


Have you enjoyed our last Dev Talk: Vikendi Reborn live show?


Our PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS team was grateful for all your meaningful questions and we hope we were able to quench most of your curiosities.


However, due to time limitations, we were also aware many questions went unanswered.


So today we’ve prepared an additional Q&A session that’ll respond to some more Vikendi Reborn questions!


[b]OUR PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS RESPONDENTS[/b]


– TAEHYUN KIM, PRODUCTION DIRECTOR OF IN-GAME


– SANGKYUN KIM, PRODUCTION DIRECTOR OF OUT-GAME


– YINJEONG JUNG, WORLD TEAM LEAD


– SEUNGKYU KIM, IN-GAME UNIT, LEVEL DESIGN PART LEAD


– GIHWAN PARK, IN-GAME UNIT, SENIOR LEVEL DESIGNER


– DAHYUN KWON, IN-GAME UNIT, BALANCE PART LEAD


– YOONJI CHUNG, IN-GAME UNIT, BALANCE PART

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/%ED%94%84%EB%A1%9C%ED%95%84_%EA%B9%80%EC%8A%B9%EA%B7%9C_name-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[b]Q. I BELIEVE GAMEPLAY STYLES DISTINCTLY DIFFER PER MAP, ESPECIALLY WHEN ENVIRONMENTAL FEATURES SEEM TO GREATLY AFFECT THE BATTLEGROUNDS. WHAT GAMEPLAY STYLES DID THE TEAM EXPECT FOR VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. (SEUNGKYU KIM) Vehicle play and highland advantages are definitely important factors for the traditional 8x8km sized maps, but Vikendi Reborn also brings you a distinct gameplay style with its unique geographical and environmental factors. Seizing the highlands and diving for cover would be helpful in the northern part of the map, and being strategic and using slopes to hide vehicles or using items such as smoke grenades, Folded Shield, etc. in the relatively flat, southern area. Furthermore, you can also use the Cable Cars to make it harder for enemies to predict your next move.


[b]Q. HAVE YOU INTENTIONALLY CREATED HOT DROP LOCATIONS FOR VIKENDI REBORN TO LURE GROUPS OF PLAYERS? AND WHERE ARE THESE HOT DROPS?[/b]


A. (SEUNGKYU KIM) The main hot drop would be the Train Station located in the middle of the map. The Observatory, Lumber Yard, and Dinoland could also be popular hot drops. Big cities and towns are scattered on the outer area of the map, and large house sets are positioned near the center of the map to lure in more players.


[b]Q. DO YOU HAVE ANY AREA RECOMMENDATIONS OR HELPFUL TIPS FOR NEWBIES?[/b]


A. (GIHWAN PARK) I’d like to recommend the Coal Mine located in the northwest. It is a town consisted of large container buildings holding relatively easy-to-loot items, and as it’s located in the outer area so we’d expect fewer enemies to accompany your fall. Additionally, it’s easier to move on to the inner areas of the map once you’re done at the Coal Mine. And what’s best, if you don’t have a vehicle, there’s a train right at the entrance – and if you happen to miss your ride, there’s always the romantic Cable Cars.


[b]Q. I NOTICED RELATIVELY UNUSED ITEMS SUCH AS THE JAMMER PACK SEEMED TO BE USEFUL IN DESTON. DID YOU HAVE ANY OTHER SPECIFIC ITEMS PLANNED OR DISCUSSED FOR VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. (GIHWAN PARK) For Vikendi, we expect a lot of engagements to occur on land. Therefore the BZ Grenade or the Folded Shield could be frequently used – you can throw BZ Grenades at enemies hiding behind boulders or trees, which we already often witness among our players. The Folded Shield is also intended to help you protect yourself especially when you’re fighting on vulnerable land. For example, you can install the Folded Shield beside your vehicle, or perhaps block the open entrance of the Cable Car you’re riding.


[b]Q. YOU’VE ADDED MANY NEW FEATURES TO VIKENDI REBORN SUCH AS THE BLIZZARD ZONE, ASCENDERS, WEATHER, CABLE CARS, AND MORE. BUT I’M WORRIED THIS BIG UPDATE MAY ALSO BRING IN-GAME BUGS OR LAGS. HAS THE TEAM COME UP WITH ANY PLANS TO PREVENT THIS FROM HAPPENING?[/b]


A. (YINJEONG JUNG) Vikendi was released after proven world performance through profiling, asset memory/type optimization, and more. Actually, there used to be an additional Cable Car route installed to the map but we removed it as we discovered risks during our map performance test in the early stages of development. We are continuously running multiple tests and analyzing possible risks to stabilize your gameplay experience as best we can.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/%ED%94%84%EB%A1%9C%ED%95%84_%EC%A0%95%EC%9D%80%EC%A0%95_name-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[b]Q. I THINK THE MOUNTAIN BIKE BRINGS A LOT OF FUN TO PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS! ARE YOU POSSIBLY THINKING OF ADDING SKIS OR SNOWBOARDS TO VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. (GIHWAN PARK / SEUNGKYU KIM) Skis or snowboards were included in our early development ideas, but we unfortunately have no current plans to add them to this update.


[b]Q. VIKENDI REBORN’S COMEBACK BR SYSTEM SEEMS A LOT DIFFERENT FROM TAEGO’S AS PLAYERS ARE GIVEN THREE COMEBACK BR OPPORTUNITIES. NOT ONLY THAT, ITEMS WILL NOT RESET PER COMEBACK BR PHASE. COULD YOU LET US KNOW YOUR INTENTIONS TO THIS CHANGE, AND WHAT YOU’D EXPECT FROM YOUR PLAYERS?[/b]


A. (YOONJI CHUNG) Since you’ll be using the same arena for each phase, we believed it’d be more realistic to leave traces of the previous battle. We also wish to witness more dynamic gameplay patterns by creating different environments in the same arena. But as players in the last Comeback BR may suffer from a lack of items, we are showering Comeback BR Multidrops every phase and leaving previous deathboxes/multidrops as they are. Remember, only the brave who dares to try for the Multidrops can leave the Comeback BR arena with rich loot!


[b]Q. NEW WEAPONS SUCH AS THE G36C AND MP5K WERE PREVIOUSLY RELEASED IN VIKENDI. WOULD THERE BE NEW WEAPONS FOR VIKENDI REBORN AS WELL?[/b]


A. (DAHYUN KWON) We currently do not have plans to release new weapons for Vikendi Reborn.


[b]Q. WILL THERE BE A WEAPON BALANCE UPDATE FOR VIKENDI REBORN? I’M CURIOUS TO KNOW WHAT’S BEEN DISCUSSED REGARDING WEAPON AND SPAWN BALANCES, AND IF YOU HAVE ANY FUTURE PLANS.[/b]


A. (DAHYUN KWON) Since weapon balance updates affect every map, we do not have specific balance updates planned for Vikendi Reborn. As Vikendi Reborn expanded to a 8x8km map, looting spots have also been adjusted and spawn balances have been measured in coordination with Ranked’s system to provide a more consistent experience. We’ll continue to look into spawn rates and decide whether to proceed with balance adjustments for future updates.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/%ED%94%84%EB%A1%9C%ED%95%84_%EB%B0%95%EA%B8%B0%ED%99%98_name-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[b]Q. WILL OTHER MAPS ALSO RECEIVE A REMAKE UPDATE? CAN SMALLER MAPS ALSO BE EXPANDED TO BIGGER SIZED MAPS?[/b]


A. (TAEHYUN KIM) As of now, we are not planning any huge remakes. We believe small maps have their distinct, entertaining aspects thanks to their size – therefore, we are also not planning to expand any smaller maps either.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/%ED%94%84%EB%A1%9C%ED%95%84_%EA%B9%80%ED%83%9C%ED%98%84_name-1-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[b]Q. WE WERE RECENTLY INTRODUCED TO AN UPDATE TO THE NORMAL MATCH MATCHMAKING SYSTEM; DO YOU HAVE ANY UPDATES FOR A FEATURE TO SHOW US WHAT OUR MMR IS?[/b]


A. (SANGKYUN KIM) It is quite rare for a game company to reveal their internal MMR and its calculation logic. We do not have any plans to implement this feature.

[h3][b]QUESTIONS ALREADY ANSWERED DURING THE LIVE SHOW[/b][/h3]

For those who missed our Dev Talk: Vikendi Reborn, we have organized the questions and answers covered during the live show.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/%ED%94%84%EB%A1%9C%ED%95%84_%EA%B9%80%EC%83%81%EA%B7%A0_name-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[b]Q. DO WE RECEIVE DAMAGE WHEN WE’RE INSIDE A BUILDING WITHIN THE BLIZZARD ZONE?[/b]


A. For a realistic depiction of winter’s brutality, we have designed the Blizzard Zone to affect players’ health, movement speed, etc. even when they’re inside a building.


[b]Q. WILL THE OLD SNOWMOBILE RETURN TO VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. As you may have already seen in our teaser video, the Snowmobile has returned even better and faster.


[b]Q. IS THERE A POSSIBILITY THAT VIKENDI WILL BE ADDED TO RANKED AND ESPORTS?[/b]


A. It’s difficult to provide a firm answer, but it may be highly possible if players consistently enjoy playing Vikendi.


[b]Q. ARE BUILDINGS ADDED TO GLACIER AREAS? HOW ARE THE BUILDING OBJECTS STRUCTURED?[/b]


A. Lab Camps (where researchers work) are scattered around the glacier areas, along with the Observatory located on the right.


[b]Q. AREN’T THERE TOO MANY COMEBACK BR PHASES IN VIKENDI? WHAT’LL BE CHANGED FROM THE CURRENT COMEBACK BR SYSTEM?[/b]


A. There is only one Comeback BR Phase in Taego, but players in Vikendi can enter up to three Comeback BR Phases during the first phase of the match. Therefore, players who die in the main arena will no longer have to wait for so long.


[b]Q. I’VE NOTICED A HUGE RIDGE PLACED BETWEEN THE COMEBACK BR ARENA AND THE MAIN ISLAND. WHAT IS THAT FOR? [/b]


A. A snowy ridge has been placed to naturally divide the main arena with the Comeback BR arena.


[b]Q. IS THERE A NEW GHILLIE SUIT FOR VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. You’ll be able to find the white Ghillie Suit for Vikendi. 


[b]Q. CAN WE ENGAGE FROM CABLE CARS MOVING OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS?[/b]


A. Panzerfausts will most likely spawn in Cable Cars, so make sure to gear up and engage when you can!


[b]Q. WILL COMEBACK BRS BE IMPLEMENTED TO OTHER MAPS?[/b]


A. We are monitoring and reflecting player/internal feedback to further improve the Comeback BR system. The Comeback BR can be added to other maps once significant improvements are made.


[b]Q. THE SNOW IN VIKENDI HAD ORIGINALLY BEEN REMOVED DUE TO NEGATIVE COMMUNITY FEEDBACK. CAN WE EXPECT SOME IMPROVEMENTS SINCE THE SNOW TERRAIN’S COMING BACK?[/b]


A. We were concerned about Vikendi’s map theme and community feedback when we ended up removing the snow from Vikendi. As we add the snow back into Vikendi Reborn, we utilized various environmental aspects, the clouds’ shadows, etc. to reduce the eye strain players may receive.


[b]Q. ARE THE SIZE OF BLIZZARD ZONES RANDOM? [/b]


A. The size of Blizzard Zones are fixed, and the spawn period will be identical to the Red Zone’s. The number and spawn location of Blizzard Zones are random. 


[b]Q. WILL THERE BE A SECRET CAVE IN VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. There will be Secret Rooms in Vikendi Reborn. Each location will be displayed on the minimap, but why ruin the fun when you can discover them on your own?


[b]Q. WILL HELMETS (LEVEL 3) WORLD SPAWN IN VIKENDI REBORN AS WELL?[/b]


A. Helmets (Level 3) will not world spawn, but Molotov Cocktails will have a high spawn rate to enhance Vikendi’s wintery traits. 


[b]Q. WILL THE THERMAL SCOPE BE ADDED TO VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. The moonlight weather update is upcoming along with the Thermal Scope.


[b]Q. ARE THERE ANY PLANS TO RELEASE NEW SURVIVOR PASSES / PROGRESSIVE WEAPON SKINS WITH THE VIKENDI REBORN CONCEPT?[/b]


A. No plans for progressive weapon skins, but definitely yes for a new Survivor Pass. We’ll also be adding some end-of-year holiday items.


[b]Q. DO YOU HAVE ANY ADDITIONAL COMMENTS REGARDING THE RECENT MMR UPDATE?[/b]


We first wish to apologize to the players. We tried our best, but issues occurred and we face disappointment as well – we are currently looking into resolving the issue with high priority. We communicate and disclose our data with our players, but we hope you understand it is difficult to disclose specific information regarding cheat programs. We are looking into improving our current MMR system as we discovered several spots that could be better. We will do our best to provide our players a safe gameplay environment. Thank you for your feedback.


[b]Q. HOW LONG DID IT TAKE TO CREATE VIKENDI REBORN? [/b]


A. Approximately a year, starting from concept creation to actual development.


[b]Q. CAN WE OBTAIN ITEMS ONLY FOUND IN CARE PACKAGES WITH THE NEW CROWBAR INTERACTION SYSTEM?[/b]


A. Care Package items will not spawn in places that can be opened with Crowbars. But other valuable items are definitely waiting to be looted!


[b]Q. ARE THERE ANY UNIQUE FACTORS WHEN DRIVING IN VIKENDI REBORN?[/b]


A. With the Vikendi Reborn update, vehicle tires such as the Zima, etc. have been replaced with sturdy tires prepared for winter.


[b]Q. SINCE WE NOW HAVE THE BLIZZARD ZONE IN VIKENDI REBORN, CAN OTHER ZONES LIKE SANDSTORMS OR TORNADOES APPEAR IN OTHER MAPS AS WELL?[/b]


A. Ideas such as these are always a part of our plans, but the stage where we can test out their feasibility is where we need more time.


[b]Q. DO DEVS REFER TO PARTNERS’ CONTENT WHEN DEVELOPING MAPS?[/b]


A. Our devs all love PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, so they of course enjoy watching and sharing our Partners’ videos and streams. 


And this is it for our additional Q&A for Vikendi Reborn!


We hope your questions have been answered – don’t forget to check out the [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/patch-notes/patch-notes-update-21-1/]#21.1 Patch Notes[/url] for more details on Vikendi Reborn and its new features!


We’ve prepared bunches of new content for Vikendi Reborn, so whip out your parachutes and get ready to land into the snow!


And as always, we appreciate your feedback. See you soon at the next update.


Thank you.


PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: FIGHT THE WINTER! HASHTAG EVENT
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:

How’s surviving the new winter in Vikendi going?

Explore every Vikendi area possible, capture and upload an intense moment of your training online to earn a chance to receive [b]G-COIN[/b].


Read on for the full training guide.

title: HOLIDAY WITH LINE FRIENDS: SANHOK, BINGO EVENT, AND STORE ITEMS!
author: SteveTheHappyWhale
contents:
Hello players!


We’ve invited some special guests to Paradise Resort for this end-of-year holiday: [b]LINE FRIENDS[/b]!


This update, a triple LINE FRIENDS combo is prepared to create some unforgettable, festive memories with you all before we head off to a new, refreshing start.


Let’s check out all the details below.

[h2][b]COMBO 1. LINE FRIENDS AT SANHOK, PARADISE RESORT[/b][/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]INTRODUCING LINE FRIENDS[/b][/*]
[/list]

LINE FRIENDS is a global creative studio creating a new culture through various contents. The original characters of LINE FRIENDS are BROWN, CONY, SALLY, CHOCO, LEONARD, EDWARD, MOON, JAMES, BOSS, JESSICA, and PANGYO.



Dive down to Sanhok and meet BROWN, CONY, SALLY, CHOCO, and more LINE FRIENDS in their wintery dreamland located in the midst of the jungle.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/PUBG_BG_Line_Screenshots_1@16x9-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Say hi to SALLY and her choo-choo train as they revolve around the magical snow globe, where BROWN and CONY enjoy their cherry-on-the-top date.

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/PUBG_BG_Line_Screenshots_6@16x9-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Colliding with the moving train won’t hurt, but make sure you apologize to SALLY if you wish to keep your stay at Paradise Resort!

[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/PUBG_BG_Line_Screenshots_7@16x9-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Feel free to book a night or two at Paradise Resort and enjoy your luxurious stay with LINE FRIENDS, but be aware the condition of your room is not guaranteed due to unexpected havoc that may be caused by other visitors looking for that Chicken Dinner.

[h2][b]COMBO 2. LINE FRIENDS BINGO![/b][/h2]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/A%EC%95%88Ingame_1920-1024x576.png[/img]

Care to join LINE FRIENDS for an old game of Bingo? Complete daily missions, obtain tickets, and cross out Bingo lines to claim LINE FRIENDS and Vikendi rewards!

[h3][b]HOW LINE FRIENDS BINGO! WORKS[/b][/h3]

contents:
[b]21.1 Highlights[/b]

[previewyoutube=pH5Qby9FE-I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]FPP Mode[/b][/h2]
(PC) The FPP queue for Solo, Duo, and Squad will no longer be available in KR/JP regions. Not only have we needed to align our available services with other platforms, but we’ve also confirmed the current FPP matchmaking in these regions were not striving enough to maintain the queue.

[b]※ [b]Please keep in mind the features and updates shown below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. Also, the images shown below are provided as visual guidelines – they may look different in the actual game as builds are continuously developed and fixed before they go live.[/b][/b]

[h2][b]Vikendi Reborn[/b][/h2]
It all started with the sudden climate change ravaging Vikendi’s lands that once flourished with greenery and crystal clear skies. Habitants of Vikendi were forced to retreat the area as blizzards drove cities to the point they were no longer able to function. No traces of life were to be found for months.

Now a desolate snowfield, the northern part of Vikendi is covered with sheets of snow – meanwhile in the south, glimpses of new land begin to peep out; survivors of the cold start to gather back, clutching on to desperate hopes of a new domain.

Starting now, Vikendi commences its comeback as a harsh winterland and is prepared to pit players into its ruthless depths of snow.

Welcome to the rebirth of Vikendi.

[u][b]Test out Vikendi Reborn TODAY as soon as the Test Server opens![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4f188f3e7492f6c150cecd99a8400ec174a3482e.jpg[/img]


[list]    [*][b]Vikendi…[/b]        [list]            [*]Is available as a Featured Map.[/*]            [*]Has expanded from a 6x6km map to a [b]8x8km[/b] map.[/*]            [*]Is composed of various environments such as glaciers, snowfields, and greenery.[/*]            [*]Presents sharp slopes and heavy snow in the north, with relatively less snow and flatter terrain in the south.[/*]            [*]Features [b]Clear [/b]and [b]Cloudy [/b]weathers.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7c0fb1f525f24209a3695b954668d1b60bc71e9c.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
As we resurrect the snowy concept of Vikendi, we also wanted to respond to several in-game issues our community had faced before our previous Vikendi’s remaster. One of the main feedback regarded the restrain players felt on their eyes due to the whiteness of Vikendi’s snow when playing the map for more than a certain period of time. To resolve this issue, we’ve conducted continuous tests by adjusting the overall colors of the map and even utilizing the clouds to cast shadows over the snow to reduce whiteness.

We’ve also adjusted the overall topography of the map to remove the disadvantages and overly advantageous factors that once existed in specific areas.

Always remember that PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team will continue to monitor your feedback after this update, so keep those suggestions and opinions coming! See you at the revitalized winter wonderland!

[b]Make sure to visit the Vikendi Website ([url=https://vikendi.pubg.com/]https://vikendi.pubg.com/[/url]) and head off on a tour through Vikendi’s new landmarks, features, and many more![/b]
[h3][b]New Feature: Cable Cars[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/06b43e7024fd3ae048a465db85ec5ad722dc26dc.jpg[/img]

Introducing the new transportation system: [b]Cable Cars[/b]. Round trip fares will cost you 300 BP.
[list]    [*]There are two routes for each station, with only one Cable Car running per route.[/*]    [*]Cable Cars move automatically.[list]            [*]You can board Cable Cars once Cable Cars arrive to their station.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Cable Cars will stop briefly at each station before moving on to the opposite route.[/*]    [*]You may also board Cable Cars with a vehicle.[/*]    [*]Available modes[list]            [*]Only available in Vikendi.[/*]            [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
A new transportation system: the Cable Car has arrived to present you new gameplay dynamics! Face off enemies traveling the opposite Cable Car route, or launch surprise attacks to enemies on the ground midair! Panzerfausts will also most likely spawn in most Cable Cars, so why not blast your enemies off their leisure Cable Car ride?
[h3][b]New Area: Lab Camp[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e4c40d1699ccfce64b4c97be05f05d66701a4a50.jpg[/img]

Meet the new [b]Lab Camp[/b], a new area holding high value items in the northwest!
[list]    [*]Lab Camps are scattered around the frozen lake in the northwest.[list]            [*]Each Lab Camp differs in size and structure.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Supply Drops[/b], a new type of crate spawning certain items with certain probability distributions, will spawn in Lab Camps.[list]            [*][b]Yellow Supply Drops[/b]: Boost items, Throwables, M79, or Level 3 Equipment may spawn.[/*]            [*][b]Red Supply Drops[/b]: Weapons available in Vikendi (including ammo) may spawn.[list]                    [*]You may even find Care Package weapons if you’re very lucky![/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Blue Supply Drops[/b]: Attachments available in Vikendi.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Alarms are installed in certain Lab Camps. They will immediately activate once items are extracted from Supply Drops.[list]            [*]Activated alarms will emit a loud siren and red lights for a certain period of time.[/*]            [*]Interacting with Supply Drops [b]while [/b]the alarm is activated will not restart the alarm’s activation.[list]                    [*]Interacting with Supply Drops [b]after [/b]an alarm’s activation time will reactivate the alarm.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
Introducing a new area that can be used as another loot-rich area for players. Lab Camps are located around the frozen lake, where building s are relatively hard to find.

But everything can’t just simply go as planned – make sure to take items from those Supply Drops as fast as you can before you excite that sensitive alarm!

And if you’re extra lucky today, you might be able to find super rare Supply Drops that hold even more and better loot. Good luck!
[h3][b]New System: Comeback BR[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7d99f8ed25ad38e881e588f02eafa6d5813463ee.jpg[/img]

It’s not Better Luck Next Time when you die during a match. Comeback BR has arrived to Vikendi to present you not only one, but [b]three [/b]opportunities!
[list]    [*]Players will spectate their team member(s) once they die during specific phases of the match.[/*]    [*]Once Comeback BR’s countdown is over, a loading screen will pop up and move the appropriate players to the Comeback BR arena.[list]            [*]Every player’s health will reset.[/*]            [*]Every item/equipment/boost a player had before death will be removed.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]During a Comeback BR Phase,[list]            [*][b]Players who survive [/b]will return to the match with every item they obtained in the arena.[list]                    [*]A total of [b]three [/b]Comeback BR Phases will proceed during a single match.[list]                            [*]The first, second, and third Comeback BR Phases will proceed consecutively during certain phases of the match. The Comeback BR participant recruitment phase will be shown on the top left of the world map screen.[/*]                            [*]Players who [b]only [/b]die during a Comeback BR Phase participant recruitment phase will be able to participate in a Comeback BR Phase.[/*]                            [*]After a player returns to a match after a Comeback BR Phase and dies again, they’ll be able to join the next Comeback BR Phase if they die within the participant recruitment phase.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Players who die [/b]will spectate their teammates until the next Comeback BR Phase.[list]                    [*]Players who die in the first/second Comeback BR Phase are provided the opportunity to retry in the next Phase.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]A dead player waiting for a Comeback BR Phase to start will instantly lose the match if [b]every teammate dies[/b] in the match and/or if they[b] quit the match[/b].[/*]    [*]A [b]Comeback BR Multidrop[/b] will be available per Comeback BR Phase.[/*]    [*]A separate Blue Zone from the match will be activated in Comeback BR.[/*]    [*]Various items (including Backpacks) will spawn in the arena.[list]            [*]A single arena will be used for every Comeback BR Phase per match. Therefore, item spawns/deathboxes/destroyed structures will not reset per Phase.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
We believed this update was the appropriate timing for us to implement Taego’s Comeback BR feature to Vikendi.

Additional adjustments have been made to Vikendi’s Comeback BR based on feedback we’ve received on Taego’s current Comeback BR system such as providing not only one but several opportunities to achieve that chicken, adjusting the countdown time, reducing the arena’s size, adding Backpacks and more items, etc. for a possibly better combat experience. Oh, and don’t forget the multi care packages falling from the sky!
[h3][b]New Features: Map Utility Items, Ascenders, and Ascender Towers[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/865d92cd1f4af5e65f4c55e7be18ee06df6fa356.jpg[/img]

The [b]features only available in Deston[/b] have set their foot in Vikendi.
[list]    [*]Map Utility Items will be provided to every player in Vikendi.[list]            [*]Ascender Attachment[/*]            [*]Utility Parachute[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ascenders have been attached to buildings in Observatory and Coal Mine.[/*]    [*]Ascender Towers are located throughout the map.[/*][/list][h3][b]New Feature: Fuel Pump[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4d626e907921d6b44db4a93751b6aaa834fba4af.jpg[/img]

The Deston-only [b]Fuel Pumps[/b] are also joining the winter party. Fill up your vehicle or make Fuel Pumps explode to make your enemies fly into the snow!
[list]    [*]Vikendi’s wintery concept has been applied to Vikendi’s Fuel Pumps.[/*][/list][h3][b]New System: Crowbar Interaction[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d74ef2adc8e49717cf838a22ae61c7a116bc7141.jpg[/img]

Players may now use [b]Crowbars to interact with various map objects[/b].
[list]    [*]Cabinets scattered throughout the map can be opened with Crowbars to obtain various items.[/*]    [*]Crowbars can also be used to open locked buildings, which are located throughout Vikendi.[/*]    [*]Crowbars must be equipped to Interact with cabinets/locked buildings.[/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
We’ve added an interaction feature to an existing weapon to create new gameplay experiences. Unlock locked building doors for a new route or open cabinets for more items! [u](Since we’re all fans of Pans, why not create a new club for Crowbars?)[/u]
[h3][b]Vehicle: The Return of the Snowmobile[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7e1ced0c0d1d675da6cd86c5952af355535042da.jpg[/img]

Streak through the snow with the [b]Snowmobile[/b].
[list]    [*]Carries up to 2 players.[/*]    [*]Max speed: 120km/h[/*]    [*]Movement speed will no longer decrease on flat surfaces/concrete/roads/hard ground.[/*]    [*]Players can now shoot from the driver’s seat with handguns.[/*]    [*]Available modes[list]            [*]Snowmobiles will only spawn in Vikendi.[/*]            [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
How could we possibly leave out the Snowmobile from the land of snow? The popular Snowmobile has returned even better and faster this update – we’ve improved several factors such as its driving experience on different lands, etc. based on both community and internal feedback.
[h3][b]Train[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/06b43e7024fd3ae048a465db85ec5ad722dc26dc.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Train noise has been reduced by approximately 30%.[/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
We’ve reduced the noise the train creates based on current gameplay feedback. And I’ve heard rumors you’d be able to board vehicles to the train as well..?

[h2][b]World[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Erangel[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b9c1adb6fe5a4d3dcfd72f543f954453ec31b249.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Players can now board vehicles to the ferry.[/*]    [*]Several improvements have been made to the ferry and pier for a more flexible vehicle navigation.[list]            [*]Certain objects have been removed from the ferry and pier.[/*]            [*]The widths of certain bridges have expanded.[/*]            [*]Planks have been added to parts where the height of the ferry and pier differed.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ferry routes have been added to the minimap.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/01d4ec42da15f671f79bfe28675e325364a4c02c.png[/img]

[list]    [*]A new building has been added to the building below Hospital.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e6d8b452340deb5476ecdb1218065da937b0dea2.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]The location of fences have been readjusted.[/*]    [*]New fences have been added.[/*]    [*]The current building has been moved slightly to the left.[/*]    [*]Streetlights and benches have been added to the area.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c6b11d7f54d336d3199e3b6733aa12c99036421f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Sanhok[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cec94b2fcac7b091b0d2cc9f4693d7fc11aafabf.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Celebrate the holidays with BROWN, CONY, SALLY, CHOCO and more as LINE FRIENDS land in Sanhok, Paradise Resort![list]            [*]Players will not receive damage from colliding with the moving toy train.[/*]            [*]The toy train will project a [u]choo choo![/u] noise.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]World Decorations[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PGC 2022 and Neymar Jr. objects have been removed from all maps.[/*][/list][h3][b]Temporary Issue[/b][/h3]
There is an issue where the Secret Room Key is unable to open Secret Rooms in Taego and Paramo. We are currently investigating the issue but have unfortunately confirmed the fix required more time and will be difficult to apply this update. [b]Therefore, Secret Room Keys will not spawn in Taego and Paramo during Update 21.1[/b].
[list]    [*]This applies to every mode.[/*]    [*]This issue will be fixed in Update 21.2.[/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2][h3][b]Vehicle Balance[/b][/h3]

Adjustments have been made to certain vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2da276c64a9c0399d9d46d6c6b918a5f7f200f6a.jpg[/img]


[list]    [*][b]Zima[/b]        [list]            [*]Health: 900 → 1200[/*]            [*]The Trunk feature has been added.[list]                    [*]Trunk capacity: 250[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Vehicle movement and control has improved on snow/ice terrain.[/*]            [*]An area of the vehicle relatively vulnerable to extra damage has been slightly reduced.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Porter[/b]        [list]            [*]Health: 1200 → 1500[/*]            [*]General speed has increased.[list]                    [*]Max speed has not changed.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Vehicle control has improved.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Pony Coupe[/b]        [list]            [*]General speed and torque in low RPM range has been slightly decreased.[list]                    [*]Max speed has not changed.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*] [b]MiniBus[/b]        [list]            [*]Health: 2000 → 2500[/*]            [*]Torque in low RPM range has increased.[list]                    [*]Max speed (normal) has increased to 87km/h.[/*]                    [*]Max speed (boost) has not changed.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Vehicle control has improved.[/*]            [*]The vehicle’s tires’ health has slightly increased.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]UAZ[/b]        [list]            [*]Torque in low RPM range has increased.[list]                    [*]Max speed has not changed.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Mirado[/b]        [list]            [*]Torque in low RPM range has increased.[list]                    [*]Max speed has not changed.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Vehicle control has improved.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/zima-1-1024x576.jpg[/img][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
Balance adjustments have been applied to certain vehicles based on in-game graphs and continuous player/internal feedback.

We’ve first boosted performances of vehicles which were not used as often in Vikendi by improving their control/movement when running on top of ice/snow terrain.

We’ve also received frequent feedback that the relatively popular Zima seemed more vulnerable to damage (compared to other vehicles). The Zima’s health itself is not considered to be on the lower side of the graph, but we confirmed it was comparatively lower than other 4-by-4 vehicles. Thus, not only have we increased its health, but we’ve sprinkled extra features to the Zima this update.

Furthermore, the Porter and MiniBus showed comparatively low usage rates – therefore, performance improvements have been applied to these vehicles as well to hopefully boost their popularity. There was also a sharp contrast in popularity between the Pony Coupe and Porter in Taego, so the Porter is granted extra health and better control while the Pony Coupe faces slower speeds.

Lastly, to respond to the feedback on certain vehicles’ low speed in low RPM ranges, we’ve increased the torque for certain vehicles such as the UAZ, Mirado, etc.
[h3][b]Animation Improvements[/b][/h3]
Improvements have been made to certain character movements.
[list]    [*]Reduced the character’s rather unnatural shoulder motions when sprinting with a weapon equipped.[/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev’s Comment[/b][/*][/list]
As we closely monitored our players’ feedback after our animation refresh back in Update #19.2, we’ve consistently received feedback that the shoulder movements were particularly looking rather unnatural. After thorough internal discussions, we’ve decided to repolish the animation mentioned above.

The updated animation is briefly featured in the 21.1 Highlights above, so make sure to check it out and share us your thoughts!

title: PUBG DEV TALK: VIKENDI REBORN - LIVESTREAM
author: OneTrueSteve
contents:
Hello players!


We’ve already told you through our Dev Plan 2022 that Vikendi will be going through a large-scale revamp that includes new features, shifts to terrain/areas, and more.


Vikendi received many love as PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS’ unique wintery map, but it also went through various in-game issues during its service. Thus, we decided to withdraw Vikendi from the pool for a while and work on improving several aspects of the map.


After months of improvements, the overhauled Vikendi is now almost ready to reveal itself to you all. But before its grand update, we’d love to meet you via our upcoming [u][b]“PUBG DEV TALK: VIKENDI REBORN”[/b][/u] a livestream where the devs will talk about our new winter wonderland!


In the upcoming livestream, we will explain what’s changed and why we’ve decided to remake Vikendi. There will also be a live Q&A session, so make sure to stay tuned!

[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2][h3][b]Vehicle Spawn Balance in Normal Matches[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a2049bf242d6a10614844b16ceb466c67570fcec.jpg[/img]

Vehicle spawns have been adjusted in Erangel and Miramar for Normal Matches.
[list]    [*]Erangel[list]            [*]UAZ: Increased by approximately 20%.[/*]            [*]Dacia: Increased by approximately 26%.[/*]            [*]Aquarail: Decreased by approximately 22%.[/*]            [*]Buggy: Decreased by approximately 11%.[/*]            [*]Boat: Decreased by approximately 23%.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Miramar[list]            [*]Pickup: Increased by approximately 8%.[/*]            [*]Mirado: Increased by approximately 18%.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev Comment[/b][/*][/list]
Based on player feedback on vehicle spawns in large maps like Erangel and Miramar, we’ve increased the spawn rates of relatively hard to find vehicles.
[h3][b]Vehicle Skin[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Removed the special effect when equipping Basic vehicle skins.[list]            [*]Pressing the Limited Interaction key will immediately equip Basic vehicle skins.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The special effect for Special vehicle skins will still apply.[/*][/list][h3][b](PC) Radio Message[/b][/h3][list]    [*]The key binding option for Inventory-related Radio Messages has been added to Settings.[/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev Comment[/b][/*][/list]
The option that was missing from the settings from the last patch is being added this update.

You may customize your keys in [b]Settings → Key Bindings[/b].
[h3][b]Folded Shield[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d7660cdc37ac1899b19c4366091e24f30c5497ce.jpg[/img]


Several improvements have been made to the Folded Shield based on our players’ feedback.

[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td][b]Reuse Item[/b][/td]                [td]Unable[/td]                [td]Able[/td]                [td]You can now put an installed Folded Shield back into your Inventory.
 *Item durability does not reset.[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td][b]Cancel Installation[/b][/td]                [td]Unable[/td]                [td]Able[/td]                [td]You can now cancel installation.
Canceling installation will have the Folded Shield return to your Inventory.[/td]            [/tr]            [tr]                [td][b]Durability UI[/b][/td]                [td]Unable[/td]                [td]Able[/td]                [td]Durability UI for the Folded Shield is now available in your Inventory.[/td]            [/tr]            [/table][h3][b]Multi Care Packages[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Reduced the number of small Care Packages of the multi Care Package drops in Taego.[list]            [*][b]Current[/b]: Min. 5 / Max. 15[/*]            [*][b]After Update[/b]: Min. 5 / Max. 10[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev Comment[/b][/*][/list]
Multi Care Package drops in Taego provide various powerful items, but we’ve also noticed teams obtaining these goods were ending up a bit overly advantageous throughout the game. Therefore, we’ve decided to reduce the possible max amount of small Care Packages.

Item types and quantities will not change.
[h3][b]Food Truck[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Default health has decreased from 3000 → 2500.[/*][/list][h3][b]O12[/b][/h3][list]    [*]You can now attach Canted Sight to the O12.[/*][/list][h3][b]Sound[/b][/h3][list]    [*]The footstep sound as soon as you stop running/sprinting has been slightly decreased.[/*][/list][h2]

[b]Normal Match Matchmaking System[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bbef3261ddce5dd4f3893669914d6431273d693e.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Improved the matchmaking system for Normal Matches to have it work better based on players’ MMR.[list]            [*]Matchmakings that used to be based on your [b]pre-made party’s average MMR[/b] will now be based on your [b]party’s highest MMR[/b].[/*]            [*]Each player’s match placement will now be based on [b]individual placement[/b], not the team’s.[/*]            [*]Other factors of the matchmaking system have been polished as well.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][list]    [*][b]Dev Comment[/b][/*][/list]
We’ve thought about how we could improve gameplay in Normal Matches, so we decided it was time to overhaul the whole matchmaking system.

The current matchmaking system is designed as matchmaking in Ranked (based on team’s average MMR), but we noticed through players’ feedback and gameplay that players were more in need of a casual environment where you can test new things out and experience more kills.

This updated matchmaking system for Normal Matches will preserve current squad play mechanics while focusing on individual stats rather than a team as a whole. We will of course continue to monitor your opinions actively after this update and work on improving the matchmaking system moving forward.

[h2][b]World[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Neymar Jr. Collaboration[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/33bb6f786ea9968f24dae4e2be86e043a12be056.jpg[/img]

Collaborative objects such as billboards, building decorations, soccer balls, and Care Packages with Neymar Jr. have been added to every map.
[h2][b]Tutorial – Basic Training[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/dd9bbb777a4b435fbf7a927332445f854f6a0872.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Improved key guide UI for each mission.[/*]    [*]Added AI Training Match related pop-up to the end of Basic Training.[/*]    [*]Rearranged pop-ups’ content and sequence.[/*]    [*]Added new sound effects.[list]            [*]Mission clear[/*]            [*]Steel door interactions[/*]            [*]Default background sound[/*]            [*]AI Training Match pop-up[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Custom Match[/b][/h2][list]    [*]The number of presets you can save in Custom Matches have been increased from 10 to 50 presets.[/*][/list][h2][b]UI/UX[/b][/h2][h3][b]Lobby Design[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Updated the lobby’s bottom panel button designs to clarify their different states.[/*]    [*]Updated the News/Event page and added a navigational menu at the top of the screen.[/*]    [*]Updated Ranked leaderboard design.[/*]    [*]Updated the colors of the general tier info.[/*]    [*](PC) Added an ESC key icon to full screen pages.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/434b79a6f1ea7831259184462761d71209db676b.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Added a tab menu to Settings.[/*]    [*]Reduced the number of options displayed on a single page.[/*]    [*]Your options will be saved when you move between tabs, and pressing Apply will apply every change. [/*]    [*]Improved UI layout.[/*][/list][h3][b]Profile[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Players who use inappropriate profile images will have their profile images changed to the default image.[/*][/list][h2][b]Workshop[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3a28e264e868adba27077928974720520205e8c5.jpg[/img]


[list]    [*]New item sets have been added to the Hunter’s Chest and Archivist’s Chest.[list]            [*]Survivor Pass: Galaxy Squad[/*]            [*]Spring Collection[/*]            [*]Emotes[list]                    [*]Victory Dance 85[/*]                    [*]Victory Dance 86[/*]                    [*]Victory Dance 87[/*]                    [*]Make It Rain[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Two new item sets have been added to Special Crafting.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6d870536c238d5da17af96323f2314cd63781cc9.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Performance[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Improvements to client performance and hitches by switching vehicle simulations to work on the server-side. However, this update may have moving vehicles at a certain distance appear slightly awkward.[list]            [*]This update will not apply to Stadia.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Fixed the issue of when a player carrying a knocked out teammate gets knocked out, the perspective of the player that was carried gets awkwardly fixated in FPP.[/*]    [*]Fixed the Death Cam issue of showing the location a player got on the vehicle, not when the player got off.[/*]    [*]Fixed the issue of being able to enter inside rocks after deploying an Emergency Pickup and being able to attack enemies from inside.[/*]    [*]Fixed the issue of the Airboat exploding/passenger dying after the Airboat collides with a fence when a issue of not showing the UAZ a player was on when the player dies after the UAZ’s wheels explode.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the issue with parties not working properly after the party leader invites a member through Discord and leaves the team.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the issue of Instant Volume Reducer applying to a different match and players having to press F7 twice to deactivate the feature.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the issue of certain accounts unable to join Ranked through a friend invite.[/*][/list][h3][b]World[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Fixed collision, texture, performance, and more general issues the button not working on the screen of banned players.[/*]    [*]Fixed the issue of the awkward size of the fist icon on the kill feed when a player dies from punches.[/*]    [*]Fixed the issue of issue of a player’s Rich Presence not showing the correct status when the player’s spectating a player that killed them.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the issue of a player’s Ranked tier icon next to their
