title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Dev Plan 2022
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b54b2f0cf5a22d5e3d5be96b0055e2e157337256.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

First of all, a very happy 5th Anniversary to you all! We’re both excited and humbled to ring in this milestone, even though we can hardly believe it has been that long already! Through the years, you all have stood with us as a constant reminder of how fortunate we have been in our successes but also a humbling reminder that there is always work to do. Many companies say it, but we hope you believe us when we say we’re truly in this together. Your joys, triumphs, milestones, and of course, your feedback, are revered throughout our studios and fuel us to keep moving forward. Sometimes we hit it out of the park and share in your celebrations. Sometimes we stumble and have to adjust and reassess our plans. Ours is a partnership we feel truly grateful to have and we’ll continue to take in your feedback, adjust, and improve as we take on the next 5 years together.

For today, we want to celebrate the past but more importantly look to the future with our 2022 Roadmap. Of course, we have to state that everything we’re sharing today along with any mentioned timelines are all subject to change. Game development can be a finicky thing and priorities can change based on issues that arise and feedback. In addition, know that what we’re sharing today isn’t everything. Some content in development is still in too early of a stage to share but we’ve tried to find some exciting features to talk about for each quarter of the year.

All that said, let’s dive into the 2022 PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cbe17a08e37ab26cb01b91d224adbd4a8f217f9f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Quarter 2 (April - June)[/h3]
[b]
Sanhok Rollback
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/93f115502350c58ce211ac1816ea0515a5c6295f.jpg[/img]

Sanhok is one of the areas you’ve been pretty vocal about. We’ve attempted a few changes in an effort to modernize Sanhok, but at the end of the day, many of you still preferred the original map. We’ve heard your feedback and are doing the following for Sanhok:
[list]    [*]Sanhok will come back in its original form[list]            [*]Sanhok is our oldest small map and is still enjoyed by many players[/*]            [*]Due to its age, it has seen a number of added features and a major revamp[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Some players like the revamped version but most players want the original Sanhok back[list]            [*]We’ve given lots of thought to the long-standing requests and made the decision to revert the map[/*]            [*]The reverted version is in the last stage of stabilization and will be revealed in the near future[/*]            [*]With the rollback, many of the added features will be removed but we are deliberating on how we’ll move forward with Sanhok’s original form[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h3][b]New Weapon: 7.62mm Assault Rifle (AR)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/92299bc260f7c340a21dd0c8c32fb406b699ddff.jpg[/img]

Assault Rifles (AR) either use the 5.56mm or 7.62mm, but there seems to be a smaller pool of 7.62mm ARs that can use the full-auto firing mode. Therefore, one of our goals for Q2 is to add an additional 7.62mm AR to the mix.
[list]    [*]For weapon variety, we are developing a new 7.62mm weapon[/*]    [*]7.62mm weapons have high DPS but are more difficult to control[/*]    [*]The new 7.62mm weapon in development has a comparably lower DPS but is easier to control, positioned between the Beryl (high damage, difficult to control) and AKM (low damage, easier to control)[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Training Mode Improvement[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7c74e3e7ecc887cb1f2c80318f54246ecef4afab.jpg[/img]

Training Mode has seen few major changes since its inception. With so many new players joining the game since Free-to-Play, we thought now was a good time to focus on more practical training areas.
[list]    [*]Since the beginning of this year, we’ve been working to improve Training Mode[/*]    [*]In the current Training Mode, players can train their skills with weapons and vehicles. [/*]    [*]With Free-to-Play, more practical training programs are required. [list]            [*]Players will be able to practice PvP combat there[/*]            [*]Adding Aim/Sound Training Room in the last update was part of the effort[/*]            [*]1vs1 training ground will be added where players can fight one-on-one[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]QoL updates are also in the pipeline: [list]            [*]Fast travel within the training grounds[/*]            [*]Custom match training mode that allows players to train with friends[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h3][b]Paramo World Sub-update[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e1e62cb5fb636e7dd43cac1a10af7a5f8c18d915.jpg[/img]

In PUBG, terrain can be just as important as the right loadout and good aim. We’re constantly looking at maps to make sure they are tactically fair and fun. Paramo especially has some overly advantageous areas that we want to look at for balance adjustments.
[list]    [*]There are some overly advantageous areas in the world, which will be adjusted for balance[/*]    [*]We constantly improve terrain balance of the Battlegrounds by making adjustments[/*]    [*]We want to make sure there is distinct gameplay on each map[/*]    [*]The Paramo sub-update is scheduled for Q2. [list]            [*]Sub-updates for existing maps such as Miramar and Taego will follow as well.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h3][b]QoL Improvement[/b][/h3]

We’re always looking at little ways we can make a big difference in your quality of life as you play. While some systems are intentionally meant to be more difficult, there are definitely places we can improve.
[list]    [*]PUBG has inconvenient elements by nature as a realistic Battle Royale rule, such as being unable to use heal and boost items in a vehicle’s driver seat or having to guess the perfect timing of a cooked grenade.[/*]    [*]Therefore, we want to find places we can reduce inconvenience without affecting core gameplay through systems such as the UI by providing the info players had to learn from experience.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Quarter 3 (July – September)[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Map: Kiki[/b][/h3]

Kiki is quite unique in its diversity, featuring not only crowded cities full of near-future buildings, but vast grasslands, dense swamps, and more. We’re pretty excited about this one and are looking forward to getting it out to you soon. Here’s a bit more on Kiki:We’ve been talking about Kiki since the 2021 Dev Plan and know many of you have been excited to learn more and eventually get your hands on it. We’re happy to announce that Kiki’s development is coming along well and we plan on debuting the new 8×8 map in Q3 of this year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f808cd12a7888fe9b7d83d2806ac6a9d30de0a43.jpg[/img]

[b]Look and Feel[/b]
Kiki is a near-future city that has been ravaged by the elements. Dangerous storms, powerful floods, and of course the tolls of time, have all contributed to the downfall of this once thriving city. Built upon a tamed frontier, the lands around [u]Kiki [/u]still very much belong to nature with a blend of rocky highlands, floral planes, and dense swamps with bits of 21st century civilization dotted throughout. It is a Battleground unlike anything we’ve built before and we’re excited to see [u]Kiki[/u] inhabited once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f8e21bf2cb45e318fe78f68e5a82fa8a85ac7107.jpg[/img]

[b]Unique Traits[/b]

Kiki’s city has the most verticality we’ve ever built into Battleground and are filled with interesting sniper-nest style points of interest, rooftops loaded with emergency parachutes, and buildings easily scaled with the new Ascenders. This isn’t to say that the entire city can be explored. Taking lessons from Haven, not every building is fully playable, with single floors, or sometimes just single chambers, open for gameplay and highlighted so that players on the ground can easily learn where snipers can fight from.

Out in nature, our new swamplands are completely unique to Kiki, with ankle deep water, and dense cover to allow for compelling cat and mouse gameplay without having to swim everywhere. We’re also looking to add an Airboat to better navigate across both land and sea. For those hoping for a more traditional PUBG gameplay, Kiki will also have plenty of fielded area for those iconic battles that players enjoyed in Erangel and Miramar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/06614a06a8de2f0aabf759e1dafcc4853938765c.jpg[/img]

[b]Exclusive features/content[/b]

[b]Airboat:[/b] A vehicle that specializes in land and sea traversal. Its amazing utility is balanced out by less than ideal cover for passengers.

[b]Ascenders:[/b] While at special areas on the map, players can use the Ascender to quicky ascend or descend great distances.

[b]Additional Features:[/b] After releasing Kiki, we will continue to add content exclusive to the map such as new weapons and vehicles

[h3][b]Weapon Mastery Overhaul[/b][/h3]
The PUBG Mastery systems were introduced as progression content to keep things challenging and interesting for players, but we’ve noticed the current systems needed some improvements for a while now as many players were reaching max levels. Therefore, our dev team will work on creating a stronger progression system by first starting with a Weapon Mastery overhaul.
[list]    [*]Increasing Weapon Mastery max level to challenge players[/*]    [*]Having players show off their achievements through Weapon Nameplates and additional rewards once players reach a certain Mastery level[/*]    [*]Considering various ways to provide more meaningful stats/records to make progressing a more rewarding experience[/*]    [*]Refer to the previous “Weapon Mastery Overhaul” announcement for more info.[list]            [*]As stated there, we welcome your feedback and ideas on this system! Please let us know what you’d like to see from the Mastery system.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[h2][b]Quarter 4 (October – December)[/b][/h2]
[h3]Vikendi – Reborn[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7fb9be1fe46efb479dd16c6863e4ef0e017c77af.jpg[/img]

Being one of the more visually unique Battlegrounds, Vikendi still has room for additional implementation of new features and areas for more core gameplay moments. Therefore, we’re planning a grand remake towards the end of the year.

Although Vikendi provides unique visuals, it has room for improvement and new features in terms of core gameplay. Being well aware of that, we decided to remake Vikendi.

[h3][b]Arcade Mode Overhaul[/b][/h3]

We haven’t done much with Arcade Mode since adding TDM, so we want to overhaul Arcade Mode to add new game types and rewards for playing them.
[list]    [*]No new mode has been added to Arcade Mode since TDM[/*]    [*]Developing content simultaneously and running LABS to test modes and features have taken our attention away from Arcade mode[/*]    [*]In the second half of the year, we plan to overhaul Arcade Mode to add more game types and a new reward system for players who enjoy playing Arcade.[/*][/list]
As stated above, this is not an all-inclusive list. We’ve got a variety of different types of content constantly in the works that we’re just not ready to talk about yet.

One last reminder that everything we talk about is subject to change, whether it’s as little as a different name for a system to completely scrapping some features that turn out to be different than we’ve envisioned. 

We’re excited about everything coming in the remainder of 2022 and have plenty more planned for beyond. For now, join in on all the 5th Anniversary festivities. Grab some cool rewards, and as always keep an eye on our official channels for info on when these awesome new features will be ready for you to jump into.

Thank you for all the love and support you’ve given throughout the years. 

[b]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team[/b]

title: Introduction to PUBG Continental Series 6
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/69afd8ace0718e7502a3e6e6616e79d62321e795.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports Fans!

The grand tour to the PUBG Global Championship 2022 has now begun and PUBG Esports is now back again with PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES (PCS)!

PCS6 will be held across four regions, with matches beginning on April 15th for the APAC and AMERICAS, followed by EUROPE and ASIA starting on April 29th.

The four regions include:
[list]
[*] ASIA –  Korea, Japan, China, and Chinese Taipei
[*] ASIA PACIFIC – Southeast Asia and Oceania
[*] AMERICAS - North America and Latin America
[*] EUROPE - Europe West and Middle East & Africa
[/list]
[b]Tournament Schedule[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7cb57b8accf382c32a0e5cb6685c35e9990842e6.png[/img]

[b]APAC / AMERICAS[/b]
[list]
[*] April 15 - 17
[*] April 22 - 24
[/list]
[b]ASIA / EUROPE[/b]
[list]
[*] April 29 - May 1
[*] May 6 - 8
[/list]
[b]Total Matches[/b]
[list]
[*] 30 matches in total per region.
[*] 5 matches per day for 6 days.
[/list]

[b]The Prize Pool[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1f796246456a9f9f75e342f652b263fca5ff5bfa.png[/img]

The PCS6 prize pool starts with a grand total of $1 million USD, which is split evenly across the four participating regions. PCS6 will continue to include 30% of all PCS6 item sales to contribute towards the total prize pool via crowdfunding.
[list]
[*] Base prize pool of $250,000 USD per region.
[*] 30% of PUBG's net sales of PCS6 items is shared directly with participating teams.
[/list]

[b]Prize Pool Breakdown[/b]

The prize pool of PCS6 is identical across all regions. However, detailed distribution ratio of the prize pool is different by region. Please refer to the prize pool image for details.

[b]Basic Prize : $230,000[/b]
[b]Special Prizes $20,000[/b]
[list]
[b]KILL LEADER ($5,000)[/b]
[list]
[*] Prize granted to the player with the most kills.
[*] Prize will be distributed evenly in the case of a tie.
[/list]
[b]ALL-PCS TEAM ($10,000)[/b]
[list]
[*] Prize granted to 4 best performing players in the Series.
[/list]
[b]INSANE SQUAD ($5,000)[/b]
[list]
[*] Prize granted to the team which showed the most impressive moment in the Series.
[/list]
[/list]
[u][b]Winner of the Special prize will be carefully chosen by the selection group.[/b][/u]

[b]PCS6 Pick'em Challenge[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/45b3c86dd274e6eb57f22834b76f173aff904cb1.jpg[/img]

The Pick'em Challenge event is back for the PCS6! Participate and pick'em to earn sweet EPs and contribute to the grand prize pool to support your favorite team directly!

[b]PCS6 Item Sales Period[/b]

[list]
[*] PC: March 16th ~ May 6th UTC 08:00 (KST 17:00) UTC 08:00 (KST 17:00)
[*] Console: March 24th ~ May 6th UTC 08:00 (KST 17:00) UTC 08:00 (KST 17:00)
[/list]

[b]PCS6 Pick'em Challenge Voting Period[/b]

[list]
[*] APAC/AM Start: April 6th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00)
[*] APAC/AM End: April 22nd UTC 09:00 (KST 18:00)
[*] ASIA/EU Start: April 25th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00)
[*] ASIA/EU End: May 6th UTC 09:00 (KST 18:00)
[/list]

[b]PCS6 Pick'em Reward Claiming Period[/b]

[list]
[*] APAC/AM Pick the winner rewards: April 26th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00) ~
[*] ASIA/EU Pick the winner rewards: May 10th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00) ~
[*] Team Faceoff rewards: May 10th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00) ~
[*] End of all reward claim period: May 25th UTC 02:00 (KST 11:00)
[/list]

The first global event of PUBG Esports 2022, PUBG CONTINETIAL SERIES 6 is just around the corner!

Stay tuned to PUBGESports.com for more details to follow!

title: Weapon Mastery Overhaul
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/67274812219d29d904f4fc31b0614952e39cbba4.jpg[/img]

Hello Players!

It’s been a while since we’ve talked about our progression content, such as Survival Mastery and Weapon Mastery. We know that many of you have maxed out on these since their introduction, and with so many new players joining also, now’s a great time to talk about what we have planned for this system going forward.

Progression is a critical fuel that motivates players to keep playing and striving for the next thing. With that in mind, we’ve come up with some updates and changes for Weapon Mastery that we’ve outlined below. Keep in mind that none of these proposed changes are final. We’re eager to get your opinions and ideas first before we put any plans into action. 

Let’s jump into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d38ea3fe03dba40d37fd377015440b4e0b7934e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[b]Weapon Mastery Expert Level & Rewards[/b]

Upon reaching level 100 in a particular Weapon Mastery, players will now be able to reset their level in order to gain one Expert Level, earning a medal and an upgraded Weapon Nameplate along with it. 
[list]    [*]Expert Levels[list]            [*]The most criticized point of the current Mastery Level is that it doesn’t take long for experienced players to reach the highest level. Therefore, we have created two different levels that allow players to continue leveling up a weapon for additional rewards, rather than a simple one-time level system. Please note that the name “Expert Level” is not final.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Rewards[list]            [*]When a basic account switches to a Plus account, Weapon Mastery medals are provided retroactively.[/*]            [*]Non-Plus accounts can still have Weapon Nameplates according to their levels.[/*]            [*]With the introduction of Expert Levels, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Plus players will receive Weapon Mastery medals on every Expert level up, in addition to an upgraded Weapon Nameplate. These are decorations that will allow a player to show off their Expert Level with that weapon. They will also receive visual upgrades to the kill message with every new Expert Level. Progressive weapons are not required for these.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Charms[list]            [*]Weapon Mastery Charms will be retroactively rewarded based on the highest level weapon after the update and will no longer be provided as Mastery Rewards. For example, if you have a level 50 M416 and a level 30 AKM, all Charms up to level 50 will be rewarded.[/*]            [*]Charms can no longer be acquired through Weapon Mastery and instead can be acquired with BP or through other means.[/*]            [*]Instead of being linked to the weapon you unlocked them with, owned charms can now be equipped to any weapon.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]XP Count[list]            [*]We used the term “Defeat” as a way to track your knockdowns + opponents’ final death in Squads and a kill in Solos. As many found this to be a confusing term, we’ve just gone ahead and changed it to “Kills.”[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Weapon Mastery Stats[/b]

Weapon Mastery records are completely reorganized for each weapon used in both Normal and Ranked matches. The current Mastery stats will no longer be updated. However, you will still be able to look up the old stats from a separate page. 
[list]    [*]Intention[list]            [*]Current stats are a simple accumulation of records without comparing with other players’ stats. The new stats are intended to provide an advanced type of information. For example, rather than just displaying the number of kills, we also plan to show details like the time spent to achieve a kill. [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Weapon Mastery UI/UX[/b]
[list]    [*]Weapons List[/*][/list]
This menu displays the player’s weapons in kill order by game mode. Once the weapon category is selected, it will list the weapons by their number of total kills so that the player can easily see which type of weapons they are skilled at in combat. It will also show total headshots, total damage, total assists, and the time spent reaching these stats. Please note that Ranked stats are a PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Plus account exclusive feature.  
[list]    [*]Kill message[/*][/list]
A Weapon Nameplate that represents the player’s Expert Level will be displayed in the kill message. Upgrade your Expert Level to enhance your Weapon Nameplate.
[list]    [*]Universal Charms[/*][/list]
We wanted to provide a Weapon Skin-like UI/UX for the Charms, as the ownership has moved from individual weapons to the player themself. Therefore, we have moved the Charms under the Customization menu. 

Again, none of these proposed changes are final. Since game progression is an essential factor for PUBG, we want to listen to your feedback on our proposed changes and begin development in April. We will continue to listen to your comments as we work and hope to have the new and improved Weapon Mastery available for you all around the July update.


PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: Patch Notes - Update 16.2
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/df5f33f0cb249cb8c010dc9bf40145e5b4dfdede.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes - Update 16.2[/h1][h2][b]16.2 Highlights[/b][/h2]

To be updated with the Live Server update.

[b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b]

[h2][b]New Tactical Gear[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Tactical Pack[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ea3487aa895b95ab733d37f40f4f0fd0fdd41ab8.jpg[/img]

Update 16.2 kicks off with a new Tactical Gear, the Tactical Pack! Store almost any type of item and come up with all kinds of wacky play styles with this super backpack; turn into a missile silo with four Panzerfausts, or carry two extra sets of vests and helmets for emergencies, or dominate every combat range with an SMG, AR, and DMR combo! Or even better yet, why not carry four [u]Mountain Bikes[/u] (because you can) so you and your squad would never need a vehicle again?
[list]    [*]The Tactical Pack will:[list]            [*]Take up your primary weapon slot.[/*]            [*]Have four attachment slots.[/*]            [*]Spawn in every map.[/*]            [*]Be available in Normal Matches, Custom Games, Training Mode, and Sandbox Mode(PC only).[/*]            [*]Hold almost any item in its slots, including weapons, helmets, vests, item stacks, etc.[list]                    [*]Stacks of an item (such as a stack of ammo) will take up a single slot, but a weight limit of 60 per slot applies to stack items only.[/*]                    [*]Weapons holding attachments will be stored as they are.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The Tactical Pack will not be able to store another Tactical Pack.[list]            [*]The Trunk in Porters cannot store a Tactical Pack.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Tactical Pack items are only accessible by the carrier.[list]            [*]To use the items, they must first be removed from the Tactical Pack.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]When a player is holding the Tactical Pack in their hands, the normal looting interaction will be replaced with a new interaction to place the item directly into the Tactical Pack.[/*]    [*]Weapons stored in the Tactical Pack will hold all their current attachments and ignore the “Replace Attachments” option when swapped out with another weapon.[list]            [*][b]※ [/b]The “Replace Attachments” option allows you to enable/disable the automatic replacement of compatible attachments when picking up a new weapon.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]If weapons are loaded before they’re added to the Tactical Pack, they will maintain their loaded state when pulled back out.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Spotter Scope[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bbb4420db4cc930f7817971ab8b3f46a90970b75.jpg[/img]

And we’re bringing in another! Meet the new mid-range scouting Tactical Gear, the Spotter Scope! This special set of binoculars will help you spy and mark your enemies and enemy Drones while also allowing non-verbal communication with your squad!
[list]    [*]The Spotter Scope will:[list]            [*]Take up your primary weapon slot.[/*]            [*]Spawn in every map.[/*]            [*]Be available in Normal Matches, Custom Games, Training Mode, and Sandbox Mode(PC only).[/*]            [*]Be able to use in ADS mode.[list]                    [*]The Spotter Scope will have a fixed 4x zoom magnification feature.[/*]                    [*]It will also provide real-time distance to the target you’re aiming at.[list]                            [*]The maximum calculative distance is 1KM, and the distance beyond that will return as “??M”.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Allow you to spot and mark enemy players and Drones.[list]                    [*]Every enemy player and Drone within 1KM of the Spotter Scope’s sight will be marked with a passive marker (white icon).[list]                            [*]The passive marker will be shown on the seer’s screen only.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]A targeting rectangle is located at the center of the Spotter Scope view.[list]            [*]If the user places the targeting rectangle to a marked enemy or Drone the passive marker will turn into an active marker (red icon).[/*]            [*]The active markers will be automatically shared to the user’s teammates.[/*]            [*]There is no limit to the number of active markers that can be created.[list]                    [*]Several enemies can be marked with the active marker at once, with each marker following its respective target.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]When the Spotter Scope is no longer marking an enemy with an active marker, the active marker will continue to follow its target for 7 more seconds before disappearing.[list]                    [*]To indefinitely maintain the active marker, the targeting rectangle of the Spotter Scope must continue to chase the enemy.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4efd11676bdd7ba1a792f00f0d73cbecb914e74f.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Normal Screen Pings can also be placed while using the Spotter Scope.[/*]    [*]You will receive an Assist when the enemy you marked is killed by a teammate (only while the enemy has the active marker or within 5 seconds after the active marker disappears).[/*]    [*]The Spotter Scope will not detect or mark players hiding behind smoke made by Smoke Grenades.[list]            [*]However, when an enemy hides behind cover or smoke after getting marked by the active marker by the Spotter Scope, the active marker will still follow them for 7 more seconds before disappearing.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Tactical Gear: Drone[/b]

The consistent color of the lights deployed Drones emit seemed to confuse many of our players, so we’ve changed the lights’ colors to the following:
[list]    [*]Deployed Ally Drone: Green lights[/*]    [*]Deployed Enemy Drone: Red lights[/*][/list]
[b]Training Mode[/b]
[h3]Aim/Sound Lab[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/67ab1dfc309aec0d8fa87359ff93b97f317f1c6e.jpg[/img]

Enter the newly-added private Aim/Sound Lab for even better shooting and sound play practice!
[list]    [*]You can enter this private practice area by interacting with either one of the three helipads in Training Mode.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c60d26f241c2a3c5f2cdb1e58988b7154e2b55aa.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]After entry, you will be asked to choose between two modes: aim practice or sound practice.[list]            [*]Aim Practice[list]                    [*]Choose your weapon in the weapon selection window, interact with the start button, and start practicing after a 5-second countdown.[/*]                    [*]Human figure-shaped targets will randomly spawn. The targets will first start out flat on the ground, then 3 to 7 random targets will come up simultaneously for you to shoot.[/*]                    [*]Once a practice session is over, the number of headshots and the total number of hit targets will show up on the screen.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Sound Practice[list]                    [*]You will start out with a basic Deagle and a red dot sight.[/*]                    [*]Various sounds of primary weapons ranging from 15m~300m will be randomly played on targets.[list]                            [*]The weapon name and distance of the gunshot will show on the screen.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]Once you shoot the correct target, the target will fall back and come back up right away.[list]                            [*]A kill message telling you what type of weapon the gunshot was from will pop up on the screen.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]You will earn 10 points for shooting the correct target, 5 for the targets on either side of the correct one, and 0 for the rest.[list]                            [*]There are different sound effects for each different score you earn.[/*]                        [/list]                    [/*]                    [*]The identical gunshot will move between different targets every 5 seconds until the player shoots a target.[/*]                    [*]Your total score will show up on the screen once a practice session is over.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Each practice session has a time limit of 1 minute, but you are free to leave the session any time by interacting with the exit button in front of you.[/*][/list][h3]Improved Shooting Targets[/h3][list]    [*]Practice on the newly-added human-shaped and vehicle-shaped targets at the Aim/Sound Lab and shooting practice ranges![/*]    [*]You can see the different damages you inflict on the target based on the area you hit.[list]            [*]Headshot damage on human-shaped targets will be displayed as red.[list]                    [*]Other body damage such as the torso, arms, legs, etc. will be displayed as white.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Damage to the driver’s seat on vehicle-shaped targets will be displayed as red.[list]                    [*]Other damage such as the wheels and body will be displayed as white.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Layout Rearrangement[/h3]
The general layout of Training Mode has been shuffled up a bit to accommodate this update’s new features and practice areas.
[list]    [*]A Vehicle Display Booth displaying the three most recently added vehicles has been added.[/*]    [*]An Item Display Booth displaying the three most recently added items has been added.[/*]    [*]A vehicle shooting range with targets moving at the same speed as vehicles has been added.[/*]    [*]The current warehouse holding the guns and attachments has been removed to enhance the mode’s performance. Use the convenient Training Helper to summon weapons and items anytime, anywhere![/*]    [*]Dirt Bikes will now spawn instead of Scooters.[/*]    [*]Due to the rearrangement of Training Mode, Camp Jackal has been removed from Warmode in Custom Matches.[/*][/list][h3]Mode Entry Requirement[/h3][list]    [*]To encourage players to begin situational practices in various practice ranges, Training Mode will now also allow entry to players who completed Basic Training only.[/*][/list][h2][b]Map Service[/b][/h2]
As we had already mentioned in our latest Map Service Plan announcement, Sanhok will be replaced with Haven in this update’s rotation for Normal Matches. Prepare to battle newly-added bots, enemy players, and the Pillar in the return of the industrial island, Haven!

[list]    [*]Normal Match[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Karakin / Haven[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ranked Match[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]World[/b][/h2][h3]Fifth Anniversary Decoration[/h3]
You’ll be noticing several fifth anniversary decorations at Erangel and Taego in Normal Matches, but we’ll be brief on the fifth anniversary explanation as separate announcements will be telling you more on our upcoming events, perks, and more!

[h3]Karakin[/h3][list]    [*]Several landscape updates have been made to balance out the battle experience in Karakin.[list]            [*]To provide a safer escape from Al Habar, trees and stone walls have been added around the area.[/*]            [*]Trees, rocks, and a stone wall have been added to the set of houses located at the upper right of Bashara to reduce the area’s vulnerability.[/*]            [*]The topography of the mountains surrounding Hadiqa Nemo has been readjusted.[list]                    [*]A mountain ridge has been added to block enemies’ view.[/*]                    [*]The height of the mountains surrounding the area has been slightly lowered as they’ve been giving a bit too much of an advantage to many players.[/*]                    [*]The mountain’s slope has become a little gentler with a bit more natural cover added as well.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Item spawn spots have increased in bunkers near Bahr Sahir and Hadiqa Nemo.[/*]    [*]Directional alphabet signs such as E for East and X for explosive exit walls have been added to specific walls in Karakin’s bunkers to assist lost players.[/*][/list][h3]Haven[/h3][list]    [*]Bots acting like actual enemy players have been added to Haven.[/*]    [*]An option to adjust the map’s brightness has been added to Settings.[/*][/list][h3]Care Package Smoke[/h3][list]    [*]The Colorblind Mode setting will no longer apply to the red smoke from Care Packages due to a new feature to be added in a later update.[/*][/list][h2][b]Item Spawn Balance[/b][/h2]
We’ve heard your feedback that relatively useful weapons and their appropriate attachments should be spotted more frequently in Normal Match maps. Therefore, we ran thorough internal tests based on the data of our current item spawns and decided it’d be best to adjust the spawn rate of ARs, DMRs, SRs, and scopes in Erangel and Miramar to reduce the frustration players feel when they lose a battle after some unlucky looting.

※ This item spawn rate balance will only apply to Normal Matches.
[h3]Erangel[/h3][list]    [*]Assault Rifles (AR) and Designated Marksman Rifles (DMR) spawn rate increased by approximately 62%.[/*]    [*]Sniper Rifles (SR) spawn rate increased by approximately 145%.[/*]    [*]Foregrip spawn rate increased by approximately 33%.[/*]    [*]Scope spawn rate increased by approximately 75%.[/*]    [*]Stock spawn rate increased by approximately 38%.[/*]    [*]Magazine spawn rate decreased by approximately 28%.[/*]    [*]Heal Items and Throwables spawn rate decreased by approximately 13%.[/*]    [*]Shotguns spawn rate decreased by approximately 27%.[/*]    [*]Handguns spawn rate decreased by approximately 48%.[/*][/list][h3]Miramar[/h3]
Due to the widespread distribution of item spawn spots in Miramar, players relatively take a bit more time to loot. Therefore, the spawn rate of weapons and items has generally increased.
[list]    [*]Assault Rifles (AR) spawn rate increased by approximately 105%.[/*]    [*]Designated Marksman Rifles (DMR) spawn rate increased by approximately 123%.[/*]    [*]Sniper Rifles (SR) spawn rate increased by approximately 317%.[/*]    [*]Foregrip spawn rate increased by approximately 103%.[/*]    [*]Scope spawn rate increased by approximately 100%.[/*]    [*]Magazine spawn rate increased by approximately 10%.[/*]    [*]Muzzle attachments spawn rate increased by approximately 12%.[/*]    [*]Stock spawn rate increased by approximately 47%.[/*]    [*]Armor spawn rate increased by approximately 12%.[/*]    [*]Backpack spawn rate increased by approximately 16%.[/*]    [*]Helmet spawn rate increased by approximately 20%.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Survivor Pass: Punk Wave[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a9f9bb0d26b350e2fe1bb684a5649776c18ead85.jpg[/img]

We first wish to thank you all for your patience. The next Survivor Pass: Punk Wave has finally arrived (with a better UI appearance too)! Turn into the punkiest star on the Battlegrounds by completing missions and collecting rewards.

We’ve also made some balance adjustments and general UI/UX enhancements for an even better Survivor Pass experience.
[list]    [*]To differentiate the XP of Survival Mastery/Weapon Mastery with the Survivor Pass XP, the Survivor Pass XP will now be referred as Pass XP.[/*]    [*]Maximum playtime to earn Pass XP per day: 6 hours → [b]8 hours[/b][/*]    [*]Maximum Pass XP obtainable per day: 7200 Pass XP → [b]9600 Pass XP[/b]        [list]            [*]This does not affect the Pass XP rewards obtained from missions.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Main Lobby[/b][/h2][list]    [*]A special BGM “PUBG 5th Anniversary” has been created and applied to the main lobby – Erangel and Taego won’t be the only ones celebrating our upcoming fifth anniversary![/*][/list][h2][b]UI/UX[/b][/h2][list]    [*]The current icons on the Hideout and Store tabs have been confusing some of our players, so they’ve been modified to deliver a clearer message.[/*]    [*]Regions with map selection can now find lore-related introductions added to each map in the map select page.[/*]    [*](Console) The general design of the hold key icons has been updated.[/*][/list][h2][b]Performance[/b][/h2][list]    [*]A new compression technology has been implemented to every platform to reduce game size and improve decompression speed.[list]            [*]This is expected to help relieve in-game hitches, especially on low-end hardware.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Frame rates should be improved thanks to optimizations for render-heavy situations such as navigating cities.[/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list]    [*]Fixed the awkward character movement in Replay mode when a player jumps off a Motorbike.[/*]    [*]Fixed the remaining Drone icon of an ally’s on the minimap in Spectator Mode even after the teammate dropped the Drone.[/*]    [*]Fixed the missing item issue in the Drone’s inventory after using the Drone to pick up an item.[/*]    [*]Fixed the invisible Drone issue when deploying a Drone while using an emote.[/*]    [*]Fixed the awkward tripod issue of the Mk12 when using the weapon while prone.[/*]    [*]Fixed the white weapon icon of the player’s Drone even after the Drone is destroyed.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the awkward character appearance of the player using a Drone after handing a weapon to that player through the Sandbox UI, and the black screen issue when the Drone is recalled.[/*]    [*](Console) Fixed the notification message popping up during the login loading screen and disappearing less than 5 seconds later.[/*][/list][h3]World[/h3][list]    [*]Fixed the disappearing rocks issue when entering ADS mode at a certain location in Karakin.[/*]    [*]Fixed the missing flame effect when throwing a Molotov at destroyable surfaces in Karakin.[/*]    [*]Fixed the missing siren sound alerting the first Black Zone in Karakin.[/*]    [*]Fixed collision, texture, performance, and more general issues in Karakin.[/*][/list][h3]UX/UI[/h3][list]    [*]Removed the Vehicles image from the world map in Training Mode.[/*]    [*]Fixed the appearance of pans in the Career tab for different level poses after equipping certain equipment skins.[/*]    [*]Fixed the issue of being able to Lock weapon items that are unable to be disassembled in the Customize tab.[/*]    [*](PC) Fixed the bunched-up looked of the Ranked season’s countdown sign.[/*][/list][h3]Items & Skins[/h3]
※ Clipping issue: Graphics that are shown outside the visible part of an image/object.
[list]    [*]Fixed the invisible RYAN’s Slippers issue when equipping the item with a Divemaster Suit.[/*]    [*]Fixed the clipping issue of the Blood Hound Jacket when using an emote where the character raises their arms.[/*]    [*]Fixed the missing Partner logo issue when equipping the WackyJacky101’s VSS skin.[/*][/list]

title: Road to PGC: PGC Point distribution
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a46c0032e77f8b7e3945480b0688ed1cd5846c41.png[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

The grand race to the PGC 2022 has finally begun and a number of teams have already cranked their engines to acquire precious PGC points!

Read on to learn more about PGC point distribution for all four regions.

[h1]EUROPE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2740be61d423252626c5e7e27531ccb0d1c06413.png[/img]

EUROPE will have a total of 8 slots at PGC 2022 and teams will be seeded as follows:

[list]
[*] The 7 teams with the highest number of points following the completion of PCS7, excluding the PCS7 winner, will qualify for the PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] The winner of PCS7 will receive a direct invitation to PGC 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each of Europe’s three sub-regions - Europe West, Europe East, and Middle East & Africa - will be guaranteed a place at PGC.
[*] This means that the highest ranking squad from any sub-region that does not have a PGC-qualified team will be awarded the eighth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about EUROPE's PUBG Esports 2022 [url=https://www.pubgesports.com/en/news/1336/view]Click here[/url] 

[h1]AMERICAS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/41fd0c8c470cc708c401f823775972c5d7a9774f.png[/img]

AMERICAS will be seeded with a total of 6 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] The winner of the PCS7 
[*] PGC Point leader from sub-region that doesn’t win PCS7
[*] Top 4 teams in the PGC Qualification Points leaderboard, excluding the teams who have already qualified based on the above.  
[/list]

To learn more about AMERICAS's PUBG Esports 2022, [url=https://na.pubgesports.com/news/pubg-esports-americas-2022-road-to-pgc]Click here [/url]

[h1]ASIA[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e368a62eabd38cf948ba110b23eb2453ce027f7e.png[/img]

ASIA will be seeded with a total of 12 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] Top 12 teams with the highest amount of points will be able to join the year's greatest event, PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each sub-region, Chinese Taipei, Japan, will each have one guaranteed slot within ASIA's 12 PGC slots.
[*] In case the Top 12 does not include all sub-regions, The highest ranking squad from the missing sub-region will be awarded the eleventh and/or twelfth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about ASIA's PUBG Esports 2022, Click here (CN, Chinese Taipei, KR)

[url=https://weibo.com/ttarticle/p/show?id=2309404729903831450323&luicode=20000061&lfid=4729903835252021]CN:[/url]
[url=https://www.pubgesports.com/kr/news/1353/view]TW: [/url]
[url=https://www.pubgesports.com/tpe/news/1354/view]KR: [/url]

[h1]APAC[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ed9bd8d6ebffc67fe2acba5ce64156b860ec2ded.png[/img]

APAC will be seeded with a total of 6 slots for the PGC 2022.

[list]
[*] Top 5 teams, excluding the PCS7 winner, with the highest amount of points will be able to join the year's greatest event, PUBG Global Championship 2022.
[*] The winner of the PCS7 will receive direct invitation to the PGC 2022.
[*] To ensure global representation, at least one squad from each sub-region, Thailand and Vietnam, will each have one guaranteed slot within APAC's 6 PGC slots.
[*] In case the Top 6 does not include all sub-regions, The highest ranking squad from the missing sub-region will be awarded the fifth and/or sixth qualifier seed.
[/list]

To learn more about APAC's PUBG Esports 2022, [url=https://asia.battlegrounds.pubg.com/en/2022/02/11/welcome-to-pubg-esports-apac-2022/]Click here [/url]



The grand journey towards this year's PUBG GLOBAL Championship has just started!

Please stay tuned to your regional events just as ESL, GLOOT, PWS and PCL to watch and cheer for your favorite teams as they collect crucial points for the biggest tournament of the year!

We will be back with more information on upcoming PCS6 soon next month!

Until then, we'll see you on the Battlegrounds!


PUBG Esports Team

title: LABS: Zombie Survival 2.0 & Discord Event
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a812271a5111f3b6d4ea5cb175ec9204a8a6d673.jpg[/img]


Hello Survivors!

The zombies are back! This time, they’re stronger, smarter, and even more thirsty for blood…

In this second comeback of Zombie Survival, you’ll have to utilize new tactical items and cooperate with your team to outsmart the living dead… or else be doomed!

We also have a Discord event prepared for those brave enough to clear every stage of Zombie Survival 2.0. Read till the end to learn how to receive 30 Contraband Coupons by busting zombies!
[h2][b]Basic Rules[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Zombie Survival has a total of 10 stages that last 3 minutes each.[/*]    [*]To get to the next stage:[list]            [*]Kill every zombie OR[/*]            [*]At least one teammate stays alive until the very end.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Once a stage is cleared, you and your squad will have a 20-second break before moving on to the next stage.[list]            [*]Teammates who died in the previous stage will respawn and continue to the next stage as well.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The game will end as a Zombie Dinner if the entire squad gets wiped out.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/66753199341ccdd40413af8efea5ded1805ac7a8.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Zombies[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Zombies spawn once a stage starts.[/*]    [*]As you proceed along the stages, expect more zombies, stronger zombies, and even special types of zombies![/*]    [*]There are new types of zombies in Zombie Survival 2.0 such as:[list]            [*]Zombies throwing Molotov Cocktails,[/*]            [*]Zombies throwing Blue Zone Grenades,[/*]            [*]Zombies holding grenades in their mouths (can only be killed by headshots),[/*]            [*]And zombies with C4 attached to their bodies.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/12c5338d290358a870acd685d72e5a71cda3e7b0.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Survival Coins and New Items[/b][/h2][list]    [*][b]Survival Coins[/b]        [list]            [*]Earn Survival Coins by taking down zombies.[/*]            [*]The Survival Coins are stored in your inventory (Max. 999).[/*]            [*]Players cannot drop Survival Coins.[/*]            [*]Players who die and respawn for the next stage will have the amount of Survival Coins they had before they died.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Equipment[/b]        [list]            [*]The basic set of equipment each player starts out with is:[list]                    [*]Deagle[/*]                    [*]60EA .45 ACP[/*]                    [*]Backpack (Level 3)[/*]                    [*]1 Grenade[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Purchase various tactical items through your inventory with Survival Coins.[/*]            [*]Stronger weapons cost more Survival Coins.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]New Items[/b]        [list]            [*]There are additional tactical items in Zombie Survival 2.0 such as:[list]                    [*]Traps to temporarily stop zombies from moving,[/*]                    [*]Sticky Traps and Sticky Chemicals to temporarily slow down zombies,[/*]                    [*]Zombie Stun Grenades to stun zombies,[/*]                    [*]Healing Chemicals to heal you and your team,[/*]                    [*]Zombie C4, Can Bombs, Zombie Blue Zone Grenades, Anti-Zombie Chemicals, and Anti-Zombie Table Legs to deal damage.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/abfe6b4372732243183231f9b4f862b0a74d0ebf.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Scores[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Scores are cumulated by taking down zombies.[/*]    [*]Check your current score anytime during the game by pressing the world map.[/*]    [*]You and your teammates’ final scores will be shown after the game.[/*][/list][h2][b]Service Schedule[/b][/h2]
Zombie Survival 2.0 will run during the following period:
[list]    [*]PC[list]            [*]PST: February 15, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 27, 2022, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 16, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 28, 2022, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 16, 2022, After live server maintenance – February 28, 2022, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PST: February 23, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 6, 2022, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 24, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 7, 2022, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 24, 2022, After live server maintenance – March 7, 2022, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay Settings[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Only Supports TPP[/*]    [*]4-Man Squad Only[/*]    [*]DBNO Disabled[/*]    [*]Teamkill Disabled[/*][/list][h2][b]Notes When Playing in LABS[/b][/h2][list]    [*]LABS games do not provide XP or gameplay rewards.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on the Career page.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay will not be reflected on Match History.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay does not support replay.[/*]    [*]Zombie kills will not count towards BATTLESTAT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Discord Event[/b][/h2]
Want to take down zombies [u]and [/u]get rewards? Clear every stage of Zombie Survival 2.0, upload your Chicken Dinner screenshot (shown below) to your region’s Zombie Survival Discord channel, and receive [b]30 Contraband Coupons[/b]!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5654d137997bf3261c7152dba2a3848b2987f313.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to Participate[/h3][olist]    [*]Clear all 10 stages of Zombie Survival 2.0 during the event period.[/*]    [*]Take a screenshot of your Chicken Dinner screen (you must take your own!).[/*]    [*]Enter your region’s Discord server.[/*]    [*]Enter the [b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Event Submission Channel.[/b][/*]    [*]Upload your [b]Chicken Dinner screenshot[/b] to the channel along with your [b]PUBG Nickname[/b] and [b]game platform[/b] you’re playing on(Steam / PlayStation® / Xbox / Stadia / etc.).[/*]    [*]You’re done![/*][/olist][h3]Discord Channels[/h3]
The Zombie Survival channel where you can submit your Chicken Dinner screenshot will open on [b]the day the event starts[/b].
[list]    [*]Global: [url=https://discord.com/invite/battlegrounds]https://discord.com/invite/battlegrounds[/url]
[/*]    [*]Russia: [url=https://discord.com/invite/pubgru]https://discord.com/invite/pubgru[/url][/*]    [*]Turkey: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgturkiye]https://discord.gg/pubgturkiye[/url][/*]    [*]Middle East and North Africa: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgmena]https://discord.gg/pubgmena[/url][/*]    [*]Brazil: [url=https://discord.com/invite/pubg-brasil]https://discord.com/invite/pubg-brasil[/url][/*]    [*]Latin America: [url=https://discord.gg/pubglatam]https://discord.gg/pubglatam[/url][/*]    [*]Vietnam: [url=https://discord.gg/x879qxmQYy]https://discord.gg/x879qxmQYy[/url][/*]    [*]Indonesia: [url=https://discord.gg/u2qmNePqev]https://discord.gg/u2qmNePqev[/url][/*]    [*]Taiwan: [url=https://discord.gg/xhCwSRTR2u]https://discord.gg/xhCwSRTR2u[/url][/*]    [*]Japan: [url=https://discord.gg/VcjqdjU]https://discord.gg/VcjqdjU[/url][/*]    [*]Korea: [url=https://discord.gg/pubgkorea]https://discord.gg/pubgkorea[/url][/*][/list]
[b]Event Reward[/b]
[list]    [*]Contraband Coupon x30[/*][/list]
[b]Event Period[/b]
[list]    [*]PC & Console[list]            [*]PST: February 17, 2022, 4 PM – February 21, 2022, 3:59 PM[/*]            [*]CET: February 18, 2022, 1 AM – February 22, 2022, 12:59 AM[/*]            [*]KST: February 18, 2022, 9 AM – February 22, 2022, 8:59 AM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Important Notes[/h3][list]    [*]This event will be hosted on Discord only.[/*]    [*]Players may participate in this event only once per account.[list]            [*]Even if you submit multiple submissions, they will only be counted as one.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Only players who participate within the event period will be able to receive the reward.[list]            [*]The [b]Zombie Survival 2.0 Event Submission Channel[/b] will be disabled once the event ends.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]You must clear all 10 stages of Zombie Survival 2.0 to be able to receive the reward.[/*]    [*]Your Discord username and PUBG nickname do not have to be identical.[/*]    [*]Every teammate must capture and upload their own Chicken Dinner screenshot to receive the reward.[list]            [*][b]Your PUBG nickname must be highlighted[/b] to be counted.[/*]            [*]You will not be able to receive the reward if you use other players’ screenshots.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The reward will be automatically granted to your account at the latest by March 4, 2022, 11 AM UTC.[/*][/list]
Good luck, don’t get bitten, and remember to have fun.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: Patch Notes - Update 16.1
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3c857c910b51ee21ac14d327273caeae59c1a309.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Note: Moving forward, our monthly Patch Notes will contain both PC and Console updates in a single announcement (thus the simple title).
[h3][b]16.1 Highlights[/b][/h3]
To be updated with the Live Server update.

[b]※ Please keep in mind that the features and updates we provide below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. We will update our players if such changes occur.[/b]
[h3][b]Weapon Balance[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bed536e10354256095ce2b54eeaded4375fb959b.jpg[/img]

We’re back with another weapon balance in this update to provide each weapon type a chance to shine in tactical battles and to prevent scenarios where players are all holstering the identical, overperforming weapon.

After we toned down M416’s reload time, base damage, initial bullet speed, and damage drop-off range in Update 7.2 due to the M416 being the most powerful AR and one of the top performing guns in the whole game, we noticed our players were gradually dropping the M416 for stronger ARs such as the Beryl M762. However, despite Beryl M762’s several nerfs in past updates, the weapon continues to show strong in-game performance. Additionally, out of all the DMRs, we’ve noticed the SLR was being favored due to its powerful damage – therefore, players’ options in battles seemed to be narrowed down to the Beryl M762 and the SLR.

Yet, we didn’t want to stress our players out more by nerfing well-used weapons, so instead we’ve decided to not only bring M416’s stats back up, but we also buffed the hard-hitting, high-velocity Mk12 while having it spawn in other maps to prompt more frequent 5.56mm ammo usage among DMRs.

※ Damage drop-off range: The distance at which the weapon’s damage starts to decrease from its maximum damage percentage.
[h3]M416[/h3][list]    [*]Damage increase: 40 → 41[/*]    [*]Initial bullet speed increase: 780m/s → 880m/s[/*]    [*]Damage drop-off range increased: 50m → 60m[/*][/list][h3]Mk12[/h3][list]    [*]Damage increase: 50 → 51[/*]    [*]Damage drop-off range increased: 75m → 90m[/*]    [*]The Mk12 will now spawn in every available map (Normal and Ranked).[list]            [*]The spawn settings in Custom Matches have been applied accordingly.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/21eb41a0b6babbcf338d4faf15ff7a9e9e786834.jpg[/img]

[h3]SMGs and Shotguns[/h3]
We heard and are aware of our players’ thoughts on our past weapon balancing on SMGs, Shotguns, etc., but the reason as to why it is difficult to actively readjust in-game balancing is due to the requirement of using several months of cumulative data as a foundation to potential changes. Therefore, we will continue tracking our players’ feedback and data to bring healthier balances to the game.
[h3][b]Vehicle Spawn – Ranked[/b][/h3]

title: Map Service Plan - February 2022
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/41fb60d05638e993bd3e844090f0c7621c10dc71.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors,

Back in Update 15.1, we applied a number of changes to our map service plan based on the feedback you provided. We also promised that we’d announce our future plans once they were ready to go and today we’re happy to introduce our plan for the first quarter of 2022.

[h3][b]Map Service Plan[/b][/h3]
(Like most things, the content of this plan may be subject to change!)

※ The plan below applies to both PC and Console.
[h3][b]Normal Matches[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Update 16.1[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Sanhok / Karakin[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Update 16.2[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Karakin / Haven[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Update 17.1[list]            [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego / Haven / Sanhok[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
During our preparation for Update 15.1’s map rotation, we were still running tests on Haven, such as making sure bots were working properly. We ended up needing more time than expected to complete these tasks, so Haven was eventually pulled from the rotation. With those tests now complete, players will soon be able to dive back into Haven’s 1×1 urban mayhem!

We also noticed lots of questions around missing maps while they’re off rotation. This is understandable since every player’s map preference is obviously different. Still, we’ve decided to update the map rotation every monthly update, starting with Update 16.1, so players won’t have to be without their favorite map for a whole Season. 

And last but not least, Sanhok will be taking a break in Update 16.2 while it undergoes several massive changes. Stay tuned for more details on Sanhok’s big update in future Patch Notes.
[h3][b]Ranked Mode[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*][/list]
The three 8x8km maps shown above will continue to be permanent fixtures for Ranked.

After Update 17.1, a revised Map Service Plan will be revealed in a separate announcement, once we’ve decided on the future map rotation and general direction of map services for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. As always, your feedback is a great reference while we are making decisions and we encourage you to always keep those thoughts and suggestions coming! 

Thanks, and we’ll see you on the Battlegrounds!

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Now Free-to-Play
author: Sheepy
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a6b3857546ee143ca3643515d9d29611698d7a3f.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!

The day we’ve all been waiting for is finally here: we are now free-to-play!

We’re excited to welcome our new players, greet our returning players, and continue to provide the best service to our current players.

But before you dive right in, take a moment to remind yourself of important free-to-play details shown below that will be helpful for your best battle royale experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/72e6e4450536963ff3dc78d00f62f24e1ad0bc89.png[/img]

[h3]Free-to-Play Updates[/h3][list]    [*]BATTLEGROUNDS Plus[list]            [*]New players will start out with a free Basic account which will have access to most in-game content. However, you can upgrade to BATTLEGROUNDS Plus anytime to unlock features only for BATTLEGROUNDS Plus![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Perks for Current Players[list]            [*]Returning and current players who already purchased the game before the free-to-play transition will not only have their accounts automatically upgraded to BATTLEGROUNDS Plus, but they will also receive a bundle of rewards, the PUBG – SPECIAL COMMEMORATIVE PACK.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
For even more details on our transition to free-to-play, check out our official [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2021/12/10/f2p/]Free-to-Play Announcement[/url].


We also have several Drops events prepared! Complete in-game missions, invite friends to PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, and watch our Partners’ stream to earn rewards.

The event schedules for both PC and Console platforms are as follows:

[list]    [*]Special Drops 1: F2P Grand Open Event [list]            [*]PST: January 11, 7 AM – January 31, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CET: January 11, 4 PM – February 1, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: January 12, 0 AM – February 1, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Special Drops 2: Friend Invitation and Referral Code Event[list]            [*]PST: January 11, 7 AM – February 8, 4 PM[/*]            [*]CET: January 11, 4 PM – February 9, 1 AM[/*]            [*]KST: January 12, 0 AM – February 9, 9 AM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Partner Drops[list]            [*]PST: January 11, 11 PM – January 25, 3:59 PM[/*]            [*]CET: January 12, 8 AM – January 26, 0:59 AM[/*]            [*]KST: January 12, 4 PM – January 26, 8:59 AM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

Check out the Special & Partner Drops – January 2022 (link here) for more information on our events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/01d0d35ac224189ca0aba2c99cbb5189e08e5c68.jpg[/img]

And last but definitely not least, we have a handful of new in-game features introduced in our latest 15.2 Update:

[list]    [*]Tactical Gear: Drone[list]            [*]Drones on the Battlegrounds! Hold the Drone Tablet, enter Drone View, and scout a far distance without facing the risk of direct combat.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Tactical Gear: EMT Gear[list]            [*]Obtain various healing boosts for both yourself and your teammates with the new EMT Gear![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]New Mode: Tutorials[list]            [*]We’ve added two in-game tutorial modes – Basic Training Mode and AI Training Match – to further enrich the gameplay experience for our players.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

For more information on the features above and on even more new features in both in-game and the lobby itself, read the full [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/patch-notes/update-15-2/]PC & Console Patch Notes – Update 15.2[/url].
