Hello PUBG Esports fans,

PUBG Continental Series(PCS) is now heading to the third series looking for who gets the third crown! PCS3 will be held across four regions from Nov 5 to 22.

The four regions include:
[list]    [*]Asia – which consists of Korea, Japan, China, and Chinese Taipei[/*]    [*]Asia Pacific – which consists of Southeast Asia and Oceania[/*]    [*]Europe[/*]    [*]North America[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/53d822098d5a05278ff81a7d17be8e5730b0ecb0.png[/img]

 
[list]    [*]PCS3 Tournament Schedule[list]            [*]ASIA/NA: November 5-6, 12-13, 19-20[/*]            [*]APAC/EUROPE: November 7-8, 14-15, 21-22[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Total Matches[list]            [*]24 matches in total per region (4 matches per day)[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
The Pick’em Challenge event, which gives fans a chance to benefit directly from the livestream action, is coming back as well to run over the course of the three week event.
[list]    [*]Sale period of the PCS3 items[list]            [*]PC: After the maintenance on Oct. 28, 2020 – 5 pm on Nov. 19, 2020 KST[/*]            [*]Console: 11am on Oct. 29, 2020 – 5 pm on Nov. 19, 2020 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The PCS3 Pick’em Challenge event period[list]            [*]PC: After the maintenance on Oct. 28, 2020 – 6 pm on Nov. 19, 2020 KST[/*]            [*]Console: After the maintenance on Oct. 29, 2020 – 6 pm on Nov. 19, 2020 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Pick’em reward claiming period[list]            [*]PC & Console: Nov. 23, 2020 - 11am on Dec. 9, 2020 KST[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
Twenty-five percent of the revenue from PCS3 items will be equally distributed among the four regional events. Exactly 12.5% of the 25% will go to the prize pool, and the other 12.5% will be allocated evenly to all participating teams.

We will offer more diverse Pick‘Em items for PCS3. In case you want to know more, here’s a sneak peek at some of the sales and reward items that will be available for PCS3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/32647077a854af7714b9807e5fc358c640c4f758.png[/img]

You can see these must-have items in the game beginning October 28 (October 29 for Console) when the Pick’em Challenge event starts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a08ccbba64fd29ced922ed791d3cac12f477163e.png[/img]

title: End of Season 8 Ranked and Rewards Announcement
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b371f83339140725af1c90fea352216fde02feb4.png[/img]

With Season 8 drawing to a close, it’s time to unveil all the great and exclusive Ranked rewards you’ve been working for. We’ll also go over the schedules for Season 8 close and the start of Season 9, along with a new mode to look forward to next season.

Let’s get into it!

[b]Season 8 Ranked Rewards Video[/b]
[previewyoutube=UoF-2PUc1tE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Requirements for Earning Rewards[/b][/h2]
PUBG's various Ranked rewards are earned depending on your final rank when the season ends. To be eligible, you’ll need to have at least completed your placement matches during the season, with additional awards being granted at Gold V and Diamond V tiers.

[h2][b]Season 8 Ranked Mode Rewards [/b][/h2]
Those who have reached Gold V tier or higher are eligible for the first exclusive reward, the Season 8 Ranked UAZ skin! If you manage to fight your way up to Diamond V tier or above, you’ll also be rewarded with the Season 8 Ranked Parachute skin. Finally, players who rank in the top 500 in their region will also receive a special Top 500 emblem to show off their achievement.

You can check out your final Season 8 rank by visiting the STATS screen in your CAREER tab once Season 9 has begun. Visiting the LEADERBOARD section of this screen also shows you were among the top 500 if you managed to make it that high

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/bc3ac211a270716a11b7c2688431c1306eaa382d.png[/img]

[b]Season 8 Emblems[/b]
[list]    [*]You’ll earn an emblem that matches your end of season rank[/*]    [*]The Top 500 players in each region will also earn a special TOP 500 emblem to commemorate their outstanding achievement[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/00b912ffd937c90545923b5e97fb84035fd25814.png[/img]

[b]Season 8 Skins[/b]
[list]    [*]Players who end the season in at least Gold V Tier will earn an exclusive Season 8 Vehicle Skin for the UAZ[/*]    [*]Players who end the season in at least Diamond V Tier will receive both the Vehicle Skin and an exclusive Season 8 Parachute Skin[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Upcoming Ranked Schedules[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Season 8 Ranked mode will end once servers go into maintenance on October 21st (KST) for PC players[/*]    [*]Season 9 Ranked mode will begin when servers go live with the 9.1 update[/*][/list]
[h2][b]How will my Rewards be Delivered?[/b][/h2]
All rewards are granted automatically at the beginning of each new season. You may collect them from the pop-up screen you’ll see upon your first log-in of the new season.

[h2][b]Looking Forward[/b][/h2]
Ranked Season 9 will start soon and features Ranked Solos for the first time, thanks to your feedback! That’s right, starting with Season 9, you’ll finally be able to test your skills in the traditional Battle Royale format, standing alone against an entire Battleground of enemies! We’re excited to debut this new ranked mode but for now, there’s still time to earn the Season 8 rewards before it ends. Drop in and Rank up today!

- The PUBG Dev Team

title: PUBG Labs: Arena mode
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fc16cc4e2d37f0c63510d094c78b7116f3c91d1e.png[/img]
[b]We're thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the new Arena Mode!  Based on your response, we have decided to expand Arena Mode's schedule to allow more time for playing and testing it out.

Arena Mode is now available non-stop until October 8.

With this extension, we hope you all really dive in and get a good feel for it. We're looking forward to your feedback! Thank you and we hope you enjoy the Arena![/b]

--

Hello Battlegrounds Enthusiasts,

This week we’re bringing you something new that combines intense PUBG gunplay with the tactics of an arena shooter. We call this LABS experiment Arena Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/04e52c1c1a40bf551afa8c704dfdb153f2fe5a37.jpg[/img]

Arena Mode is a 64 person, squad-based match that drops you into one of several sectioned-off zones on Erangel, Miramar, or Sanhok. You’ll fight it out with up to two other squads to claim victory in your arena. Should you lose, your team will lose one of its 3 chances, which eliminates you once they’re gone. Claim victory, and move onto the next round with a stronger position than those who failed. When 3 or fewer squads remain, they’ll enter a Sudden Death arena where the winner takes all, regardless of how many chances you have left.

Arena mode has some other differences from a normal match as well. The biggest of which is that weapons do not spawn in the world. Instead, you will need to use currency that you earn by eliminating other players to purchase your arsenal through the Loadout menu (PC: L key, Console: Map key(System menu/Touch pad) by default). Knocked allies can also be revived in 5 seconds, which is important for maintaining your advantage in such small, intense fights.

Surviving the Arena means teamwork and smart tactical decisions. From matching your loadout to the terrain you’re in, to watching each other’s backs until you’ve got eyes on your enemies, to coordinating your attack, Arena Mode is sure to test your teamwork and communication skills.

Here’s a quick breakdown of all the rules:
[h2]Rules[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5cfab5190e50127679b9a58dd815a0b4bd686436.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]In each round, 2-3 squads will dive into a random, sectioned-off area.[/*]    [*]Each squad starts with 3 chances and will be eliminated once those chances are lost.[/*]    [*]When 3 or fewer squads remain, they are placed into a sudden death round where the winner takes the chicken, regardless of how many chances each squad has left.[/*]    [*]There are no world spawn weapons. You will earn points during each round that can be used to purchase weapons from the Loadout menu (PC: L key, Console: Map key(System menu/Touch pad)).[/*]    [*]Other items, such as attachments, helmets and vests, still spawn across the map.[/*][/list][h2]Game Settings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f5d2d62972ba3fe98895937e7b0a10b360a9a410.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]64 players (16 squads)[/*]    [*]Erangel, Miramar, and Sanhok[/*]    [*]Squadmate revival time: 5 seconds[/*]    [*]Adjusted bluezone speed for more intense gameplay[/*]    [*]Your team will have 30 seconds to loot upon winning your Arena[/*]    [*]Observer Mode Enabled once your team has won an arena or been killed[/*][/list]
Arena Mode will be available in LABS over 2 weeks, so make sure to grab your squad and drop in while it’s available.

[b]PC & Console[/b]

September 24 (14:00 KST) ~ October 8 (16:00 KST)

As always, your feedback here is important and will help shape the mode should we decide to continue development on it.

We’ll see you in the Arena!

title: Update 8.3 - Now Live
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9bddaf4eaa1aa5595a5404cd7d5d110959e9c41b.png[/img]

The final update of season 8 is here and brings a brand new tool to help you catch up to the playzone, a new mode of transportation to avoid those heavily camped bridges, some UI adjustments and more!

Take a little extra time in the Blue Zone with the new Jammer Pack! This new pack has the capacity of a level 2 bag and interrupts Blue Zone damage while its battery lasts, letting you catch up to the play zone or utilize the blue zone for a tactical advantage. The Jammer Pack drops on Sanhok and Karakin starting this update!

Treading the chilled waters of Erangel are new Ferries delivering players to and from Sosnovka Island. Four Ferries travel back and forth between two different destinations, giving you some alternatives to crashing through bridge blockades, finding a boat, or swimming it. Add to that a new Assist indication in the UI, two new Team Deathmatch stages on Sanhok, indicators when your teammates enter combat, and more.

The M416 has also received an additional sound adjustment, you can the context related to this change in the patch notes. We hope these new changes are more to your liking, and will be monitoring your feedback.

Add to that a new Assist indication in the UI, two new Team Deathmatch stages on Sanhok, indicators when your teammates enter combat, and more.

[previewyoutube=1PGN4_3nUXo;full][/previewyoutube]
Learn all the details in the [url=https://www.pubg.com/2020/09/08/update-8-3/]patch notes[/url] or drop in and check them out yourself!

title: Update 8.3 - Patch Notes
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6423468c75ee3374b80e0d76d955282bb16ff7e5.png[/img]

Season 8 is winding down, but we've got a few more big improvements to drop before we're out of the jungle.

Update 8.3 brings a new Ferry system to Erangel, a new item that can temporarily negate Bluezone damage, two new Team Deathmatch stages on Sanhok, a number of bug and hitching fixes, and more. We've even, at long last, added destructible haystacks to Miramar!

Read on for info in all this and more coming with Update 8.3.

[h2]New Feature: Erangel Ferries[/h2]
For those of you wondering what the new docks on Erangel were all about since we added them last update, your ship has come in!

Two new Ferry lines will now carry passengers across the water from Southern Erangel to Sosnovka Island and back. There's a total of 4 ferries that make round trips throughout the game for those of you not feeling lucky enough to yolo it across the bridge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/dacf74cd9b4be536cd8bd894e78e66dfbba9f1f1.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]Four Ferries have been added to Erangel[/*]    [*]Ferries allow players to board and travel via two set routes between the Erangel Mainland and Sosnovka Island[list][*]Each route has two Ferries[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Each Ferry will depart from the docks with the first phase of the Blue Zone[/*]    [*]Once arriving at a dock, ferries will stay docked for approximately 20 seconds before taking to the sea en route to their destination[list]            [*]Ferries will sound a horn 7 secs prior to arrival and departure. Hop aboard![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ferries are not available in Ranked Mode or Esports Mode in Custom Matches[/*][/list]
[h2]New Item: Jammer Pack[/h2]
We've been teasing the Jammer Pack for a while, and it's finally making its Battlegrounds debut! The Jammer Pack allows you to prevent Blue Zone damage for a short time at the expense of level 3 bag space. For now, the Jammer Pack will only spawn rarely on Sanhok and Karakin in Normal and Custom Matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/310f149938af08d9e2629253c99c94cce6317817.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]The Jammer Pack uses its energy to temporarily prevent players from taking damage from the Blue Zone[list]            [*]An new energy bar for the Jammer Pack will be displayed on screen once equipped[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Once all energy has been depleted, the Jammer Pack will function only a regular backpack, not giving any protection against the Blue Zone[list]            [*]Energy depletes more quickly as the Blue Zone deals more damage[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Available in Normal and Custom Matches as rare world loot spawn on Karakin and Sanhok[list]            [*]Also obtainable from the Sanhok Loot Truck[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[b]General[/b]
[list]    [*]Decoy Grenades have been added Karakin and Training Mode[/*]    [*]Miramar haystacks are now destructible (much like their Erangel counterparts)[/*]    [*]Added Pai Nan and Bootcamp to Team Deathmatch[list][*]With the added maps, the map ratio for Sanhok in TDM has been increased[/list][/list]    [*]Added additional natural cover in the form of trees and rocks outside Bootcamp, Sanhok on both the North and West sides[/*]    [*]Since the recent sound improvements to the Kar98k and SKS, we've received feedback that the overall volume of the sounds are too loud. We've heard your feedback and have lowered the volume when firing both the Kar98k and SKS[/*]    [*]Destructible wooden shacks have been re-added to Erangel[list]            [*]These were temporarily replaced with concrete shacks in Update 8.2 due to a technical issue[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Sanhok Loot Truck[/b]
[list]    [*]Added Jammer Pack to available loot pool[/*]    [*]Greatly reduced the number of Level 3 Helmets and Ghillie suits drops[/*]    [*]Limited the number of duplicate item drops from Loot Trucks, to prevent situations where excessive loot of the same type is dropped from one Loot Truck[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Assist System[/b][/h2]
Up until now, assists were only tracked during the recap of Ranked Mode matches. Now we're expanding upon it's visibility and adding it to Normal Matches as well, with new UI elements added to show when your assists happen.

Assist UI and messaging has been added to Ranked Mode, Normal Matches in Duos/Squads and team modes in Battle Royale Custom Matches. The current assist system for TDM will remain unchanged.
[list]    [*]Assists are earned after dealing at least 25 damage to an enemy who is then killed soon after by a teammate[list]            [*]You'll be granted an assist for enemies knocked within 60 seconds of you dealing the minimum damage, who are then later killed by one of your teammate, without being revived beforehand[/*]            [*]Assists also apply when these conditions are met in situations where an enemy dies instantly, due to being the last member alive in their team or squad[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2]Teammate Combat Indicators[/h2]
We've added a visual indication for when your squad mates are attacked by enemy players. This will help teams react more quickly to allies under fire, especially those not using voice comms.
[list]    [*]Additional indicators will now display alongside the existing teammate UI to help you identify when teammates are engaged in combat.[/*]    [*]You'll see these indicators in the existing locations you get information on your teammate's current status.[list]            [*]Team HUD[/*]            [*]Minimap[/*]            [*]On-screen 3D teammate icons[/*]            [*]The notifications won't display while spectating (including replays) or watching the Deathcam[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2]Bot AI improvements[/h2][list]    [*]We've made a few improvements to bots to make them act a little more naturally[/*][/list]

[h2]M416 Sound Adjustment[/h2]
Sound is a crucial factor in PUBG's gameplay, realism, and fun and the PUBG Sound team has been looking for places to increase this quality further. One place we've targeted is improving weapon sounds to try and bring them as close to realistic as possible. To this end, the sound team recently updated the weapon sounds of the M416. However, we've received a large amount of feedback that these new sounds are not up to the standards and goes against the familiar gameplay experience you expect.

With the above in mind, we've made additional improvements on the M416 sounds. We hope these new changes are more to your liking, and will be monitoring your feedback. Our goal is to provide the highest quality and most realistic gameplay sounds for you, so you can rely on the best gameplay experience and fully immerse yourself in the Battlegrounds.

[h2]Ranked Mode[/h2]
[b]Train your skills while matchmaking[/b]

Players will now have the option to join Training Mode while waiting for their Ranked Match queue. About 30 seconds after your queue begins, you'll be given a popup asking whether you want to stay in the lobby or join Training Mode. 

This is a good, completely optional way to warm up and pass the time before getting into your Ranked Match.

title: PUBG Labs: Faction Warmode
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/13a73052299bb51c35768eaf90745b464c94a749.jpg[/img]

Hello players,

Last year, we introduced PUBG Labs as a way to experiment with fun game settings and try out new features and modes before they’re ready for normal matches.

While we haven’t had a new LABS mode in a while, we’ve seen you asking for new event modes and different ways to play.

To help scratch that itch, we’re spinning up Labs again, starting with an already existing mode: Faction Warmode. This time around, you'll be able to form your own 8 person party before entering, so grab your friends and get ready rumble!

Faction Warmode is a team vs team (8v8) match that takes place on Sanhok. When you spawn, you’ll be able to choose from one of several different [b]“Spawn Kits”[/b] that each have their own load-out. Your team has to work together to earn points by eliminating enemies within a small safe zone to reach the point threshold!

[b]Faction Warmode Schedule[/b]
[list]    [*]September 4th (Fri) 1600 (KST) - September 7th (Mon) 1600 (KST)[/*][/list]
[b]Matchmaking[/b]
[list]    [*]8 person squads, 8 vs 8 combat[/*]    [*]You can invite players to form up your squad of 8 and matchmaking will automatically fill any missing slots.[/*]    [*]TPP / FPP[/*][/list]
[b]Faction Warmode Rules[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1cd229ccc7a0ea9eccf95a7e3d27017b387df40d.png[/img]
[list]    [*]Faction Warmode takes place on Sanhok during several different weather types.[/*]    [*]Each match takes place in a small Safe Zone surrounded by a static Blue Zone.[/*][/list]
[b]When first entering the game, you will select one of four Spawn kits to play with:[/b]

[b]Assault - [/b]M416 (red dot), R1895, Level 1 Vest/Helmet, ammo, bandages
[b]Medic[/b] [b]-[/b] UMP (red dot), Sawed-off, Level 3 Vest/Helmet, ammo, First Aid Kit, Med Kit, Painkillers, Adrenaline Syringe, Critical Response Kit*
* Critical Response Kit: Allows you to revive a downed teammate much faster
[b]Support - [/b]S12K (red dot), Skorpion, Level 2 Vest/Helmet, ammo, Frag Grenade, Bandages
[b]Scout -[/b] Kar98K (4x Scope), P18C, Level 1 Vest/Helmet, Ghillie Suit, ammo, Bandages
[list]    [*]No Red Zone.[/*]    [*]No world spawn items. no vehicles, or Flare Guns and Care Packages.[/*]    [*]No Deathcam[/*]    [*]Respawn from the plane upon death[/*][/list]
[b]Win Conditions [/b]
[list]    [*]The team that reaches 200 points first wins the chicken dinner[/*]    [*]When the 15 minute timer reaches 0, the team with higher points wins.[list]            [*]Points are granted by the conditions:[list]                    [*]Kill an enemy player: +3 points[/*]                    [*]Down an enemy player: +1 point[/*]                    [*]Revive a teammate: +1 point[/*]                    [*]Down or kill a teammate: -5 points[/*]                    [*]Killed by your own grenade or falling: -5 points[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Other[/b]

In Faction Warmode you cannot:
[list]    [*]Earn BP or Survivor Pass XP[/*]    [*]Complete Survivor Pass missions[/*]    [*]Earn Weapon/survival mastery XP[/*]    [*]Utilize the Team Up feature after the game[/*][/list]
[b]Faction Warmode Known Issues[/b]
[list]    [*]In situations where a teammate reconnects to the game while dead, others in the team may be unable to see the UI which indicates they're a part of your team.[/*][/list]
Hope you enjoy the return of the PUBG LABS and the introduction of Faction Warmode.
We're always watching your feedback, so please keep it coming! We'll be back with additional modes in the future.

Thanks for playing!

title: Predict the champions of PCS2! Pick’Em Challenge now available
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a08a25c908f2ab9f29561cb96127feaa6855c659.png[/img]

Hello PUBG Esports fans!
Pick’em Challenge is back with the PUBG Continental Series 2 (PCS2)!
[previewyoutube=Q5LwxoA0tVg;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve extended the PCS2 Pick’em Challenge event duration, along with increased matches and days for the PCS2 tournament! Moreover, we’ve prepared various ways to get more voting coupons and EPs for free, so don’t miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/30d3dd8c2a7cc45c5dc7b712c65833627cb5c6b0.png[/img]

[b]Availability of PCS2 Items[/b]
PC: After the maintenance on Aug. 19, 2020 - 5 pm on Sep. 8, 2020 KST
Console: After the maintenance on Aug. 27, 2020 - 5 pm on Sep. 8, 2020 KST

[b]Voting Period[/b]
PC: After the maintenance on Aug. 19, 2020 - 6 pm on Sep. 8, 2020 KST
Console: After the maintenance on Aug. 27, 2020 - 6 pm on Sep. 8, 2020 KST

[b]Distribution of Esports Points (EPs) and availability of special items[/b]
PC & Console: 11am on Sep. 15, 2020 - 11am on Sep 23, 2020 KST

Twenty-five percent of the revenue from PCS2 items will be equally distributed among the four regional events. Exactly 12.5% of the 25% will go to the prize pool, and the other 12.5% will be allocated evenly to all participating teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2f685d16673d14e5c540e634f159e1316a3f3bf7.jpg[/img]

[u]Check out the details below, and don’t miss out on your chance to get these special PCS2 items![/u]

[b]Esports Shop is back![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fec9472894b77b7b0125b45ad201bf8aad4d6bc6.png[/img]

Starting with PCS2, the Esports Shop is reopening as an in-game space for PUBG Esports fans. You can use the shop and claim the final rewards and items from the Pick’Em Challenge with Esports Points. You can earn EPs by winning Pick’Em Challenge games or watching PCS2 live streaming.

[b]Main events of Pick’Em Challenge[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/35e55461d3a5eed7fb0ef3b1feb26b9360ebb682.png[/img]

There are two types of Pick’Em Challenges for PCS2, and you can earn EPs by participating in the event.

[b]1. PICK THE WINNER[/b]
In the main game of the Pick’Em Challenge, you predict the champion of each region with one voting coupon per region. You can get up to 14 voting coupons by purchasing PCS2 items.

[b]List of the PCS2 Items:[/b]
PCS2 Fierce Conflict - SLR + one voting coupon
PCS2 Gilded Triumph - Beryl M762 + one voting coupon
PCS2 Fierce Conflict - S12K + one voting coupon
PCS2 Tactical Torque - Buggy + one voting coupon
PCS2 Unseen Survivor Mask + one voting coupon
PCS2 Dance - Beckoning Boomstick + one voting coupon
PCS2 ALL-IN-ONE SET + five voting coupon
PCS2 WEAPON SET + three voting coupon

If you win the game to predict the champions, you will get 100,000 EPs that can be used at the Esports Shop in each region. For example, if you successfully predict the champion of one region, you will be awarded 100,000 EPs, and if you predict the champion of all regions, you can get a total of 400,000 EPs. You cannot vote for the same team twice, and you can only vote once for each team.

[b]2. TEAM FACEOFF[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/24f05597f82c496aa4caa73a92e470a50b7ffce8.png[/img]

The second game that lets you rack up EPs is the Team Faceoff, and you’ll win EP for each winner you select between which of two teams will rank higher in the tournament..

Team Faceoff can be played for FREE, no voting coupons required! Compared to PCS1, there’s a slight change in this game: If you successfully predict the winning teams, you will get EPs based on the winning team’s final percentage of votes.

[b]More chances to get additional voting coupons and EPs for FREE.[/b]
1. Twitch Drops - Obtaining voting coupons and EPs for free on Twitch
2. Twitch Live Quiz

There will be Twitch Drops and Quizzes during PCS2 live streaming on PCS2 Twitch broadcast channels, and you can acquire more free coupons and EPs while watching.

In order to get rewards, you need to link Twitch, Steam, and PUBG Account each other.

[b]How to link your Twitch and PUBG accounts[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b29ec9d74b88cf6f79b96a714b8e4cdabb489fd0.png[/img]
[list]    [*][url=https://accounts.pubg.com/]Click here[/url] to create or sign into your PUBG Global Account[/*]    [*]Link Twitch and Steam accounts on the Platform page.[/*][/list]
[b]Twitch Drops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a5bc0825797dfae6d52d557d38aaf9c1daacc449.png[/img][/b]You can get up to 20,000EPs and one free voting coupon based on your watching time.

The following channels have drops enabled:
[list]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg]https://www.twitch.tv/pubg[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/starladder_pubg_ru]https://www.twitch.tv/starladder_pubg_ru[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgtvturkiye]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgtvturkiye[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgkorea/]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgkorea/[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_japan_official]https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_japan_official[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgthailandofficial]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgthailandofficial[/url][/*]    [*][url=http://bit.ly/PMLtwitch]http://bit.ly/PMLtwitch[/url][/*][/list]

[b]Twitch Drops - Obtaining voting coupon for free by watching the tournament in select regions
[/b]Similar to PCS1, you can also get a voting coupon while watching select PCS2 live broadcasts.

A unique code for a voting coupon will be displayed during the broadcast, and people who quickly type in the code on the ”ADD EVENT CODE” section of the Pick’Em Challenge event tab or Store in-game will each receive a voting coupon on a first come-first served basis. You can only obtain one voting coupon per account through this event.

For Console players, we will announce the details soon of how to acquire your codes.

[b]Twitch Live Quiz
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f2a039c1f69421a3f1411d9aca180ef5b1d39576.png[/img]
[/b]On the official [url=http://twitch.tv/pubg]Twitch.tv/PUBG[/url] channel, live quizzes will be generated randomly during live streams. You can get EPs based on the highest EPs you get from regions.

[h2][b]Pick’Em Challenge FAQ[/b][/h2]
[b]1. Voting[/b]

[b]Q. Where can I vote?[/b]
A. Go to the Esports Tab > Pick’Em Challenge Event Tab in-game to cast a vote.

[b]Q. Where can I see the status of voting coupons I own?[/b]
A. Go to the Esports Tab > Pick’Em Challenge Event Tab to see the status of the voting coupons you own.

[b]Q. What happens if I get a refund after I have already voted?[/b]
A. Once you refund the item after you have already voted, the vote will be invalid.

[b]Q. What happens if I have the voting coupon, but the voting period has ended?[/b]
A. If the voting period has ended, you cannot vote anymore. The voting coupon will disappear as soon as the Pick’Em Challenge period ends.

[b]Q. Can I vote again for the same team?[/b]
A. You can only vote once for each team. If you have many voting coupons, you may vote for other teams as well.

[b]2. Rewards
[/b]
[b]Q. What do I get as a reward?[/b]
If you successfully predict the champion in the two types of Pick’Em Challenge games introduced above, you will earn Esports Points (EP). With the EPs obtained, you can obtain the final reward of the Pick’Em Challenge under PCS2 at the Esports Shop.

[b]Q. When do I get the Esports Points (EP)?[/b]
A. The EP is provided starting from 11am on Sep. 15, 2020 (KST) after PCS2 ends. You can use the points at the shops until 11 am on Sep. 23, 2020 (KST). If you don’t get them, please contact the Support team for further inquiries.

[b]Q. Will I continue to have the EPs even if I don’t use all of the points that I gained from this Pick’Em Challenge?[/b]
A. The EP you obtained from the Pick’Em Challenge under the PCS2 will remain until Sep. 23, 2020 and it will disappear after that.

[b]Q. Can I trade the items that I purchased with EP at the Steam store?[/b]
A. The items purchased using EP can be traded at the Steam Community Market beginning at 12 pm on Sep. 23, 2020 (KST).

[b]3. Free Voting Coupons and EPs
[/b]
[b]Q. How can I get a Twitch Drop and Quiz Rewards?[/b]
A. In order to get rewards, you need to link Twitch, Steam, and PUBG Account each other.

[b]*How to link accounts*[/b]
[list]    [*][url=https://accounts.pubg.com/]Click here[/url] to create or sign into your PUBG Global Account[/*]    [*]Link Twitch and Steam accounts in Platform page.[/*][/list]
[b]Q. When can I get rewards acquiring from Twitch Drops?[/b]
A. If you linked accounts, obtained voting coupons and EPs from Twitch Drops will automatically be getting into the PUBG account that you’ve linked, and you can check the reward details by clicking [Drops] among the information on the top right of the Twitch account.

[b]Q. What is the criteria of getting rewards from Twitch Drops?[/b]
A. With Twitch Drops, you can get up to 20,000EPs and one free voting coupon based on how much you watched PCS2 live streaming on Twitch .

[b]Q. When can I get rewards acquiring from Twitch Live Quiz?[/b]
A. Earned EPs through the Twitch Quiz will be provided after PCS2 ends.If you don’t get them, please contact the Support team for further inquiries.

[b]Q. What is the criteria of getting rewards from Twitch Live Quiz?[/b]
A. You can get EPs based on the highest EPs you get from regions.
For example, if you get 8,000 EP in NA, 5,000 EP in Europe, 10,000 EP in APAC, and 15,000EP in ASIA, you will get 15,000EP which is the highest points you earned. You will not get the cumulative amount of EP, only the highest region’s amount.

[b]Q. Which Twitch channels would activate Drops and cumulate my watching time?[/b]
A. PUBG Twitch channels listed below will activate Drops.
[list]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg]https://www.twitch.tv/pubg[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/starladder_pubg_ru]https://www.twitch.tv/starladder_pubg_ru[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgtvturkiye]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgtvturkiye[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgkorea/]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgkorea/[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_japan_official]https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_japan_official[/url][/*]    [*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubgthailandofficial]https://www.twitch.tv/pubgthailandofficial[/url][/*]    [*][url=http://bit.ly/PMLtwitch]http://bit.ly/PMLtwitch[/url][/*][/list]
Q. Which Twitch channel would activate Live Quiz?
A. PUBG Official Global channel ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg]https://www.twitch.tv/pubg[/url]) will activate Live Quiz.

title: Update 8.2 - Now Live!
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[previewyoutube=s5lAyoaBaHs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Update 8.2 is now live on PC servers and brings two new loot items, some updated weapon models, updated seaside locations on Erangel, some bug fixes, and more![/b]

Unpack the latest weapon, the devastating MG3, now dropping in care packages on all non-ranked Battlegrounds. This new LMG comes with a variable fire rate between 660 and 990 rounds per minute and does increased damage to vehicles. Drop prone and pull out the gun's built-in bipod for added stability when spitting bullets across longer distances.

The brand new Decoy Grenade is also available now, spawning across Sanhok in Normal Matches. With the ability to mimic the gunfire sounds of various weapons, even to the point of spitting out shell casings, this compact distraction might be just what you need to get the drop on an enemy or at least turn their head for a moment.

[b]All this and more now available on live servers. [/b]

Read full details in our [url=https://www.pubg.com/2020/08/10/update-8-2-patch-notes/]Patch Notes[/url] and drop in to check out everything new!

title: Update 8.2 - Patch Notes
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/06304718110ac02250d8e922c27a5c6585a30be8.jpg[/img]

We're bringing some new toys to the Battlegrounds in update 8.2, along with some visual improvements to a few weapons, a nostalgia hit in the main menu, and more!

[b]Update 8.2 is planned to hit the Test Server on August 12, before coming to live servers on August 19 KST.[/b]

[h2]New Weapon: MG3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ac34dba42296234e78d12dd62d310bddcedd6b8e.png[/img][/h2]
The latest weapon available in Battlegrounds Care Packages is the fast firing MG3 Light Machine Gun. With two different rates of fire, a bipod for stability, tracer rounds to help you keep track of your spray, and increased weapon damage to vehicles, theres a new reason to fight over the big red box.
[list]    [*]Spawns in Care Packages on all maps, in Normal Matches only[list]            [*]Not currently available in Ranked Matches[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The MG3 has two firing modes which change the fire rate between 660 rpm and 990 rpm[/*]    [*]Chambered for 7.62mm, holds 75 rounds and has a muzzle velocity of 820 m/s[/*]    [*]1.25x damage multiplier when shooting vehicles[/*]    [*]Tracer rounds are fired every 5th round, as well as for the final 10 bullets of each magazine, letting you know that ammo is running low.[list][*]Tracer rounds can only be seen by the shooter[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Supports optical attachments up to the 6x Scope[/*]    [*]The MG3 has an attached bipod, deploying automatically when prone to greatly improve weapon stability[/*][/list]
[h2]New Throwable: Decoy Grenade
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0ce0f4da2580e6124ff828dcaea4ccd48178f9eb.png[/img][/h2]
Disorient your enemies and cover your movements with the new Decoy Grenade. Available as world loot on Sanhok, the Decoy Grenade will make fake firing sounds for about 10 seconds after thrown, giving you a few moments to make your move.

The Decoy Grenade is a new throwable which mimics gunshot sounds. Purposely made to be used as a tactical item to distract and outwit your opponents.
[list]    [*]Available only on Sanhok in Normal Matches, as a rare world spawn item[list]            [*]Not available in Ranked Mode[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Decoy grenades can be cooked to reduce their detonation time out of the hand and are thrown just like other grenades[list]            [*]Upon detonation, Decoy Grenades emit gunshot sounds for 10 seconds and eject shell casings to add to the guise of real gunfire[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Beware, they're not waterproof! Dropping one into water will disable its effects[/*]    [*]Decoy Grenades don't currently spawn in Training Mode[/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[b]Weapon Remodel and Retexture
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8a4cedb37a80404910457fa465ff2bc48df25278.png[/img]
[/b]

M416, SKS and Kar98k has been remodeled from scratch to improve their visual quality. Along with their visual update, weapon sounds of these weapons has been overhauled.

[b]Care Package Updates[/b]
[list]    [*]C4 has been added to Care Packages on all maps, except Karakin[/*]    [*]MG3 has been added to Care Packages on all maps[list]            [*]The C4 and MG3 are not available in Ranked Mode[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]LMG (Light Machine Gun) Balance Adjustment[/b]
[list]    [*]Vehicle damage multipliers have been added to LMGs.[list]            [*]MG3: x 1.25[/*]            [*]DP28 : 1.15x[/*]            [*]M249: 1.10x[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Camera shake when firing LMGs while prone has been reduced[list]            [*]There has been no changes made to the weapon recoil. However, players may feel the weapon is more stable due to reduced camera shake.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]World[/h2]
[b]Erangel Docks[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/93672a540a1ce22944da779a92dff1d8438cc760.png[/img]
[list]    [*]Four docks have been added to Erangel[list]            [*]Two docks have been added to existing wharves, one at Novorepnoye and the other at Ferry Pier[/*]            [*]The southern beaches of the Erangel mainland and Sosnovka Island have also had docks added[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[b]Throwables Wheel Menu Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/37a85cb371b6751c89fcf2acd57be40b7cff7e78.png[/img]
[/b]

The Throwables Wheel has been updated to better facilitate multiple recent additions to the PUBG throwable arsenal.
[list]    [*]The wheel now has 6 slots and allows access to all throwables[list]            [*]4 slots are permanent locations for the most common throwables; Frag Grenade, Molotov Cocktail, Smoke Grenade and Stun Grenade[/*]            [*] [/*]            [*]2 slots are dynamic. The dynamic slot on the right side holds either Sticky bomb or C4 and the one on the left can hold either Decoy grenade or Spike Trap[list]                    [*]If your inventory has both the Sticky Bomb and C4, the wheel will prioritize the Sticky Bomb. With Decoy grenade and Spike Trap, the Decoy grenade takes priority[/*]                    [*]If you have a Sticky Bomb or Decoy equipped in your throwables slot, the dynamic slot on the wheel will display the other corresponding item, C4 or Spike Trap[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Helmet Hide Function
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4a179e7f54ecd594c259efa25a6f81eb3f72142c.png[/img]
[/b]

Sometimes you just want to look good for YOU. For those moments, you can now toggle off your helmet to maintain your default costume pieces, even after you protect your noggin with a fine Level 3 helmet. This functionality is purely cosmetic, and other players will still see you with a helmet on, but you'll at least get the satisfaction of enjoying your chicken dinner in full Alex the Dinosaur costume glory.
[list]    [*]When Helmet Hide is enabled, your hoodie, hat or other head covering will remain visible even when wearing a helmet.[list]            [*]To all other players, you'll still be seen wearing, equipping and otherwise interacting with your helmet.[/*]            [*]This is a local visual change, only showing for players who enable it.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Helmet Hide is disabled by default. You can enable it in the Settings, or by clicking the option in the Inventory.[/*]    [*]Equipable slots for Head and Helmet are now separated.[list]            [*]Equipping a helmet now won't automatically drop your hat, or other cosmetic item in the head slot.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[h2]Performance[/h2]
The Following performance improvements have been made:
[list]    [*]Improved font loading process to reduce game stuttering/hitching[/*]    [*]Optimized the process for loading character data to reduce instances of stuttering/hitching and ensure a more stable framerate[/*]    [*]The item table is now preloaded on the client backend which results in items loading quicker[/*]    [*]Refactored the onscreen Key Guide widget to reduce potential instances of stuttering/hitching[/*]    [*]Improved the game from hitching when loading a character on the inventory screen[/*][/list]
[h2]Esports Tab - PCS 2[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f47cde31309a3a810e31a54620325d6dc3dbd593.png[/img]

The Esports Tab has been updated to include PCS2 information and the next Pick em challenge!

When the challenge unlocks, you can head over and make your predictions just like before. Grab as many points as you can and pick up some of the great new PCS2 items! The Esports Tab will be available until September 23rd!

[b]Menu Breakdown[/b]
[list]    [*]OVERVIEW[/*]    [*]Overview page will now feature a total of 4 pages.[list]            [*]1st page[list]                    [*]An introduction to PCS 2 and thumbnail image which when clicked will redirect you to the live stream and event information.[/*]                    [*]Now each day with a match on a schedule will be highlighted.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]2nd page[list]                    [*]Introduction to the Pick'em challenge. Here, you will be able to learn how to participate and preview rewards.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]3rd, 4th page[list]                    [*]PCS Focus which features certain players who successfully advanced to PCS 2 from each region (APAC/ASIA, EUROPE/NORTH)[/*]                    [*]A player who has recorded the best PCS 1 PEPS+ stats from the region[/*]                    [*]A player who has recorded the most kills in PCS 2 preliminary[/*]                    [*]A player who has been selected as a dark horse[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]TEAMS[/b]
[list]    [*]All participating teams and their players (including team's reserved players!) can be found here.[/*]    [*]Under the team name, the title of the preliminary where that team went through and their final placement is displayed.[/*]    [*]Weekly team stats will be updated weekly.[/*]    [*]STANDINGS[list]            [*]Up to date standings with a per region breakdown (APAC, Asia, North America, and Europe)[/*]            [*]Until the start of the event, countdown to the very first match of each region is displayed.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]PICK'EM CHALLENGE[list]            [*]Event page for the PCS2 Pick’Em Challenge where you can vote on who you think will take home the event victory.[/*]            [*]All details can be found here on how to participate for a chance to unlock exclusive rewards. We’ll also be sharing a separate announcement with more details before this goes live[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
Want more info? Read the PCS 2 event announcement [url=https://www.pubg.com/2020/08/04/pcs-update-upcoming-pcs2-and-the-pcs3-that-will-keep-the-excitement-going/]here[/url].
Stay tuned for another announcement on everything you need to know about the Pick’Em Challenge.

For everything PUBG Esports, head over to [url=http://pubgesports.com/]pubgesports.com[/url], or hit the PCS2 logo in the esports tab for an easy shortcut when you’re in-game.

[h2]UI/UX & Menus[/h2]
[b]Background Music Selection
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c88d2a2a2ff79c32adb202a38927a94f0341ce4d.png[/img]
[/b]

Players looking for a bit of nostalgia when they log in can now choose their lobby music! We've added a selection of themes dating from all the way back to Early Access for you to choose from. After all, there's no better way to get hyped for the Battlegrounds than by rocking your favorite tunes!

Select your Background Music under Settings.
[list]    [*]Previously used background music is now available for selection[list]            [*]Each Season, BGM is reset to default[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Ranked Mode and the Esports tab will feature their own exclusive BGM which cannot be changed[/*][/list]
[b]Match History[/b]
[list]    [*]New Match History section has been added to the Career tab[/*]    [*]You can view your most recent 20 matches[list]            [*]Review match records from both Normal and Ranked matches[/*]            [*]Records over 30 days old cannot be viewed in detail[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Leaving a match early or disconnecting due to an error will prevent that match from being recorded in your Match History[/*][/list]
[b]New Loading Screen and Guide for Training Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8f3f20d4b44e300b68f9ef8e38e0291af41a9d20.png[/img]
[/b][list][*]New splash art and text has been added to the loading screen[/*]    [*]Additional informational text has been added to the minimap[/*][/list]
[b]In-game UI Improvements[/b]
[list]    [*]Unified the style and location of round buttons to improve the visual experience[/*]    [*]Improved irregular title locations on some screens[/*]    [*]Design of badges, tags, wide pop-up screens and drop-down menus has been improved[/*][/list]
[b]Emote Settings Improvement[/b]
[list]    [*]Now you can double click to equip/unequip an emote from your emote list.[/*]    [*]Drag & drop emotes in the emote wheel to change slots or unequip emotes.[/*][/list]
[b]Improved System messages[/b]
[list]    [*]Improved system messages displayed in case of server maintenance, server overload, external provider authentication failure etc to be more clear.[/*][/list]
[b]Store UI Update[/b]
[list]    [*]When bonus items are included in sets, they are now displayed in the Bonus Gift section of the item preview screen.[/*]    [*]Now all set items are displayed on the character while previewing an emote.[/*][/list]
[h2]Social[/h2]
[b]Friends List Rework[/b]
[list]    [*]The friends list has undergone a visual and functional rework[list]            [*]More detailed status friend statuses are now displayed, such as 'On your team'[/*]            [*]Friends tab now displays the last online state of an offline player on your friends list[/*]            [*]Information on when you last played with someone on your recent tab is now displayed[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Invite[list]            [*]Now players can invite a player already in a team[/*]            [*]Accepting this invite will make the player move from the existing team to the new team.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Follow friends renamed to add/remove friends[/*][/list]
[h2]Custom Matches[/h2]
[b]Team Deathmatch is now available in Custom Matches[/b]
[list]    [*]Now you can enjoy TDM in custom matches[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ee5879466cb13c83d0dfe3cdeacb2214fcaa3096.png[/img]

[b]New system message for Custom Matches[/b]
[list]    [*]A new message has been added for when players are kicked by match observers[list]            [*]This is to clearly distinguish messages in situations where a player has been kicked by the host, versus being kicked for cheating or another Rules of Conduct offence[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Replay System[/b]
[list]    [*]The replay system has been updated. Replay files from previous updates are now unable to be used[/*][/list]
[h2]Skin & Items[/h2]
[b]New Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/caaea0f835206d24998300021edecb517ed42765.png[/img][/b]
[list]    [*]Night on the Town[list]            [*]Sets[list]                    [*]NIGHTCLUB DRESS SET (+ Victory Dance 23 emote)[/*]                    [*]BOW TIE AND SUSPENDERS SET (+ Bundle of Hearts emote)[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Individual items[list]            [*]Nightclub Dress (White)[/*]            [*]Nightclub Stockings[/*]            [*]Bow Tie and Suspenders Suit[/*]            [*]Shiny Shoes and Socks[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]PCS 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fb12196ca2a9045e815cfa1c919d037867ecff6e.jpg[/img]
[/b][b]PCS Item sets (8 sets - Each comes with 1 voting coupon)[/b]
[list]    [*]PCS2 SLR BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 BERYL M762 BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 S12K BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 BUGGY BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 MASK BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 EMOTE BOX[/*]    [*]PCS2 ALL-IN-ONE SET[/*]    [*]PCS2 WEAPON SET[/*][/list]
[b]Metal Plated M416 Skins[/b]
[list]    [*]Gold and Silver Plate M416 skins are returning to the store!
Over the years, we've released dozens of skins on the PUBG store, only to have them never show up again after the initial sale. Some players have been asking for another chance at some of these skins, so after some thought, we've decided to bring a couple items back to the store. title: PCS Update: Upcoming PCS2 and the PCS3 that will keep the excitement going
author: Hawkinz
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e44f87d297ac2ca66392fda9930e931f020e93a9.jpg[/img]

Hello PUBG Esports fans,

Today, we are excited to share additional details about the upcoming PCS2 event and reveal our new plan to hold a third tournament, PCS3, that will keep the excitement of PUBG Esports rolling through the rest of the year.

[h2]PCS2 – Increased tension and fun with more matches[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c35e708dc6fad5460f3f8fbed37ef7fa8a51cd72.png[/img]

Scheduled to be held in August, we’ve made the decision to extend the tournament period for PCS2 and increase the total number of matches. PUBG Esports fans will get 24 matches per region played over three weeks in order to maximize the thrill of competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fe3a83f94e6b210e018717ca3b15091866dbde08.png[/img]

[list][*]PCS2 Tournament Period
[list][*]Asia: August 27–28, September 3-4, September 8-9
[*]North America: August 27–28, September 3-4, September 10-11
[*]Asia-Pacific: August 29-30, September 5-6, September 12-13
[*]Europe: August 29-30, September 5-6, September 12-13[/list]
[*]Total Matches
[list][*]24 matches in total per region (4 matches per day)[/list][/list]

With the extended period and more matches, we can’t wait to see what kind of new strategies and adjustments the world’s top PUBG teams will bring to PCS2!

The Pick’em Challenge event, which gives fans a chance to benefit directly from the livestream action, is expanding as well to run over the course of the three week event.

[list][*]Sale period of the PCS2 items and the Pick’em Challenge event period
[list][*]PC: After the server maintenance on August 19 ~ Until 6 p.m. on September 8
[*]Console: After the server maintenance on August 27 ~ Until 6 p.m. on September 8[/list][/list]

We will offer more diverse Pick‘Em items for PCS2. In case you want to know more, here’s a sneak peek at some of the sales and reward items that will be available for PCS2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/81a9ae4856316817a3f53fa6f5a764ddc1da976c.jpg[/img]

You can see these must-have items in the game beginning August 19 (August 27 for console) when the Pick’em Challenge event starts.

[h2]PCS3 will keep the excitement of PUBG Esports going[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2e57868a1200a9ccd2a73c74435a3870e9c9a682.png[/img]

We want to continue to give back to PUBG Esports fans, provide the opportunity for players and teams to play on a global stage, and ensure the sustainability of the PUBG Esports system. So, PUBG is making plans to hold a PUBG Continental Series 3 (PCS3) event in November. Stay tuned for more information about PCS3, as we put the finishing touches on the event plan.

Despite these difficult times, we will continue to hold fun and exciting esports tournaments in support of our fans, players and partners. In addition to the two upcoming PCS events, we are also putting lots of thought and effort into global tournaments, which are considered the finale and the essence of PUBG esports for everyone to enjoy every year. We hope that you will continue to support us in our future events.

Thank you.
